2.8.6.s: ā devo yātu savitā suratnaḥ | antarikṣaprā vahamāno aśvaiḥ | haste dadhāno naryā purūṇi | niveśayanca prasuvañca bhūma | abhīvṛtaṃ kṛśanairviśvarūpam | hiraṇyaśamyaṃ yajato bṛhantam | āsthādrathaṃ savitā citrabhānuḥ | kṛṣṇā rajāṃsi taviṣīṃ dadhānaḥ | saghā no devaḥ savitā savāya | āsāviṣadvasupatirvasūni
2.8.6.d: आ देवो यातु सविता सुरत्नः । अन्तरिक्षप्रा वहमानो अश्वैः । हस्ते दधानो नर्या पुरूणि । निवेशयन्च प्रसुवञ्च भूम । अभीवृतं कृशनैर्विश्वरूपम् । हिरण्यशम्यं यजतो बृहन्तम् । आस्थाद्रथं सविता चित्रभानुः । कृष्णा रजांसि तविषीं दधानः । सघा नो देवः सविता सवाय । आसाविषद्वसुपतिर्वसूनि
2.8.6.m: May god Savitṛ come, possessing fine jewels, / filling the midspace, borne by horses, / bearing many human delights in his hand, / laying [all creatures] to rest and impelling the world. / Covered with pearls, all-formed, / with golden yoke-pins, worthy of worship, great, / god Savitṛ of bright radiance has mounted his chariot, / traversing the dark realms, displaying strength. / May that god Savitṛ, the lord of goods, / impel wealth for us at his impelling.

2.8.6.s: viśrayamāṇo amatimurūcīm | martabhojanamadha rāsate na | vi janāñchyāvāḥ śitipādo akhyan | rathaṃ hiraṇyapra ugaṃ vahantaḥ | śaśvaddiśaḥ saviturdaivyasya | upasthe viśvā bhuvanāni tasthuḥ | vi suparṇo antarikṣāṇyakhyat | gabhīravepā asuraḥ sunīthaḥ | kvedānīṃ sūryaḥ kaściketa | katamāṃ dyāṃ raśmirasyātatāna
2.8.6.d: विश्रयमाणो अमतिमुरूचीम् । मर्तभोजनमध रासते न । वि जनाञ्छ्यावाः शितिपादो अख्यन् । रथं हिरण्यप्र उगं वहन्तः । शश्वद्दिशः सवितुर्दैव्यस्य । उपस्थे विश्वा भुवनानि तस्थुः । वि सुपर्णो अन्तरिक्षाण्यख्यत् । गभीरवेपा असुरः सुनीथः । क्वेदानीं सूर्यः कश्चिकेत । कतमां द्यां रश्मिरस्याततान
2.8.6.m: Spreading out broad brilliance, / he now bestows sustenance upon mortals. / The dark, white-footed steeds have looked out upon the peoples, / drawing the chariot with its golden pole. / Continually all realms have stood within the lap / of the divine Savitṛ, according to the quarters. / The beautiful-winged bird has surveyed the midspaces, / the asura of deep stirring, the good guide. / Where is the sun now? Who has understood it? / To which heaven has his ray extended?

2.8.6.s: bhagaṃ dhiyaṃ vājayantaḥ purandhim | narāśaṃso gnāspatirno avyāt | ā'ye vāmasya saṃgathe rayīṇām | priyā devasya savituḥ syāma | ā no viśve askrā gamantu devāḥ | mitro aryamā varuṇaḥ sajoṣāḥ | bhuvan yathā no viśve vṛdhāsaḥ | karanthsuṣāhā vithuraṃ na śavaḥ | śaṃ no devā viśvadevā bhavantu | śaṃ sarasvatī saha dhībhirastu
2.8.6.d: भगं धियं वाजयन्तः पुरन्धिम् । नराशंसो ग्नास्पतिर्नो अव्यात् । आऽये वामस्य संगथे रयीणाम् । प्रिया देवस्य सवितुः स्याम । आ नो विश्वे अस्क्रा गमन्तु देवाः । मित्रो अर्यमा वरुणः सजोषाः । भुवन् यथा नो विश्वे वृधासः । करन्थ्सुषाहा विथुरं न शवः । शं नो देवा विश्वदेवा भवन्तु । शं सरस्वती सह धीभिरस्तु
2.8.6.m: Seeking to win Bhaga, the prayer, and Purandhi, / may Narāśaṃsa, the lord of the wives of the gods, protect us! / When goods are brought together, / may we be dear to the lovely god Savitṛ. / May the all-gods, agile, come to us, / Mitra, Aryaman, and Varuṇa in full accord, / so that all of them may be our increasers, / making their power easily bearable, not shaky. / May the gods, the all-gods, bring us peace; / may Sarasvatī together with prayers bring peace.

2.8.6.s: śamabhiṣācaḥ śamu rātiṣācaḥ | śaṃ no divyāḥ pārthivāḥ śaṃ no apyāḥ | ye savituḥ satyasavasya viśve | mitrasya vrate varuṇasya devāḥ | te saubhagaṃ vīravadgomadapnaḥ | dadhātana draviṇaṃ citramasme | agne yāhi dūtyaṃ vāriṣeṇyaḥ | devāṃ acchā brahmakṛtā gaṇena | sarasvatīṃ maruto aśvinā'paḥ | yakṣi devānratnadheyāya viśvān
2.8.6.d: शमभिषाचः शमु रातिषाचः । शं नो दिव्याः पार्थिवाः शं नो अप्याः । ये सवितुः सत्यसवस्य विश्वे । मित्रस्य व्रते वरुणस्य देवाः । ते सौभगं वीरवद्गोमदप्नः । दधातन द्रविणं चित्रमस्मे । अग्ने याहि दूत्यं वारिषेण्यः । देवां अच्छा ब्रह्मकृता गणेन । सरस्वतीं मरुतो अश्विनाऽपः । यक्षि देवान्रत्नधेयाय विश्वान्
2.8.6.m: Peace from those who attend [us], peace from the bestowers of gifts! / Peace to us from the heavenly, the earthly, and the watery! / Those all-gods who are in the ordinance of Savitṛ of true impulsion, / of Mitra, and of Varuṇa, / do you place in us good fortune, possessions rich in heroes and cattle, / and diverse wealth! / O Agni, go as an envoy, you who are worthy to be chosen, / toward the gods with the host that performs the brahman! / Worship Sarasvatī, the Maruts, the Aśvins, the Waters, / and all the gods, for the bestowing of treasures!

2.8.6.s: dyauḥ pitaḥ pṛthivi mātaradhruk | agne bhrātarvasavo mṛḍatā naḥ | viśva ādityā adite sajoṣāḥ | asmabhyaṃ śarma bahulaṃ viyanta | viśve devāḥ śṛṇutemaṃ havaṃ me | ye antarikṣe ya upa dyavi ṣṭha | ye agnijihvā uta vā yajatrāḥ | āsadyāsminbarhiṣi mādayadhvam | ā vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā havyajuṣṭim | namasā devāvavasā''vavṛtyām
2.8.6.d: द्यौः पितः पृथिवि मातरध्रुक् । अग्ने भ्रातर्वसवो मृडता नः । विश्व आदित्या अदिते सजोषाः । अस्मभ्यं शर्म बहुलं वियन्त । विश्वे देवाः शृणुतेमं हवं मे । ये अन्तरिक्षे य उप द्यवि ष्ठ । ये अग्निजिह्वा उत वा यजत्राः । आसद्यास्मिन्बर्हिषि मादयध्वम् । आ वां मित्रावरुणा हव्यजुष्टिम् । नमसा देवाववसा'ऽववृत्याम्
2.8.6.m: O Father Heaven, O Mother Earth, who do not deceive, / O brother Agni, O Vasus, be gracious to us! / All you Ādityas, harmonious with Aditi, / extend abundant protection to us! / O all-gods, hear this call of mine, / you who are in the midspace and you who abide in heaven, / you whose tongue is Agni, and who are worthy of worship; / seated on this barhis-grass, rejoice! / May I turn the two of you, Mitra and Varuṇa, to the offering of oblations / with homage, O gods, and with aid.

2.8.6.s: asmākaṃ brahma pṛtanāsu sahyā asmākam | vṛṣṭirdivyā supārā | yuvaṃ vastrāṇi pīvasā vasāthe | yuvoracchidrā mantavo ha sargāḥ | avātiratamanṛtāni viśvā | ṛtena mitrāvaruṇā sacethe | tathsu vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā mahitvam | īrmā tasthuṣīrahabhirduduhre | viśvāḥ pinvatha svasarasya dhenāḥ | anu vāmekaḥ pavirāvavarti
2.8.6.d: अस्माकं ब्रह्म पृतनासु सह्या अस्माकम् । वृष्टिर्दिव्या सुपारा । युवं वस्त्राणि पीवसा वसाथे । युवोरच्छिद्रा मन्तवो ह सर्गाः । अवातिरतमनृतानि विश्वा । ऋतेन मित्रावरुणा सचेथे । तथ्सु वां मित्रावरुणा महित्वम् । ईर्मा तस्थुषीरहभिर्दुदुह्रे । विश्वाः पिन्वथ स्वसरस्य धेनाः । अनु वामेकः पविराववर्ति
2.8.6.m: May our brahman prevail in the battles, may our / divine rain bring good passage! / The two of you put on garments of fatness; / without break are your designs and courses. / You crossed beyond all falsehoods; / you accompany Mitra and Varuṇa with truth. / That, O Mitra and Varuṇa, is your greatness: / the cows that stood still have been milked through the days; / you swell all the milch cows of the pasture; one felly of yours turns along.

2.8.6.s: yadbaṃhiṣṭhaṃ nātivide sudānū | acchidraṃ śarma bhuvanasya gopā | tato no mitrāvaruṇāvavīṣṭam | siṣāsanto jīgivāṃsaḥ syāma | ā no mitrāvaruṇā havyadātim | ghṛtairgavyūtimukṣatamiḍābhiḥ | prativāmatra varamā janāya | pṛṇītamudno divyasya cāroḥ | pra bāhavā sisṛtaṃ jīvase naḥ | ā no gavyūtimukṣataṃ ghṛtena
2.8.6.d: यद्बंहिष्ठं नातिविदे सुदानू । अच्छिद्रं शर्म भुवनस्य गोपा । ततो नो मित्रावरुणाववीष्टम् । सिषासन्तो जीगिवांसः स्याम । आ नो मित्रावरुणा हव्यदातिम् । घृतैर्गव्यूतिमुक्षतमिडाभिः । प्रतिवामत्र वरमा जनाय । पृणीतमुद्नो दिव्यस्य चारोः । प्र बाहवा सिसृतं जीवसे नः । आ नो गव्यूतिमुक्षतं घृतेन
2.8.6.m: That which is most firm, not to be broken through, O generous ones, / the unbroken shelter, O guardians of the world, / from that, O Mitra and Varuṇa, protect us, / that we may be winning and victorious! / To our offering of oblation, O Mitra and Varuṇa, / sprinkle the pasture with ghee and with refreshments! / To your satisfaction here for the people, / fill [us] with the stream of the lovely divine [rain]! / Stretch forth your arms for our life! / Sprinkle our pasture with ghee!

2.8.6.s: ā no jane śravayataṃ yuvānā | śrutaṃ me mitrāvaruṇā havemā | imā rudrāya sthiradhanvane giraḥ | kṣipreṣave devāya svadhāmne | aṣāḍhāya sahamānāya mīḍhuṣe | tigmāyudhāya bharatā śṛṇotana | tvā dattebhī rudra śaṃtamebhiḥ | śataṃ himā aśīya bheṣajebhiḥ | vyasmaddveṣo vitaraṃ vyaṃhaḥ | vyamīvāṃścātayasvā viṣūcīḥ
2.8.6.d: आ नो जने श्रवयतं युवाना । श्रुतं मे मित्रावरुणा हवेमा । इमा रुद्राय स्थिरधन्वने गिरः । क्षिप्रेषवे देवाय स्वधाम्ने । अषाढाय सहमानाय मीढुषे । तिग्मायुधाय भरता शृणोतन । त्वा दत्तेभी रुद्र शंतमेभिः । शतं हिमा अशीय भेषजेभिः । व्यस्मद्द्वेषो वितरं व्यंहः । व्यमीवांश्चातयस्वा विषूचीः
2.8.6.m: Make us renowned among the people, O young ones! / Hear, O Mitra and Varuṇa, these calls of mine! / These songs to Rudra of the firm bow, / of swift arrows, the self-ruling god, / unconquerable, overpowering, the bountiful, / of sharp weapons—bring them and hear! / With the most healing remedies given by you, O Rudra, / may I attain a hundred winters! / Drive far away hatred from us, drive away distress, / drive away the diseases in every direction!

2.8.6.s: arhanbibharṣi mā nastoke | ā te pitarmarutāṃ sumnametu | mā naḥ sūryasya saṃdṛśo yuyothāḥ | abhi no vīro arvati kṣameta | prajāyemahi rudra prajābhiḥ | evā babhro vṛṣabha cekitāna | yathā deva na hṛṇīṣe na haṃsi | hāvanaśrūrno rudreha bodhi | bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ | pari ṇo rudrasya hetiḥ stuhi śrutam | mīḍhuṣṭamārhanbibharṣi | tvamagne rudra ā vo rājānam
2.8.6.d: अर्हन्बिभर्षि मा नस्तोके । आ ते पितर्मरुतां सुम्नमेतु । मा नः सूर्यस्य संदृशो युयोथाः । अभि नो वीरो अर्वति क्षमेत । प्रजायेमहि रुद्र प्रजाभिः । एवा बभ्रो वृषभ चेकितान । यथा देव न हृणीषे न हंसि । हावनश्रूर्नो रुद्रेह बोधि । बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः । परि णो रुद्रस्य हेतिः स्तुहि श्रुतम् । मीढुष्टमार्हन्बिभर्षि । त्वमग्ने रुद्र आ वो राजानम्
2.8.6.m: “Worthy you bear...” [and] “Do not [harm] our children...” / May your favor come, O father of the Maruts! / Do not separate us from the sight of the sun! / May our hero hold his own upon his steed! / May we propagate, O Rudra, through offspring! / Thus, O tawny, wise bull, / so that, O god, you are neither angry nor strike, / be one who hears our calls here, O Rudra! / May we, rich in heroes, speak loudly in the assembly! / “May the weapon of Rudra avoid us...”, “Praise the renowned...”, / “O most bountiful...”, “Worthy you bear...”, / “You, O Agni, are Rudra...”, “To your king...”

2.8.7.s: sūryo devīmuṣasaṃ rocamānā maryaḥ | na yoṣāmabhyeti paścāt | yatrā naro devayanto yugāni | vitanvate prati bhadrāya bhadram | bhadrā aśvā haritaḥ sūryasya | citrā edagvā anumādyāsaḥ | namasyanto diva ā pṛṣṭhamasthuḥ | pari dyāvāpṛthivī yanti sadyaḥ | tathsūryasya devatvaṃ tanmahitvam | madhyā kartorvitataṃ saṃjabhāra
2.8.7.d: सूर्यो देवीमुषसं रोचमाना मर्यः । न योषामभ्येति पश्चात् । यत्रा नरो देवयन्तो युगानि । वितन्वते प्रति भद्राय भद्रम् । भद्रा अश्वा हरितः सूर्यस्य । चित्रा एदग्वा अनुमाद्यासः । नमस्यन्तो दिव आ पृष्ठमस्थुः । परि द्यावापृथिवी यन्ति सद्यः । तथ्सूर्यस्य देवत्वं तन्महित्वम् । मध्या कर्तोर्विततं संजभार
2.8.7.m: The sun follows behind the shining goddess Dawn, / as a young man follows a maiden, / where god-fearing men stretch out their yokes / for auspicious [tasks], auspicious for the auspicious. / Auspicious are the tawny mares of the sun, / bright, swift, praiseworthy; / receiving homage, they mounted the back of heaven; / in a single day they traverse heaven and earth. / That is the godhead of the sun, that is his greatness: / in the middle of his work he gathered up what was outspread.

2.8.7.s: yadedayukta haritaḥ sadhasthāt | ādrātrī vāsastanute simasmai | tanmitrasya varuṇasyābhicakṣe | sūryo rūpaṃ kṛṇute dyorupasthe | anantamanyadruśadasya pājaḥ | kṛṣṇamanyaddharitaḥ saṃbharanti | adyā devā uditā sūryasya | niraṃhasaḥ pipṛtānniravadyāt | tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantām | aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
2.8.7.d: यदेदयुक्त हरितः सधस्थात् । आद्रात्री वासस्तनुते सिमस्मै । तन्मित्रस्य वरुणस्याभिचक्षे । सूर्यो रूपं कृणुते द्योरुपस्थे । अनन्तमन्यद्रुशदस्य पाजः । कृष्णमन्यद्धरितः संभरन्ति । अद्या देवा उदिता सूर्यस्य । निरंहसः पिपृतान्निरवद्यात् । तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्ताम् । अदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः
2.8.7.m: When he unyoked his tawny mares from their stand, / then Night spreads her garment over everyone. / That the sun displays for Mitra and Varuṇa to see, / his form in the lap of heaven; / one bright, radiant splendor of his is endless, / the other, dark, his tawny mares gather together. / Today, O gods, at the rising of the sun, / save us from distress, from blameworthiness! / May Mitra and Varuṇa grant that to us, / and Aditi, the Sindhu, Earth, and Heaven!

2.8.7.s: divo rukma urucakṣā udeti | dūrearthastaraṇirbhrājamānaḥ | nūnaṃ janāḥ sūryeṇa prasūtāḥ | āyannarthāni kṛṇavannapāṃsi | śaṃ no bhava cakṣasā śaṃ no ahnā | śaṃ bhānunā śaṃ himāśaṃ ghṛṇena | yathā śamasmai śamasadduroṇe | tathsūrya draviṇaṃ dhehi citram | citraṃ devānāmudagādanīkam | cakṣurmitrasya varuṇasyāgneḥ
2.8.7.d: दिवो रुक्म उरुचक्षा उदेति । दूरेअर्थस्तरणिर्भ्राजमानः । नूनं जनाः सूर्येण प्रसूताः । आयन्नर्थानि कृणवन्नपांसि । शं नो भव चक्षसा शं नो अह्ना । शं भानुना शं हिमाशं घृणेन । यथा शमस्मै शमसद्दुरोणे । तथ्सूर्य द्रविणं धेहि चित्रम् । चित्रं देवानामुदगादनीकम् । चक्षुर्मित्रस्य वरुणस्याग्नेः
2.8.7.m: The gold ornament of heaven, wide-seeing, rises, / far-aiming, swiftly crossing, shining bright. / Now mortals, impelled by the sun, / go about their aims and perform their works. / Be auspicious to us with your vision, auspicious with the day, / auspicious with your light, auspicious in cold, auspicious with your heat, / so that there may be peace for him, peace in the dwelling. / Grant that varied wealth, O sun! / The wondrous banner of the gods has arisen, / the eye of Mitra, of Varuṇa, of Agni.

2.8.7.s: āprā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣam | sūrya ātmā jagatastasthuṣaśca | tvaṣṭā dadhattannasturīpam | tvaṣṭā vīraṃ piśaṅgarūpaḥ | daśemaṃ tvaṣṭurjanayanta garbham | atandrāso yuvatayo bibhartram | tigmānīkagg svayaśasaṃjaneṣu | virocamānaṃ pariṣīṃ nayanti | āviṣṭyo vardhate cārurāsu | jihmānāmūrdhvaḥ svayaśā upasthe
2.8.7.d: आप्रा द्यावापृथिवी अन्तरिक्षम् । सूर्य आत्मा जगतस्तस्थुषश्च । त्वष्टा दधत्तन्नस्तुरीपम् । त्वष्टा वीरं पिशङ्गरूपः । दशेमं त्वष्टुर्जनयन्त गर्भम् । अतन्द्रासो युवतयो बिभर्त्रम् । तिग्मानीकग्ग् स्वयशसंजनेषु । विरोचमानं परिषीं नयन्ति । आविष्ट्यो वर्धते चारुरासु । जिह्मानामूर्ध्वः स्वयशा उपस्थे
2.8.7.m: It has filled heaven and earth and the intermediate space, / the sun, the self of what moves and stands still. / May Tvaṣṭṛ granting, that our turīpa, / Tvaṣṭṛ a hero, tawny-formed. / Ten unwearied maidens brought forth this embryo of Tvaṣṭṛ, / a foster-child; / sharp-faced, self-renowned among people, / shining brightly, they lead him round. / Becoming manifest, lovely among them, he grows, / standing erect, self-renowned, in the lap of the crooked [fire-sticks].

2.8.7.s: ubhe tvaṣṭurbibhyaturjāyamānāt | pratīcī siṃhaṃ pratijoṣayete | mitro janān prasamitra | ayaṃ mitro namasyaḥ suśevaḥ | rājā sukṣatro ajaniṣṭa vedhāḥ | tasya vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyasya | api bhadre saumanase syāma | anamīvāsa iḍayā madantaḥ | mitajmavo varimannā pṛthivyāḥ | ādityasya vratamupakṣyantaḥ
2.8.7.d: उभे त्वष्टुर्बिभ्यतुर्जायमानात् । प्रतीची सिंहं प्रतिजोषयेते । मित्रो जनान् प्रसमित्र । अयं मित्रो नमस्यः सुशेवः । राजा सुक्षत्रो अजनिष्ट वेधाः । तस्य वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियस्य । अपि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम । अनमीवास इडया मदन्तः । मितज्मवो वरिमन्ना पृथिव्याः । आदित्यस्य व्रतमुपक्ष्यन्तः
2.8.7.m: Both [worlds] feared Tvaṣṭṛ's [child] as he was being born; / facing him, they welcome the lion. / Mitra [arranges] the peoples; may that, O Mitra; / this Mitra is worthy of worship, very gracious, / the king with good regal power, the ordainer, has been born. / In the benevolence of that worshipful one, even in his auspicious favor may we be, / unailing, rejoicing with refreshing drink, / firm-footed on the expanse of the earth, / abiding by the ordinance of the Āditya.

2.8.7.s: vayaṃ mitrasya sumatau syāma | mitraṃ na īṃ śimyā goṣu gavyavat | svādhiyo vidathe apsvajījanan | arejayatāṃ rodasī pājasā girā | prati priyaṃ yajataṃ januṣāmavaḥ | mahāṃ ādityo namasopasadyaḥ | yātayajjano gṛṇate suśevaḥ | tasmā etatpanyatamāya juṣṭam | agnau mitrāya havirājuhota | ā vāṃ ratho rodasī badbadhānaḥ
2.8.7.d: वयं मित्रस्य सुमतौ स्याम । मित्रं न ईं शिम्या गोषु गव्यवत् । स्वाधियो विदथे अप्स्वजीजनन् । अरेजयतां रोदसी पाजसा गिरा । प्रति प्रियं यजतं जनुषामवः । महां आदित्यो नमसोपसद्यः । यातयज्जनो गृणते सुशेवः । तस्मा एतत्पन्यतमाय जुष्टम् । अग्नौ मित्राय हविराजुहोत । आ वां रथो रोदसी बद्बधानः
2.8.7.m: May we be in the benevolence of Mitra! / Mitra to us, with work, possessing cattle among cows, / the devout brought [him] forth in the sacred gathering, in the waters; / with his radiance, with praise, they made the two world-halves tremble; / toward the dear, worshipful help of the born. / The great Āditya is to be approached with reverence, / who sets peoples in order, very gracious to the singer; / for him, most praiseworthy, offer into the fire / an agreeable oblation to Mitra! / May your chariot, pressing on the two world-halves,

2.8.7.s: hiraṇyayo vṛṣabhiryātvaśvaiḥ | ghṛtavartaniḥ pavibhī rucānaḥ | iṣāṃ voḍhā nṛpatirvājinīvān | sa paprathāno abhi pañcabhūma | trivandhuro manasā''yātu yuktaḥ | viśo yena gacchatho devayantīḥ | kutrācidyāmamaśvinā dadhānā | svaśvā yaśasā''yātamarvāk | dasrā nidhiṃ madhumantaṃ pibāthaḥ | vi vāṃ ratho vadhvā yādamānaḥ
2.8.7.d: हिरण्ययो वृषभिर्यात्वश्वैः । घृतवर्तनिः पविभी रुचानः । इषां वोढा नृपतिर्वाजिनीवान् । स पप्रथानो अभि पञ्चभूम । त्रिवन्धुरो मनसा'ऽयातु युक्तः । विशो येन गच्छथो देवयन्तीः । कुत्राचिद्याममश्विना दधाना । स्वश्वा यशसा'ऽयातमर्वाक् । दस्रा निधिं मधुमन्तं पिबाथः । वि वां रथो वध्वा यादमानः
2.8.7.m: golden, come with bull-strong horses, / whose path is clarified butter, shining with rims, / bearer of refreshments, lord of men, rich in prize-horses; / spreading itself out, [it has encompassed] the five realms of earth. / May it come three-seated, yoked by thought, / by which you two go to the clans that seek the gods; / making your journey somewhere, O Aśvins, / with good horses, come hither with fame! / O wonder-workers, you shall drink the sweet store; / your chariot, parting [the darkness], accompanied by the bride,

2.8.7.s: antāndivo bādhate vartanibhyām | yuvoḥ śriyaṃ pari yoṣā vṛṇīta | sūro duhitā paritakmiyāyām | yaddevayantamavathaḥ śacībhiḥ | parighraṃ savāṃ manāvāṃ vayogām | yo ha sya vāṃ rathirā vasta usrāḥ | ratho yujānaḥ pariyāti vartiḥ | tena naḥ śaṃ yoruṣaso vyuṣṭau | nyaśvinā vahataṃ yajñe asmin | yuvaṃ bhujyumavaviddhaṃ samudre
2.8.7.d: अन्तान्दिवो बाधते वर्तनिभ्याम् । युवोः श्रियं परि योषा वृणीत । सूरो दुहिता परितक्मियायाम् । यद्देवयन्तमवथः शचीभिः । परिघ्रं सवां मनावां वयोगाम् । यो ह स्य वां रथिरा वस्त उस्राः । रथो युजानः परियाति वर्तिः । तेन नः शं योरुषसो व्युष्टौ । न्यश्विना वहतं यज्ञे अस्मिन् । युवं भुज्युमवविद्धं समुद्रे
2.8.7.m: presses upon the ends of heaven with its rims. / The maiden chose your beauty, / the sun's daughter, at the circling [contest]. / When you protect the godly man with your wondrous powers, / the burning heat is yours, your mind, your vigor, the cow; / who indeed is that charioteer of yours, the dawns clothe themselves [in light]; / the chariot, yoked, goes around the course. / By that, at the break of dawn, O Aśvins, / bring down into this sacrifice peace and well-being for us! / You two [saved] Bhujyu cast into the ocean;

2.8.7.s: udūhathurarṇaso asridhānaiḥ | patatribhiraśramairavyathibhiḥ | daṃsanābhiraśvinā pārayantā | agnīṣomā yo adya vām | idaṃ vacaḥ saparyati | tasmai dhattaṃ suvīryam | gavāṃ poṣaṃ svaśviyam | yo agnīṣomā haviṣā saparyāt | devadrīcā manasā yo ghṛtena | tasya vrataṃ rakṣataṃ pātamaṃhasaḥ
2.8.7.d: उदूहथुरर्णसो अस्रिधानैः । पतत्रिभिरश्रमैरव्यथिभिः । दंसनाभिरश्विना पारयन्ता । अग्नीषोमा यो अद्य वाम् । इदं वचः सपर्यति । तस्मै धत्तं सुवीर्यम् । गवां पोषं स्वश्वियम् । यो अग्नीषोमा हविषा सपर्यात् । देवद्रीचा मनसा यो घृतेन । तस्य व्रतं रक्षतं पातमंहसः
2.8.7.m: you brought him up from the surging wave with unfailing, / winged, unwearied, untroubled [steeds], / with wondrous deeds, O Aśvins, may they bring across! / O Agni and Soma, whoever today / serves this word to you two, / to him grant heroic power, / abundance of cows, good horsemen! / O Agni and Soma, whoever would serve with oblation, / with mind turned toward the gods, who [serves] with clarified butter, / protect his ordinance, protect [him] from distress!

2.8.7.s: viśe janāya mahi śarma yacchatam | agnīṣomā ya āhutim | yo vāṃ dāśāddhaviṣkṛtim | sa prajayā suvīryam | viśvamāyurvyaśnavat | agnīṣomā ceti tadvīryaṃ vām | yadamuṣṇītamavasaṃ paṇiṃ goḥ | avātirataṃ prathayasya śeṣaḥ | avindataṃ jyotirekaṃ bahubhyaḥ | agnīṣomāvimaṃ sume'gnīṣomā haviṣaḥ prasthitasya
2.8.7.d: विशे जनाय महि शर्म यच्छतम् । अग्नीषोमा य आहुतिम् । यो वां दाशाद्धविष्कृतिम् । स प्रजया सुवीर्यम् । विश्वमायुर्व्यश्नवत् । अग्नीषोमा चेति तद्वीर्यं वाम् । यदमुष्णीतमवसं पणिं गोः । अवातिरतं प्रथयस्य शेषः । अविन्दतं ज्योतिरेकं बहुभ्यः । अग्नीषोमाविमं सुमेऽग्नीषोमा हविषः प्रस्थितस्य
2.8.7.m: Grant great protection to the settlement, to the people! / O Agni and Soma, whoever [offers] an oblation, / whoever shall present the preparation of an oblation to you two, / he, through offspring, [shall attain] heroic power, / he shall enjoy his full lifespan. / O Agni and Soma, that heroic deed of yours was recognized, / that you robbed the Paṇi of his food, the cow; / you laid low the remainder of Prathaya; you found the one light for many. / O Agni and Soma, [listen] well to this of mine; O Agni and Soma, of the oblation set forth,

2.8.8.s: ahamasmi prathamajā ṛtasya | pūrvaṃ devebhyo amṛtasya nābhiḥ | yo mā dadāti sa ideva mā''vāḥ | ahamannamannamadantamadmi | pūrvamagnerapi dahatyannam | yattau hā''sāte ahamuttareṣu | vyāttamasya paśavaḥ sujambham | paśyanti dhīrāḥ pracaranti pākāḥ | jahāmyanyaṃ na jahāmyanyam | ahamannaṃ vaśamiccarāmi
2.8.8.d: अहमस्मि प्रथमजा ऋतस्य । पूर्वं देवेभ्यो अमृतस्य नाभिः । यो मा ददाति स इदेव मा'ऽवाः । अहमन्नमन्नमदन्तमद्मि । पूर्वमग्नेरपि दहत्यन्नम् । यत्तौ हा'ऽसाते अहमुत्तरेषु । व्यात्तमस्य पशवः सुजम्भम् । पश्यन्ति धीराः प्रचरन्ति पाकाः । जहाम्यन्यं न जहाम्यन्यम् । अहमन्नं वशमिच्चरामि
2.8.8.m: I am the first-born of truth, / prior to the gods, the navel of immortality. / He who gives me, he indeed has preserved me; / I, food, eat the eater of food. / Prior to fire, food also consumes. / Where those two sit, in the highest [heavens], / the animals see his open mouth, well-toothed; / the wise perceive [it], the simple-minded wander about. / I abandon the one, I do not abandon the other; / I, food, wander at will.

2.8.8.s: samānamarthaṃ paryemi bhuñjat | ko māmannaṃ manuṣyo dayeta | parāke annaṃ nihitaṃ loka etat | viśvairdevaiḥ pitṛbhirguptamannam | yadadyate lupyate yatparopyate | śatatamī sā tanūrme babhūva | mahāntau carū sakṛddugdhena paprau | divaṃ ca pṛśni pṛthivīṃ ca sākam | tathsaṃpibanto na minanti vedhasaḥ | naitadbhūyo bhavati no kanīyaḥ
2.8.8.d: समानमर्थं पर्येमि भुञ्जत् । को मामन्नं मनुष्यो दयेत । पराके अन्नं निहितं लोक एतत् । विश्वैर्देवैः पितृभिर्गुप्तमन्नम् । यदद्यते लुप्यते यत्परोप्यते । शततमी सा तनूर्मे बभूव । महान्तौ चरू सकृद्दुग्धेन पप्रौ । दिवं च पृश्नि पृथिवीं च साकम् । तथ्संपिबन्तो न मिनन्ति वेधसः । नैतद्भूयो भवति नो कनीयः
2.8.8.m: To a common purpose I go around, consuming; / what mortal would have mercy on me, the food? / Placed in the far distance, in this world, / is food, guarded by all the gods, by the ancestors. / That which is eaten, that which is torn away, that which is cast aside— / that has become my hundredth body. / The two great vessels were filled with a single milking, / heaven and the dappled earth together; / drinking it fully, the wise ordainers do not diminish it; / it neither becomes greater nor less.

2.8.8.s: annaṃ prāṇamannamapānamāhuḥ | annaṃ mṛtyuṃ tamu jīvātumāhuḥ | annaṃ brahmāṇo jarasaṃ vadanti | annamāhuḥ prajananaṃ prajānām | moghamannaṃ vindate apracetāḥ | satyaṃ bravīmi vadha ithsa tasya | nāryamaṇaṃ puṣyati no sakhāyam | kevalāgho bhavati kevalādī | ahaṃ meghaḥ stanayanvarṣannasmi | māmadantyahamadmyanyān
2.8.8.d: अन्नं प्राणमन्नमपानमाहुः । अन्नं मृत्युं तमु जीवातुमाहुः । अन्नं ब्रह्माणो जरसं वदन्ति । अन्नमाहुः प्रजननं प्रजानाम् । मोघमन्नं विन्दते अप्रचेताः । सत्यं ब्रवीमि वध इथ्स तस्य । नार्यमणं पुष्यति नो सखायम् । केवलाघो भवति केवलादी । अहं मेघः स्तनयन्वर्षन्नस्मि । मामदन्त्यहमद्म्यन्यान्
2.8.8.m: They call food exhalation, food inhalation; / food they call death, and that same [food] they call life; / food the Brahmins call old age; / food they call the generative power of offspring. / In vain does the unthinking man obtain food; / I speak the truth: it is indeed his death; / he nourishes neither Aryaman nor a comrade; / eating alone, he becomes purely guilty. / I am the cloud, thundering, raining; / me they eat, I eat the others.

2.8.8.s: ahaṃ sadamṛto bhavāmi | madādityā adhi sarve tapanti | devīṃ vācamajanayanta yadvāgvadantī | anantāmantādadhinirmitāṃ mahīm | yasyāṃ devā adadhurbhojanāni | ekākṣarāṃ dvipadāṃ ṣaṭpadāṃ ca | vācaṃ devā upajīvanti viśve | vācaṃ devā upajīvanti viśve | vācaṃ gandharvāḥ paśavo manuṣyāḥ | vācīmā viśvā bhuvanānyarpitā
2.8.8.d: अहं सदमृतो भवामि । मदादित्या अधि सर्वे तपन्ति । देवीं वाचमजनयन्त यद्वाग्वदन्ती । अनन्तामन्तादधिनिर्मितां महीम् । यस्यां देवा अदधुर्भोजनानि । एकाक्षरां द्विपदां षट्पदां च । वाचं देवा उपजीवन्ति विश्वे । वाचं देवा उपजीवन्ति विश्वे । वाचं गन्धर्वाः पशवो मनुष्याः । वाचीमा विश्वा भुवनान्यर्पिता
2.8.8.m: I, being [truth], become immortal; / through me all the Ādityas shine with heat. / The gods brought forth divine speech—what speech they speak— / infinite, fashioned great from the end, / in which the gods placed refreshments; / of one syllable, of two feet, and of six feet. / All the gods live upon speech; / all the gods live upon speech; / gandharvas, domestic animals, and mortals [live upon] speech; / in speech are set all these beings.

2.8.8.s: sā no havaṃ juṣatāmindrapatnī | vāgakṣaraṃ prathamajā ṛtasya | vedānāṃ mātā'mṛtasya nābhiḥ | sā no juṣāṇopayajñamāgāt | avantī devī suhavā me astu | yāmṛṣayo mantrakṛto manīṣiṇaḥ | anvaicchandevāstapasā śrameṇa | tāṃ devīṃ vācaṃ haviṣā yajāmahe | sā no dadhātu sukṛtasya loke | catvāri vākparimitā padāni
2.8.8.d: सा नो हवं जुषतामिन्द्रपत्नी । वागक्षरं प्रथमजा ऋतस्य । वेदानां माताऽमृतस्य नाभिः । सा नो जुषाणोपयज्ञमागात् । अवन्ती देवी सुहवा मे अस्तु । यामृषयो मन्त्रकृतो मनीषिणः । अन्वैच्छन्देवास्तपसा श्रमेण । तां देवीं वाचं हविषा यजामहे । सा नो दधातु सुकृतस्य लोके । चत्वारि वाक्परिमिता पदानि
2.8.8.m: May she, the wife of Indra, favor our invocation: / speech, the imperishable syllable, first-born of truth, / mother of the Vedas, navel of immortality! / May she, delighting [in us], come to the sacrifice; / may the goddess, easily invoked, be my protector! / Whom the seers, the mantra-makers, the wise ones, / sought out, [whom] the gods [sought] by ascetic toil, by effort; / that divine speech we worship with oblation; / may she place us in the world of the well-done! / Speech is measured out in four steps.

2.8.8.s: tāni vidurbrāhmaṇā ye manīṣiṇaḥ | guhā trīṇi nihitā neṅgayanti | turīyaṃ vāco manuṣyā vadanti | śraddhayā'gniḥ samidhyate | śraddhayā vindate haviḥ | śraddhāṃ bhagasya mūrdhani | vacasā''vedayāmasi | priyaṃ śraddhe dadataḥ | priyaṃ śraddhe didāsataḥ | priyaṃ bhojeṣu yajvasu
2.8.8.d: तानि विदुर्ब्राह्मणा ये मनीषिणः । गुहा त्रीणि निहिता नेङ्गयन्ति । तुरीयं वाचो मनुष्या वदन्ति । श्रद्धयाऽग्निः समिध्यते । श्रद्धया विन्दते हविः । श्रद्धां भगस्य मूर्धनि । वचसा'ऽवेदयामसि । प्रियं श्रद्धे ददतः । प्रियं श्रद्धे दिदासतः । प्रियं भोजेषु यज्वसु
2.8.8.m: Those the Brahmins who are wise know; / three, placed in secret, they do not stir; / the fourth [part] of speech humans speak. / By faith Agni is kindled, / by faith the oblation is obtained. / Faith upon the head of Bhaga / we proclaim with our speech. / Dear, O Faith, to the giver, / dear, O Faith, to one who desires to give, / dear to the generous sacrificers—

2.8.8.s: idaṃ ma uditaṃ kṛdhi | yathā devā asureṣu | śraddhāmugreṣu cakrire | evaṃ bhojeṣu yajvasu | asmākamuditaṃ kṛdhi | śraddhāṃ devā yajamānāḥ | vāyugopā upāsate | śraddhāṃ hṛdayyayā''kūtyā | śraddhayā hūyate haviḥ | śraddhāṃ prātarhavāmahe
2.8.8.d: इदं म उदितं कृधि । यथा देवा असुरेषु । श्रद्धामुग्रेषु चक्रिरे । एवं भोजेषु यज्वसु । अस्माकमुदितं कृधि । श्रद्धां देवा यजमानाः । वायुगोपा उपासते । श्रद्धां हृदय्यया'ऽकूत्या । श्रद्धया हूयते हविः । श्रद्धां प्रातर्हवामहे
2.8.8.m: Make this [wish] of mine fulfilled! / Just as the gods placed faith / in the fierce asuras, / so among the generous sacrificers / make our [wish] fulfilled! / The gods who sacrifice, guarded by Vāyu, / revere Faith. / Faith with the intention of the heart, / with faith the oblation is poured. / Faith we invoke in the morning,

2.8.8.s: śraddhāṃ madhyaṃdinaṃ pari | śraddhāṃ sūryasya nimruci | śraddhe śraddhāpayeha mā | śraddhā devānadhivaste | śraddhā viśvamidaṃ jagat | śraddhāṃ kāmasya mātaram | haviṣā vardhayāmasi | brahma jajñānaṃ prathamaṃ purastāt | vi sīmataḥ suruco vena āvaḥ | sa budhniyā upamā asya viṣṭhāḥ
2.8.8.d: श्रद्धां मध्यंदिनं परि । श्रद्धां सूर्यस्य निम्रुचि । श्रद्धे श्रद्धापयेह मा । श्रद्धा देवानधिवस्ते । श्रद्धा विश्वमिदं जगत् । श्रद्धां कामस्य मातरम् । हविषा वर्धयामसि । ब्रह्म जज्ञानं प्रथमं पुरस्तात् । वि सीमतः सुरुचो वेन आवः । स बुध्निया उपमा अस्य विष्ठाः
2.8.8.m: Faith around midday, / Faith at the setting of the sun. / O Faith, inspire faith in me here! / Faith encompasses the gods, / Faith this whole world. / Faith, the mother of desire, / we magnify with an oblation. / The brahman born first in the east / the seer unclosed from the shining boundary; / he [unclosed] its lowest and highest stations,

2.8.8.s: sataśca yonimasataśca vivaḥ | pitā virājāmṛṣabho rayīṇām | antarikṣaṃ viśvarūpa āviveśa | tamarkairabhyarcanti vathsam | brahma santaṃ brahmaṇā vardhayantaḥ | brahma devānajanayat | brahma viśvamidaṃ jagat | brahmaṇaḥ kṣatraṃ nirmitam | brahma brāhmaṇa ātmanā | antarasminnime lokāḥ
2.8.8.d: सतश्च योनिमसतश्च विवः । पिता विराजामृषभो रयीणाम् । अन्तरिक्षं विश्वरूप आविवेश । तमर्कैरभ्यर्चन्ति वथ्सम् । ब्रह्म सन्तं ब्रह्मणा वर्धयन्तः । ब्रह्म देवानजनयत् । ब्रह्म विश्वमिदं जगत् । ब्रह्मणः क्षत्रं निर्मितम् । ब्रह्म ब्राह्मण आत्मना । अन्तरस्मिन्निमे लोकाः
2.8.8.m: and unclosed the womb of the existent and the nonexistent. / The father of luminous bodies, the bull of riches, / omniform entered the intermediate space. / They revere that calf with praises, / magnifying him who is brahman with brahman. / Brahman generated the gods; / brahman [generated] this whole world; / from brahman regal power was fashioned; / brahman is the Brahmin by himself; / within it are these worlds;

2.8.8.s: antarviśvamidaṃ jagat | brahmaiva bhūtānāṃ jyeṣṭham | tena ko'rhati spardhitum | brahmandevāstrayastriṃśat | brahmannindraprajāpatī | brahman ha viśvā bhūtāni | nāvīvāntaḥ samāhitā | catasra āśāḥ pracarantvagnayaḥ | imaṃ no yajñaṃ nayatu prajānan | ghṛtaṃ pinvannajaraṃ suvīram
2.8.8.d: अन्तर्विश्वमिदं जगत् । ब्रह्मैव भूतानां ज्येष्ठम् । तेन कोऽर्हति स्पर्धितुम् । ब्रह्मन्देवास्त्रयस्त्रिंशत् । ब्रह्मन्निन्द्रप्रजापती । ब्रह्मन् ह विश्वा भूतानि । नावीवान्तः समाहिता । चतस्र आशाः प्रचरन्त्वग्नयः । इमं नो यज्ञं नयतु प्रजानन् । घृतं पिन्वन्नजरं सुवीरम्
2.8.8.m: within it is this whole world; / brahman alone is the eldest of beings; / who is able to contend with it? / In brahman are the thirty-three gods; / in brahman are Indra and Prajāpati; / in brahman indeed all beings / are held together as within a ship. / Let the four fires proceed to the quarters; / knowing [the way], let him lead this sacrifice of ours, / swelling with ghee, unaging, rich in heroes.

2.8.8.s: brahma samidbhavatyāhutīnām | ā gāvo agmannuta bhadramakran | sīdantu goṣṭhe raṇayantvasme | prajāvatīḥ pururūpā iha syuḥ | indrāya pūrvīruṣaso duhānāḥ | indro yajvane pṛṇate ca śikṣati | upeddadāti na svaṃ muṣāyati | bhūyo bhūyo rayimidasya vardhayan | abhinne khille nidadhāti devayum | na tānaśanti na tā arvā
2.8.8.d: ब्रह्म समिद्भवत्याहुतीनाम् । आ गावो अग्मन्नुत भद्रमक्रन् । सीदन्तु गोष्ठे रणयन्त्वस्मे । प्रजावतीः पुरुरूपा इह स्युः । इन्द्राय पूर्वीरुषसो दुहानाः । इन्द्रो यज्वने पृणते च शिक्षति । उपेद्ददाति न स्वं मुषायति । भूयो भूयो रयिमिदस्य वर्धयन् । अभिन्ने खिल्ले निदधाति देवयुम् । न तानशन्ति न ता अर्वा
2.8.8.m: Brahman becomes the kindling-stick of the oblations. / The cows have come and have brought good fortune; / let them settle in the pen and delight in us; / rich in offspring, of many forms let them be here, / milking many dawns for Indra. / Indra assists the sacrificer and the one who offers; / he gives [to him], he does not steal what is his own; / increasing more and more his wealth, / he places the god-fearing man in unbroken pasture. / They do not perish; no courser [harms] them;

2.8.8.s: gāvo bhago gāva indro me acchāt | gāvaḥ somasya prathamasya bhakṣaḥ | imā yā gāvaḥ sa janāsa indraḥ | icchāmīddhṛdā manasā cidindram | yūyaṃ gāvo medayathā kṛśaṃ cit | aślīlaṃ citkṛṇuthā supratīkam | bhadraṃ gṛhaṃ kṛṇutha bhadravācaḥ | bṛhadvo vaya ucyate sabhāsu | prajāvatīḥ sūyavasaṃ riśantīḥ | śuddhā apaḥ suprapāṇe pibantīḥ | mā vaḥ stena īśata mā'ghaśaṃsaḥ | pari vo hetī rudrasya vṛñjyāt | upedamupa parcanam | āsu goṣūpapṛcyatām | uparṣabhasya retasi | upendra tava vīrye
2.8.8.d: गावो भगो गाव इन्द्रो मे अच्छात् । गावः सोमस्य प्रथमस्य भक्षः । इमा या गावः स जनास इन्द्रः । इच्छामीद्धृदा मनसा चिदिन्द्रम् । यूयं गावो मेदयथा कृशं चित् । अश्लीलं चित्कृणुथा सुप्रतीकम् । भद्रं गृहं कृणुथ भद्रवाचः । बृहद्वो वय उच्यते सभासु । प्रजावतीः सूयवसं रिशन्तीः । शुद्धा अपः सुप्रपाणे पिबन्तीः । मा वः स्तेन ईशत माऽघशंसः । परि वो हेती रुद्रस्य वृञ्ज्यात् । उपेदमुप पर्चनम् । आसु गोषूपपृच्यताम् । उपर्षभस्य रेतसि । उपेन्द्र तव वीर्ये
2.8.8.m: the cows are Bhaga, the cows are Indra to me, / the cows are the portion of the first soma; / these cows are Indra, O people! / With heart and mind I seek Indra. / You, O cows, make even the lean fat; / you make even the uncomely handsome; / you make the house auspicious, O auspicious-voiced ones; / exalted is your renown declared in assemblies. / Rich in offspring, grazing on good pasture, / drinking pure waters at a good drinking-place, / let no thief master you, nor evil-speaker; / let Rudra's weapon pass you by. / This contact, / let it be joined to these cows, / to the semen of the bull, / to your heroic power, O Indra.

2.8.9.s: tā sūryācandramasā viśvabhṛttamā mahat | tejo vasumadrājato divi | sāmātmānā carataḥ sāmacāriṇā | yayorvrataṃ na mame jātu devayoḥ | ubhāvantau pariyāta armyā | divo na raśmīṃstanuto vyarṇave | ubhā bhuvantī bhuvanā kavikratū | sūryā na candrā carato hatāmatī | patī dyumadviśvavidā ubhā divaḥ | sūryā ubhā candramasā vicakṣaṇā
2.8.9.d: ता सूर्याचन्द्रमसा विश्वभृत्तमा महत् । तेजो वसुमद्राजतो दिवि । सामात्माना चरतः सामचारिणा । ययोर्व्रतं न ममे जातु देवयोः । उभावन्तौ परियात अर्म्या । दिवो न रश्मींस्तनुतो व्यर्णवे । उभा भुवन्ती भुवना कविक्रतू । सूर्या न चन्द्रा चरतो हतामती । पती द्युमद्विश्वविदा उभा दिवः । सूर्या उभा चन्द्रमसा विचक्षणा
2.8.9.m: Those two, sun and moon, sustaining all, great, / radiant with treasure, rule in heaven; / their essence is the Sāman, moving in harmony, / the course of which two gods has never been measured. / The two travel around both borders [of the sky]; / they spread out their rays like [rays] of heaven in the ocean; / both discerning beings, having poetic vision, / sun and moon travel, minds intent; / both lords of heaven, luminous, all-knowing, / both sun and moon, far-seeing,

2.8.9.s: viśvavārā varivobhā vareṇyā | tā no'vataṃ matimantā mahivratā | viśvavaparī prataraṇā tarantā | suvarvidā dṛśaye bhūriraśmī | sūryā hi candrā vasu tveṣa darśatā | manasvinobhā'nucarato nu saṃ divam | asya śravo nadyaḥ sapta bibhrati | dyāvā kṣāmā pṛthivī darśataṃ vapuḥ | asme sūryācandramasā'bhicakṣe | śraddhe kamindra carato vicarturam
2.8.9.d: विश्ववारा वरिवोभा वरेण्या । ता नोऽवतं मतिमन्ता महिव्रता । विश्ववपरी प्रतरणा तरन्ता । सुवर्विदा दृशये भूरिरश्मी । सूर्या हि चन्द्रा वसु त्वेष दर्शता । मनस्विनोभाऽनुचरतो नु सं दिवम् । अस्य श्रवो नद्यः सप्त बिभ्रति । द्यावा क्षामा पृथिवी दर्शतं वपुः । अस्मे सूर्याचन्द्रमसाऽभिचक्षे । श्रद्धे कमिन्द्र चरतो विचर्तुरम्
2.8.9.m: all-desirable, wide-ruling, both choice; / may those two wise ones of great vows protect us! / All-nourishing, transporting across, conquering, / finding heaven, of many rays for seeing, / sun and moon, bright treasures, wondrous to behold, / both thoughtful ones now traverse the sky together. / Seven rivers carry his fame; / heaven and earth [bear] the wondrous form. / For us to behold the sun and the moon, / for faith, O Indra, they travel eagerly.

2.8.9.s: pūrvāparaṃ carato māyayaitau | śiśū krīḍantau pariyāto adhvaram | viśvānyanyo bhuvanā'bhicaṣṭe | ṛtūnanyo vidadhajjāyate punaḥ | hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā yāsāṃ rājā | yāsāṃ devāḥ śivena mā cakṣuṣā paśyata | āpo bhadrā āditpaśyāmi | nāsadāsīnno sadāsīttadānīm | nāsīdrajo no vyomāparo yat | kimāvarīvaḥ kuha kasya śarman
2.8.9.d: पूर्वापरं चरतो माययैतौ । शिशू क्रीडन्तौ परियातो अध्वरम् । विश्वान्यन्यो भुवनाऽभिचष्टे । ऋतूनन्यो विदधज्जायते पुनः । हिरण्यवर्णाः शुचयः पावका यासां राजा । यासां देवाः शिवेन मा चक्षुषा पश्यत । आपो भद्रा आदित्पश्यामि । नासदासीन्नो सदासीत्तदानीम् । नासीद्रजो नो व्योमापरो यत् । किमावरीवः कुह कस्य शर्मन्
2.8.9.m: These two travel from east to west by magic craft; / two children playing, they go round the sacrificial rite. / The one surveys all beings; / the other, arranging the seasons, is born anew. / Golden-colored, pure, purifying, whose king [is Varuṇa] / whose gods [are …], look on me with an auspicious eye, / waters are auspicious, then indeed I see, / There was neither nonexistence nor existence then; / there was neither the realm of space nor the sky beyond. / What covered [it]? Where? In whose protection?

2.8.9.s: ambhaḥ kimāsīdgahanaṃ gabhīram | na mṛtyuramṛtaṃ tarhi na | rātriyā ahna āsītpraketaḥ | ānīdavātaṃ svadhayā tadekam | tasmāddhānyaṃ na paraḥ kiṃca nāsa | tama āsīttamasā gūḍhamagre praketam | salilaṃ sarvamā idam | tucchenābhvapihitaṃ yadāsīt | tamasastanmahinā jāyataikam | kāmastadagre samavartatādhi
2.8.9.d: अम्भः किमासीद्गहनं गभीरम् । न मृत्युरमृतं तर्हि न । रात्रिया अह्न आसीत्प्रकेतः । आनीदवातं स्वधया तदेकम् । तस्माद्धान्यं न परः किंच नास । तम आसीत्तमसा गूढमग्रे प्रकेतम् । सलिलं सर्वमा इदम् । तुच्छेनाभ्वपिहितं यदासीत् । तमसस्तन्महिना जायतैकम् । कामस्तदग्रे समवर्तताधि
2.8.9.m: Was there water, unfathomable and deep? / There was neither death nor immortality then; / there was no sign of night nor of day. / That One breathed, breathless, by its own impulse; / other than that there was nothing whatever beyond. / Darkness there was, hidden by darkness in the beginning; / all this was an unillumined flood. / What existed was enveloped by the void; / that One arose through the power of heat. / Desire arose in the beginning upon that,

2.8.9.s: manaso retaḥ prathamaṃ yadāsīt | sato bandhumasati niravindan | hṛdi pratīṣyā kavayo manīṣā | tiraścīno vitato raśmireṣām | adhaḥ svidāsīdupari svidāsīt | retodhā āsanmahimāna āsan | svadhā avastātprayatiḥ parastāt | ko addhā veda ka iha pravocat | kuta ājātā kuta iyaṃ visṛṣṭiḥ | arvāgdevā asya visarjanāya
2.8.9.d: मनसो रेतः प्रथमं यदासीत् । सतो बन्धुमसति निरविन्दन् । हृदि प्रतीष्या कवयो मनीषा । तिरश्चीनो विततो रश्मिरेषाम् । अधः स्विदासीदुपरि स्विदासीत् । रेतोधा आसन्महिमान आसन् । स्वधा अवस्तात्प्रयतिः परस्तात् । को अद्धा वेद क इह प्रवोचत् । कुत आजाता कुत इयं विसृष्टिः । अर्वाग्देवा अस्य विसर्जनाय
2.8.9.m: which was the first seed of the mind. / Sages, searching in the heart with intellect, / found the bond of the existent in the nonexistent. / Their cord was stretched across: / was there a below, was there an above? / There were seed-placers, there were powers; / impulse was below, offering was above. / Who really knows? Who will proclaim here, / whence it was born, whence this manifold creation? / The gods are on this side of its creation;

2.8.9.s: athā ko veda yata ā babhūva | iyaṃ visṛṣṭiryata ābabhūva | yadi vā dadhe yadi vā na | yo asyādhyakṣaḥ parame vyoman | so aṅga veda yadi vā na veda | kiṃsvidvanaṃ ka u sa vṛkṣa āsīt | yato dyāvāpṛthivī niṣṭatakṣuḥ | manīṣiṇo manasā pṛcchatedu tat | yadadhyatiṣṭhadbhuvanāni dhārayan | brahma vanaṃ brahma sa vṛkṣa āsīt
2.8.9.d: अथा को वेद यत आ बभूव । इयं विसृष्टिर्यत आबभूव । यदि वा दधे यदि वा न । यो अस्याध्यक्षः परमे व्योमन् । सो अङ्ग वेद यदि वा न वेद । किंस्विद्वनं क उ स वृक्ष आसीत् । यतो द्यावापृथिवी निष्टतक्षुः । मनीषिणो मनसा पृच्छतेदु तत् । यदध्यतिष्ठद्भुवनानि धारयन् । ब्रह्म वनं ब्रह्म स वृक्ष आसीत्
2.8.9.m:
then who knows whence it came into being? / Whence this manifold creation came into being, / whether it fashioned [itself] or whether not, / he who is its overseer in highest heaven, / he indeed knows, or if he does not know. / What was the forest, and what was the tree, / from which they carved out heaven and earth? / Wise men, ask with your mind that very thing, / whereon he stood while supporting the worlds: / brahman was the forest, brahman was that tree.

From which they fashioned heaven and earth.
Wise men, with mind I declare [it] to you:
Brahman stood over them, sustaining the worlds.
In the morning we invoke Agni, in the morning Indra,
in the morning Mitra and Varuṇa, in the morning the two Aśvins,
in the morning Bhaga, Pūṣan, Brahmaṇaspati;
in the morning may we invoke Soma and Rudra.
In the morning we invoke the victorious, mighty Bhaga,
the son of Aditi, who is the sustainer,
upon whom the wretched, thinking [of him], and the swift [call],

2.8.9.s: yato dyāvāpṛthivī niṣṭatakṣuḥ | manīṣiṇo manasā vibravīmi vaḥ | brahmādhyatiṣṭhadbhuvanāni dhārayan | prātaragniṃ prātarindraṃ havāmahe | prātarmitrāvaruṇā prātaraśvinā | prātarbhagaṃ pūṣaṇaṃ brahmaṇaspatim | prātaḥ somamuta rudraṃ huvema | prātarjitaṃ bhagamugraṃ huvema | vayaṃ putramaditeryo vidhartā | ādhraścidyaṃ manyamānasturaścit
2.8.9.d: यतो द्यावापृथिवी निष्टतक्षुः । मनीषिणो मनसा विब्रवीमि वः । ब्रह्माध्यतिष्ठद्भुवनानि धारयन् । प्रातरग्निं प्रातरिन्द्रं हवामहे । प्रातर्मित्रावरुणा प्रातरश्विना । प्रातर्भगं पूषणं ब्रह्मणस्पतिम् । प्रातः सोममुत रुद्रं हुवेम । प्रातर्जितं भगमुग्रं हुवेम । वयं पुत्रमदितेर्यो विधर्ता । आध्रश्चिद्यं मन्यमानस्तुरश्चित्

2.8.9.s: rājācidyaṃ bhagaṃ bhakṣītyāha | bhaga praṇetarbhaga satyarādhaḥ | bhagemāṃ dhiyamudava dadannaḥ | bhaga pra ṇo janaya gobhiraśvaiḥ | bhaga pra nṛbhirnṛvantaḥ syāma | utedānīṃ bhagavantaḥ syāma | uta prapitva uta madhye ahnām | utoditā maghavanthsūryasya | vayaṃ devānāṃ sumatau syāma | bhaga eva bhagavāṃ astu devāḥ
2.8.9.d: राजाचिद्यं भगं भक्षीत्याह । भग प्रणेतर्भग सत्यराधः । भगेमां धियमुदव ददन्नः । भग प्र णो जनय गोभिरश्वैः । भग प्र नृभिर्नृवन्तः स्याम । उतेदानीं भगवन्तः स्याम । उत प्रपित्व उत मध्ये अह्नाम् । उतोदिता मघवन्थ्सूर्यस्य । वयं देवानां सुमतौ स्याम । भग एव भगवां अस्तु देवाः
2.8.9.m:
upon whom the king says, 'May I enjoy Bhaga!'
O Bhaga, leader! O Bhaga of true gifts!
O Bhaga, promote this inspired thought, giving to us!
O Bhaga, generate us forth with cattle, with horses!
O Bhaga, with men may we be rich in men!
And may we now be fortunate,
and at the early morning, and in the middle of the days,
and at the rising of the sun, O bounteous one!
May we be in the goodwill of the gods!
May Bhaga indeed be fortunate, O gods!

2.8.9.s: tena vayaṃ bhagavantaḥ syāma | taṃ tvā bhaga sarva ijjohavīmi | sa no bhaga pura etā bhaveha | samadhvarāyoṣaso namanta | dadhikrāveva śucaye padāya | arvācīnaṃ vasuvidaṃ bhagaṃ naḥ | rathamivāśvā vājina āvahantu | aśvāvatīrgomatīrna uṣāsaḥ | vīravatīḥ sadamucchantu bhadrāḥ | ghṛtaṃ duhānā viśvataḥ prapīnāḥ | yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
2.8.9.d: तेन वयं भगवन्तः स्याम । तं त्वा भग सर्व इज्जोहवीमि । स नो भग पुर एता भवेह । समध्वरायोषसो नमन्त । दधिक्रावेव शुचये पदाय । अर्वाचीनं वसुविदं भगं नः । रथमिवाश्वा वाजिन आवहन्तु । अश्वावतीर्गोमतीर्न उषासः । वीरवतीः सदमुच्छन्तु भद्राः । घृतं दुहाना विश्वतः प्रपीनाः । यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः
2.8.9.m:
Through him may we be fortunate!
As such, O Bhaga, do I invoke you entirely.
As such, O Bhaga, be our forerunner here!
May the dawns bow down toward the sacrificial rite,
like Dadhikrāvan toward the bright place!
May the swift horses bring here to us
Bhaga, turned toward us, who finds wealth, like a chariot!
Rich in horses, rich in cattle, rich in heroes,
may the auspicious dawns ever shine upon us,
yielding ghee, overflowing from every side!
Do you always protect us with blessings!

3.1.1.s: agnirnaḥ pātu kṛttikāḥ | nakṣatraṃ devamindriyam | idamāsāṃ vicakṣaṇam | havirāsaṃ juhotana | yasya bhānti raśmayo yasya ketavaḥ | yasyemā viśvā bhuvanāni sarvā | sa kṛttikābhirabhi saṃvasānaḥ | agnirno devaḥ suvite dadhātu | prajāpate rohiṇī vetu patnī | viśvarūpā bṛhatī citrabhānuḥ
3.1.1.d: अग्निर्नः पातु कृत्तिकाः । नक्षत्रं देवमिन्द्रियम् । इदमासां विचक्षणम् । हविरासं जुहोतन । यस्य भान्ति रश्मयो यस्य केतवः । यस्येमा विश्वा भुवनानि सर्वा । स कृत्तिकाभिरभि संवसानः । अग्निर्नो देवः सुविते दधातु । प्रजापते रोहिणी वेतु पत्नी । विश्वरूपा बृहती चित्रभानुः
3.1.1.m:
May Agni protect our Kṛttikās,
the divine, potent lunar mansion.
This is their looking-place;
offer an oblation into their mouth!
Whose rays shine, whose banners [shine],
whose are all these worlds—
he, dwelling together with the Kṛttikās,
may Agni, the god, place us in prosperity!
May Rohiṇī, the wife of Prajāpati, approach,
all-formed, lofty, of variegated brightness!

3.1.1.s: sā no yajñasya suvite dadhātu | yathā jīvema śaradaḥ savīrāḥ | rohiṇī devyudagātpurastāt | viśvā rūpāṇi pratimodamānā | prajāpatiṃ haviṣā vardhayantī | priyā devānāmupayātu yajñam | somo rājā mṛgaśīrṣeṇa āgan | śivaṃ nakṣatraṃ priyamasya dhāma | āpyāyamāno bahudhā janeṣu | retaḥ prajāṃ yajamāne dadhātu
3.1.1.d: सा नो यज्ञस्य सुविते दधातु । यथा जीवेम शरदः सवीराः । रोहिणी देव्युदगात्पुरस्तात् । विश्वा रूपाणि प्रतिमोदमाना । प्रजापतिं हविषा वर्धयन्ती । प्रिया देवानामुपयातु यज्ञम् । सोमो राजा मृगशीर्षेण आगन् । शिवं नक्षत्रं प्रियमस्य धाम । आप्यायमानो बहुधा जनेषु । रेतः प्रजां यजमाने दधातु
3.1.1.m:
May she place us in the prosperity of the sacrifice,
so that we may live autumns accompanied by heroes!
Rohiṇī, the goddess, has risen in the east,
rejoicing over all forms,
strengthening Prajāpati with the oblation;
dear to the gods, may she come to the sacrifice!
King Soma has come with Mṛgaśīrṣa,
the auspicious lunar mansion, his dear abode;
swelling abundantly among the peoples,
may he place semen [and] offspring in the sacrificer!

3.1.1.s: yatte nakṣatraṃ mṛgaśīrṣamasti | priyaṃ rājanpriyatamaṃ priyāṇām | tasmai te soma haviṣā vidhema | śaṃ na edhi dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade | ārdrayā rudraḥ prathamāna eti | śreṣṭho devānāṃ patiraghniyānām | nakṣatramasya haviṣā vidhema | mā naḥ prajāṃ rīriṣanmota vīrān | hetī rudrasya pari ṇo vṛṇaktu | ārdrā nakṣatraṃ juṣatāṃ havirnaḥ
3.1.1.d: यत्ते नक्षत्रं मृगशीर्षमस्ति । प्रियं राजन्प्रियतमं प्रियाणाम् । तस्मै ते सोम हविषा विधेम । शं न एधि द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे । आर्द्रया रुद्रः प्रथमान एति । श्रेष्ठो देवानां पतिरघ्नियानाम् । नक्षत्रमस्य हविषा विधेम । मा नः प्रजां रीरिषन्मोत वीरान् । हेती रुद्रस्य परि णो वृणक्तु । आर्द्रा नक्षत्रं जुषतां हविर्नः

3.1.1.s: pramuñcamānau duritāni viśvā | apāghaśaṃsaṃ nudatāmarātim | punarno devyaditiḥ spṛṇotu | punarvasū naḥ punaretāṃ yajñam | punarno devā abhiyantu sarve | punaḥ punarvo haviṣā yajāmaḥ | evā na devyaditiranarvā | viśvasya bhartrī jagataḥ pratiṣṭhā | punarvasū haviṣā vardhayantī | priyaṃ devānāmapyetu pāthaḥ
3.1.1.d: प्रमुञ्चमानौ दुरितानि विश्वा । अपाघशंसं नुदतामरातिम् । पुनर्नो देव्यदितिः स्पृणोतु । पुनर्वसू नः पुनरेतां यज्ञम् । पुनर्नो देवा अभियन्तु सर्वे । पुनः पुनर्वो हविषा यजामः । एवा न देव्यदितिरनर्वा । विश्वस्य भर्त्री जगतः प्रतिष्ठा । पुनर्वसू हविषा वर्धयन्ती । प्रियं देवानामप्येतु पाथः
3.1.1.m:
Releasing [us] from all distresses,
may the two thrust away the speaker of evil, the enemy!
May the goddess Aditi rescue us again;
may the two Punarvasus come again to our sacrifice!
May all the gods turn again toward us;
again and again we worship you with an oblation!
Even so, may the unobstructed goddess Aditi,
the supporter of all, the foundation of the world,
strengthening the two Punarvasus with an oblation,
approach the dear dwelling of the gods!

3.1.1.s: bṛhaspatiḥ prathamaṃ jāyamānaḥ | tiṣyaṃ nakṣatramabhi saṃbabhūva | śreṣṭho devānāṃ pṛtanāsu jiṣṇuḥ | diśo nu sarvā abhayaṃ no astu | tiṣyaḥ purastāduta madhyato naḥ | bṛhaspatirnaḥ paripātu paścāt | bādhetāṃ dveṣo abhayaṃ kṛṇutām | suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma | idaṃ sarpebhyo havirastu juṣṭam | āśreṣā yeṣāmanuyanti cetaḥ
3.1.1.d: बृहस्पतिः प्रथमं जायमानः । तिष्यं नक्षत्रमभि संबभूव । श्रेष्ठो देवानां पृतनासु जिष्णुः । दिशो नु सर्वा अभयं नो अस्तु । तिष्यः पुरस्तादुत मध्यतो नः । बृहस्पतिर्नः परिपातु पश्चात् । बाधेतां द्वेषो अभयं कृणुताम् । सुवीर्यस्य पतयः स्याम । इदं सर्पेभ्यो हविरस्तु जुष्टम् । आश्रेषा येषामनुयन्ति चेतः

3.1.1.s: ye antarikṣaṃ pṛthivīṃ kṣiyanti | te naḥ sarpāso havamāgamiṣṭhāḥ | ye rocane sūryasyāpi sarpāḥ | ye divaṃ devīmanu saṃcaranti | yeṣāmāśreṣā anuyanti kāmam | tebhyaḥ sarpebhyo madhumajjuhomi | upahūtāḥ pitaro ye maghāsu | manojavasaḥ sukṛtaḥ sukṛtyāḥ | te no nakṣattre havamāgamiṣṭhāḥ | svadhābhiryajñaṃ prayataṃ juṣantām
3.1.1.d: ये अन्तरिक्षं पृथिवीं क्षियन्ति । ते नः सर्पासो हवमागमिष्ठाः । ये रोचने सूर्यस्यापि सर्पाः । ये दिवं देवीमनु संचरन्ति । येषामाश्रेषा अनुयन्ति कामम् । तेभ्यः सर्पेभ्यो मधुमज्जुहोमि । उपहूताः पितरो ये मघासु । मनोजवसः सुकृतः सुकृत्याः । ते नो नक्षत्त्रे हवमागमिष्ठाः । स्वधाभिर्यज्ञं प्रयतं जुषन्ताम्
3.1.1.m:
They who dwell in the intermediate space [and] on the earth,
may those serpents come most readily to our call!
Those serpents who are also in the realm of the sun,
who wander along the divine heaven,
whose desire the Āśreṣās follow—
to those serpents I sacrifice accompanied by sweetness!
Invoked are the Fathers who are in the Maghās,
swift as thought, doing good, of good deeds;
may they come most readily to our call at the lunar mansion,
with the ancestral offerings may they enjoy the proffered sacrifice!

3.1.1.s: ye agnidagdhā ye'nagnidagdhāḥ | ye'muṃ lokaṃ pitaraḥ kṣiyanti | yāṃśca vidma yāṃ u ca na pravidma | maghāsu yajñaṃ sukṛtaṃ juṣantām | gavāṃ patiḥ phalgunīnāmasi tvam | tadaryamanvaruṇa mitra cāru | taṃ tvā vayaṃ sanitāraṃ sanīnām | jīvā jīvantamupa saṃviśema | yenemā viśvā bhuvanāni saṃjitā | yasya devā anu saṃyanti cetaḥ ||
3.1.1.d: ये अग्निदग्धा येऽनग्निदग्धाः । येऽमुं लोकं पितरः क्षियन्ति । यांश्च विद्म यां उ च न प्रविद्म । मघासु यज्ञं सुकृतं जुषन्ताम् । गवां पतिः फल्गुनीनामसि त्वम् । तदर्यमन्वरुण मित्र चारु । तं त्वा वयं सनितारं सनीनाम् । जीवा जीवन्तमुप संविशेम । येनेमा विश्वा भुवनानि संजिता । यस्य देवा अनु संयन्ति चेतः ॥
3.1.1.m:
Those who are burned by fire, those who are unburned by fire,
the Fathers who dwell in yonder world,
those whom we know and those whom we do not know—
may they enjoy the well-performed sacrifice in the Maghās!
You are the lord of the cows, of the Phalgunīs,
that, O Aryaman, Varuṇa, Mitra, is delightful!
As such, may we, living, dwell near you,
the living one, the winner of winnings,
by whom all these worlds have been won together,
whose intent the gods follow!

3.1.1.s: aryamā rājā'jarastuviṣmān | phalgunīnāmṛṣabho roravīti | śreṣṭho devānāṃ bhagavo bhagāsi | tattvā viduḥ phalgunīstasya vittāt | asmabhyaṃ kṣattramajaraṃ suvīryam | gomadaśvavadupa saṃnudeha | bhago ha dātā bhaga itpradātā | bhago devīḥ phalgunīrāviveśa | bhagasyettaṃ prasavaṃ gamema | yatra devaiḥ sadhamādaṃ madema
3.1.1.d: अर्यमा राजाऽजरस्तुविष्मान् । फल्गुनीनामृषभो रोरवीति । श्रेष्ठो देवानां भगवो भगासि । तत्त्वा विदुः फल्गुनीस्तस्य वित्तात् । अस्मभ्यं क्षत्त्रमजरं सुवीर्यम् । गोमदश्ववदुप संनुदेह । भगो ह दाता भग इत्प्रदाता । भगो देवीः फल्गुनीराविवेश । भगस्येत्तं प्रसवं गमेम । यत्र देवैः सधमादं मदेम

3.1.1.s: āyātu devaḥ savitopayātu | hiraṇyayena suvṛtā rathena | vahan hastaṃ subhagaṃ vidmanāpasam | prayacchantaṃ papuriṃ puṇyamaccha | hastaḥ prayacchatvamṛtaṃ vasīyaḥ | dakṣiṇena pratigṛbhṇīma enat | dātāramadya savitā videya | yo no hastāya prasuvāti yajñam | tvaṣṭā nakṣattramabhyeti citrām | subhaṃsasaṃ yuvatiṃ rocamānām
3.1.1.d: आयातु देवः सवितोपयातु । हिरण्ययेन सुवृता रथेन । वहन् हस्तं सुभगं विद्मनापसम् । प्रयच्छन्तं पपुरिं पुण्यमच्छ । हस्तः प्रयच्छत्वमृतं वसीयः । दक्षिणेन प्रतिगृभ्णीम एनत् । दातारमद्य सविता विदेय । यो नो हस्ताय प्रसुवाति यज्ञम् । त्वष्टा नक्षत्त्रमभ्येति चित्राम् । सुभंससं युवतिं रोचमानाम्
3.1.1.m:
May the god Savitṛ come, may he approach
with his well-turning golden chariot,
bringing the auspicious, skillfully working Hasta,
toward the bountiful, meritorious [mansion] that bestows!
May Hasta bestow nectar, superior wealth;
with the right hand may we receive it!
May I find Savitṛ today as the giver,
who shall impel the sacrifice for our Hasta!
Tvaṣṭṛ approaches the Citrā lunar mansion,
the shapely, shining maiden,

3.1.1.s: niveśayannamṛtānmartyāṃśca | rūpāṇi piṃśanbhuvanāni viśvā | tannastvaṣṭā tadu citrā vicaṣṭām | tannakṣatraṃ bhūridā astu mahyam | tannaḥ prajāṃ vīravatīṃ sanotu | gobhirno aśvaiḥ samanaktu yajñam | vāyurnakṣatramabhyeti niṣṭyām | tigmaśṛṅgo vṛṣabho roruvāṇaḥ | samīrayanbhuvanā mātariśvā | apa dveṣāṃsi nudatāmarātīḥ
3.1.1.d: निवेशयन्नमृतान्मर्त्यांश्च । रूपाणि पिंशन्भुवनानि विश्वा । तन्नस्त्वष्टा तदु चित्रा विचष्टाम् । तन्नक्षत्रं भूरिदा अस्तु मह्यम् । तन्नः प्रजां वीरवतीं सनोतु । गोभिर्नो अश्वैः समनक्तु यज्ञम् । वायुर्नक्षत्रमभ्येति निष्ट्याम् । तिग्मशृङ्गो वृषभो रोरुवाणः । समीरयन्भुवना मातरिश्वा । अप द्वेषांसि नुदतामरातीः
3.1.1.m:
establishing mortals and immortals,
fashioning forms, all the worlds.
May Tvaṣṭṛ look upon that for us, and may Citrā [look upon it]!
May that lunar mansion be a giver of abundance to me!
May it win for us offspring rich in heroes;
may it anoint our sacrifice with cattle [and] with horses!
Vāyu approaches the Niṣṭyā lunar mansion,
the sharp-horned bull, roaring loudly;
setting the worlds in motion, Mātariśvan,
may he thrust away hatreds [and] enemies!

3.1.1.s: tanno vāyustadu niṣṭyā śṛṇotu | tannakṣatraṃ bhūridā astu mahyam | tanno devāso anujānantu kāmam | yathā tarema duritāni viśvā | dūramasmacchatravo yantu bhītāḥ | tadindrāgnī kṛṇutāṃ tadviśākhe | tanno devā anumadantu yajñam | paścātpurastādabhayaṃ no astu | nakṣatrāṇāmadhipatnī viśākhe | śreṣṭhāvindrāgnī bhuvanasya gopau
3.1.1.d: तन्नो वायुस्तदु निष्ट्या शृणोतु । तन्नक्षत्रं भूरिदा अस्तु मह्यम् । तन्नो देवासो अनुजानन्तु कामम् । यथा तरेम दुरितानि विश्वा । दूरमस्मच्छत्रवो यन्तु भीताः । तदिन्द्राग्नी कृणुतां तद्विशाखे । तन्नो देवा अनुमदन्तु यज्ञम् । पश्चात्पुरस्तादभयं नो अस्तु । नक्षत्राणामधिपत्नी विशाखे । श्रेष्ठाविन्द्राग्नी भुवनस्य गोपौ
3.1.1.m: May Vāyu hear that for us, and may Niṣṭyā [hear] that; / may that lunar mansion be a giver of abundance to me; / may the gods grant us that desire, / so that we may cross over all misfortunes. / Afraid, let our enemies depart far from us; / let Indra and Agni effect that, let the Viśākhās [effect] that. / Let the gods welcome this sacrifice of ours; / let there be safety for us from behind and from before. / The Viśākhās are the mistresses among the lunar mansions, / the best, Indra and Agni the protectors of the world.

3.1.1.s: viṣūcaḥ śatrūnapa bādhamānau | apa kṣudhaṃ nudatāmarātim | pūrṇā paścāduta pūrṇā purastāt | unmadhyataḥ paurṇamāsī jigāya | tasyāṃ devā adhi saṃvasantaḥ | uttame nāka iha mādayantām | pṛthvī suvarcā yuvatiḥ sajoṣāḥ | paurṇamāsyudagācchobhamānā | āpyāyayantī duritāni viśvā | uruṃ duhāṃ yajamānāya yajñam
3.1.1.d: विषूचः शत्रूनप बाधमानौ । अप क्षुधं नुदतामरातिम् । पूर्णा पश्चादुत पूर्णा पुरस्तात् । उन्मध्यतः पौर्णमासी जिगाय । तस्यां देवा अधि संवसन्तः । उत्तमे नाक इह मादयन्ताम् । पृथ्वी सुवर्चा युवतिः सजोषाः । पौर्णमास्युदगाच्छोभमाना । आप्याययन्ती दुरितानि विश्वा । उरुं दुहां यजमानाय यज्ञम्
3.1.1.m: Thrusting back the enemies in all directions, / may they drive away hunger and malevolence. / Full behind and full before, / the Full-Moon night has ascended from the center; / dwelling upon her, let the gods / rejoice here on the highest firmament. / Broad, well-radiant, a harmonious maiden, / the Full-Moon night has risen gleaming, / filling up all misfortunes; / may she milk a wide sacrifice for the sacrificer.

3.1.2.s: ṛdhyāsma havyairnamasopasadya | mitraṃ devaṃ mitradheyaṃ no astu | anūrādhān haviṣā vardhayantaḥ | śataṃ jīvema śaradaḥ savīrāḥ | citraṃ nakṣattramudagātpurastāt | anūrādhāsa iti yadvadanti | tanmitra eti pathibhirdevayānaiḥ | hiraṇyayairvitatairantarikṣe | indro jyeṣṭhāmanu nakṣattrameti | yasminvṛtraṃ vṛtratūrye tatāra
3.1.2.d: ऋध्यास्म हव्यैर्नमसोपसद्य । मित्रं देवं मित्रधेयं नो अस्तु । अनूराधान् हविषा वर्धयन्तः । शतं जीवेम शरदः सवीराः । चित्रं नक्षत्त्रमुदगात्पुरस्तात् । अनूराधास इति यद्वदन्ति । तन्मित्र एति पथिभिर्देवयानैः । हिरण्ययैर्विततैरन्तरिक्षे । इन्द्रो ज्येष्ठामनु नक्षत्त्रमेति । यस्मिन्वृत्रं वृत्रतूर्ये ततार
3.1.2.m: Approaching with homage, may we prosper through oblations; / let the god Mitra become our alliance. / Strengthening the Anūrādhas with an oblation, / may we live a hundred autumns, possessing heroes. / The splendid lunar mansion has risen in the east, / which they call the Anūrādhas; / through it Mitra walks along the paths of the gods, / golden and spread wide in the midspace. / Indra follows the lunar mansion Jyeṣṭhā, / in which he overcame Vṛtra in the battle for Vṛtra.

3.1.2.s: tasminvayamamṛtaṃ duhānāḥ | kṣudhaṃ tarema duritiṃ duriṣṭim | purandarāya vṛṣabhāya dhṛṣṇave | aṣāḍhāya sahamānāya mīḍhuṣe | indrāya jyeṣṭhā madhumadduhānā | uruṃ kṛṇotu yajamānāya lokam | mūlaṃ prajāṃ vīravatīṃ videya | parācyetu nirṛtiḥ parācā | gobhirnakṣattraṃ paśubhiḥ samaktam | aharbhūyādyajamānāya mahyam
3.1.2.d: तस्मिन्वयममृतं दुहानाः । क्षुधं तरेम दुरितिं दुरिष्टिम् । पुरन्दराय वृषभाय धृष्णवे । अषाढाय सहमानाय मीढुषे । इन्द्राय ज्येष्ठा मधुमद्दुहाना । उरुं कृणोतु यजमानाय लोकम् । मूलं प्रजां वीरवतीं विदेय । पराच्येतु निरृतिः पराचा । गोभिर्नक्षत्त्रं पशुभिः समक्तम् । अहर्भूयाद्यजमानाय मह्यम्
3.1.2.m: Milking immortality in it, / may we cross over hunger, misery, and poor sacrifice. / For the fortress-destroyer, the bull, the daring, / the unconquered, the victorious, the bounteous, / for Indra, may Jyeṣṭhā, milking sweetness, / make wide space for the sacrificer. / May I attain Mūla, offspring possessing heroes; / let Nirṛti go far away, departing. / Anointed with cows and domestic animals, may the lunar mansion / become day for me, the sacrificer.

3.1.2.s: aharno adya suvite dadhātu | mūlaṃ nakṣattramiti yadvadanti | parācīṃ vācā nirṛtiṃ nudāmi | śivaṃ prajāyai śivamastu mahyam | yā divyā āpaḥ payasā saṃbabhūvuḥ | yā antarikṣa uta pārthivīryāḥ | yāsāmaṣāḍhā anuyanti kāmam | tā na āpaḥ śaṃ syonā bhavantu | yāśca kūpyā yāśca nādyāḥ samudriyāḥ | yāśca vaiśantīruta prāsacīryāḥ
3.1.2.d: अहर्नो अद्य सुविते दधातु । मूलं नक्षत्त्रमिति यद्वदन्ति । पराचीं वाचा निरृतिं नुदामि । शिवं प्रजायै शिवमस्तु मह्यम् । या दिव्या आपः पयसा संबभूवुः । या अन्तरिक्ष उत पार्थिवीर्याः । यासामषाढा अनुयन्ति कामम् । ता न आपः शं स्योना भवन्तु । याश्च कूप्या याश्च नाद्याः समुद्रियाः । याश्च वैशन्तीरुत प्रासचीर्याः
3.1.2.m: May it place us today in auspicious fortune, / the lunar mansion that they call Mūla; / with speech I drive Nirṛti far away; / may there be blessing for offspring, blessing for me. / The divine waters that arose with milk, / those in the midspace and those belonging to the earth, / whose desire the Aṣāḍhās pursue, / may those waters be peaceful and pleasant to us; / both those from wells and those from streams, from the sea, / those belonging to ponds and those flowing forth,

3.1.2.s: yāsāmaṣāḍhā madhu bhakṣayanti | tā na āpaḥ śaṃ syonā bhavantu | tanno viśve upa śṛṇvantu devāḥ | tadaṣāḍhā abhi saṃyantu yajñam | tannakṣattraṃ prathatāṃ paśubhyaḥ | kṛṣirvṛṣṭiryajamānāya kalpatām | śubhrāḥ kanyā yuvatayaḥ supeśasaḥ | karmakṛtaḥ sukṛto vīryāvatīḥ | viśvāndevān haviṣā vardhayantīḥ | aṣāḍhāḥ kāmamupayāntu yajñam
3.1.2.d: यासामषाढा मधु भक्षयन्ति । ता न आपः शं स्योना भवन्तु । तन्नो विश्वे उप शृण्वन्तु देवाः । तदषाढा अभि संयन्तु यज्ञम् । तन्नक्षत्त्रं प्रथतां पशुभ्यः । कृषिर्वृष्टिर्यजमानाय कल्पताम् । शुभ्राः कन्या युवतयः सुपेशसः । कर्मकृतः सुकृतो वीर्यावतीः । विश्वान्देवान् हविषा वर्धयन्तीः । अषाढाः काममुपयान्तु यज्ञम्
3.1.2.m: whose sweetness the Aṣāḍhās consume: / may those waters be peaceful and pleasant to us. / May all the gods listen to this for us; / may the Aṣāḍhās come unto that sacrifice. / May that lunar mansion extend itself for domestic animals; / may plowing and rain be ready for the sacrificer. / Bright maidens, youthful, richly ornamented, / performing deeds, doing good works, possessing heroic power, / strengthening all the gods with an oblation, / let the Aṣāḍhās approach the sacrifice according to desire.

3.1.2.s: yasminbrahmābhyajayathsarvametat | amuṃ ca lokamidamū ca sarvam | tanno nakṣattramabhijidvijitya | śriyaṃ dadhātvahṛṇīyamānam | ubhau lokau brahmaṇā saṃjitemau | tanno nakṣattramabhijidvicaṣṭām | tasminvayaṃ pṛtanāḥ saṃjayema | taṃ no devāso anujānantu kāmam | śṛṇvanti śroṇāmamṛtasya gopām | puṇyāmasyā upaśṛṇomi vācam
3.1.2.d: यस्मिन्ब्रह्माभ्यजयथ्सर्वमेतत् । अमुं च लोकमिदमू च सर्वम् । तन्नो नक्षत्त्रमभिजिद्विजित्य । श्रियं दधात्वहृणीयमानम् । उभौ लोकौ ब्रह्मणा संजितेमौ । तन्नो नक्षत्त्रमभिजिद्विचष्टाम् । तस्मिन्वयं पृतनाः संजयेम । तं नो देवासो अनुजानन्तु कामम् । शृण्वन्ति श्रोणाममृतस्य गोपाम् । पुण्यामस्या उपशृणोमि वाचम्
3.1.2.m: In which the brahman conquered all this— / both yonder world and all of this; / having conquered, may that lunar mansion Abhijit / grant fortune to us, being unangered. / Both these worlds are completely conquered by the brahman; / may that lunar mansion Abhijit look upon that for us. / In it may we conquer armies; / may the gods grant that desire to us. / They hear Śroṇā, the protector of immortality; / I listen to her holy voice.

3.1.2.s: mahīṃ devīṃ viṣṇupatnīmajūryām | pratīcīmenāṃ haviṣā yajāmaḥ | tredhā viṣṇururugāyo vicakrame | mahīṃ divaṃ pṛthivīmantarikṣam | tacchroṇaiti śrava icchamānā | puṇyaṃ ślokaṃ yajamānāya kṛṇvatī | aṣṭau devā vasavaḥ somyāsaḥ | catasro devīrajarāḥ śraviṣṭhāḥ | te yajñaṃ pāntu rajasaḥ parastāt | saṃvathsarīṇamamṛtaṃ svasti
3.1.2.d: महीं देवीं विष्णुपत्नीमजूर्याम् । प्रतीचीमेनां हविषा यजामः । त्रेधा विष्णुरुरुगायो विचक्रमे । महीं दिवं पृथिवीमन्तरिक्षम् । तच्छ्रोणैति श्रव इच्छमाना । पुण्यं श्लोकं यजमानाय कृण्वती । अष्टौ देवा वसवः सोम्यासः । चतस्रो देवीरजराः श्रविष्ठाः । ते यज्ञं पान्तु रजसः परस्तात् । संवथ्सरीणममृतं स्वस्ति
3.1.2.m: The great goddess, the ageless wife of Viṣṇu, / turned toward us, we worship her with an oblation. / Threefold Viṣṇu of wide stride stepped out: / the great sky, the earth, the midspace. / Unto that Śroṇā goes, desiring fame, / making a holy renown for the sacrificer. / The eight divine Vasus, belonging to Soma, / the four goddesses, the ageless Śraviṣṭhās: / may they protect the sacrifice from beyond the realm of air, / safe, immortal, through the entire year.

3.1.2.s: yajñaṃ naḥ pāntu vasavaḥ purastāt | dakṣiṇato'bhiyantu śraviṣṭhāḥ | puṇyaṃ nakṣattramabhi saṃviśāma | mā no arātiraghaśaṃsā gan | kṣatrasya rājā varuṇo'dhirājaḥ | nakṣattrāṇāṃ śatabhiṣagvasiṣṭhaḥ | tau devebhyaḥ kṛṇuto dīrghamāyuḥ | śataṃ sahasrā bheṣajāni dhattaḥ | yajñaṃ no rājā varuṇa upayātu | taṃ no viśve abhi saṃyantu devāḥ
3.1.2.d: यज्ञं नः पान्तु वसवः पुरस्तात् । दक्षिणतोऽभियन्तु श्रविष्ठाः । पुण्यं नक्षत्त्रमभि संविशाम । मा नो अरातिरघशंसा गन् । क्षत्रस्य राजा वरुणोऽधिराजः । नक्षत्त्राणां शतभिषग्वसिष्ठः । तौ देवेभ्यः कृणुतो दीर्घमायुः । शतं सहस्रा भेषजानि धत्तः । यज्ञं नो राजा वरुण उपयातु । तं नो विश्वे अभि संयन्तु देवाः
3.1.2.m: May the Vasus protect our sacrifice from the east; / from the south may the Śraviṣṭhās approach. / May we enter into the holy lunar mansion; / let no malevolence, chanting evil, come upon us. / Varuṇa is the king, the overlord of regal power; / Śatabhiṣaj is the most excellent among lunar mansions. / Both of them establish long lifespan for the gods; / they grant a hundred, a thousand remedies. / May king Varuṇa come unto our sacrifice; / may all the gods assemble here for that.

3.1.2.s: tanno nakṣattraṃ śatabhiṣagjuṣāṇam | dīrghamāyuḥ pratiradbheṣajāni | aja ekapādudagātpurastāt | viśvā bhūtāni pratimodamānaḥ | tasya devāḥ prasavaṃ yanti sarve | proṣṭhapadāso amṛtasya gopāḥ | vibhrājamānaḥ samidhāna ugraḥ | ā'ntarikṣamaruhadagandyām | taṃ sūryaṃ devamajamekapādam | proṣṭhapadāso anuyanti sarve
3.1.2.d: तन्नो नक्षत्त्रं शतभिषग्जुषाणम् । दीर्घमायुः प्रतिरद्भेषजानि । अज एकपादुदगात्पुरस्तात् । विश्वा भूतानि प्रतिमोदमानः । तस्य देवाः प्रसवं यन्ति सर्वे । प्रोष्ठपदासो अमृतस्य गोपाः । विभ्राजमानः समिधान उग्रः । आऽन्तरिक्षमरुहदगन्द्याम् । तं सूर्यं देवमजमेकपादम् । प्रोष्ठपदासो अनुयन्ति सर्वे
3.1.2.m: May that lunar mansion Śatabhiṣaj, being pleased with us, / prolong long lifespan [and] remedies. / Aja Ekapād has risen in the east, / greeting all beings with joy. / All the gods follow his impulse, / the Proṣṭhapadās, the protectors of immortality. / Blazing, ignited, fierce, / he mounted the midspace, he attained the sky; / that god, the sun, Aja Ekapād, / all the Proṣṭhapadās follow.

3.1.2.s: ahirbudhniyaḥ prathamāna eti | śreṣṭho devānāmuta mānuṣāṇām | taṃ brāhmaṇāḥ somapāḥ somyāsaḥ | proṣṭhapadāso abhirakṣanti sarve | catvāra ekamabhikarma devāḥ | proṣṭhapadāsa iti yān vadanti | te budhniyaṃ pariṣadyaṃ stuvantaḥ | ahiṃ rakṣanti namasopasadya | pūṣā revatyanveti panthām | puṣṭipatī paśupā vājabastyau
3.1.2.d: अहिर्बुध्नियः प्रथमान एति । श्रेष्ठो देवानामुत मानुषाणाम् । तं ब्राह्मणाः सोमपाः सोम्यासः । प्रोष्ठपदासो अभिरक्षन्ति सर्वे । चत्वार एकमभिकर्म देवाः । प्रोष्ठपदास इति यान् वदन्ति । ते बुध्नियं परिषद्यं स्तुवन्तः । अहिं रक्षन्ति नमसोपसद्य । पूषा रेवत्यन्वेति पन्थाम् । पुष्टिपती पशुपा वाजबस्त्यौ
3.1.2.m: Ahi Budhnya goes spreading out, / the best of gods and of mortals. / Him the soma-drinking Brahmins, worthy of Soma, / the Proṣṭhapadās, all protect. / Four gods for a single work, / those whom they call the Proṣṭhapadās: / praising the Budhnya who sits in council, / they protect the serpent, approaching with homage. / Pūṣan and Revatī follow the path, / masters of nourishment, protectors of cattle, whose dwelling is prize-wealth.

3.1.2.s: imāni havyā prayatā juṣāṇā | sugairno yānairupayātāṃ yajñam | kṣudrānpaśūnrakṣatu revatī naḥ | gāvo no aśvāṃ anvetu pūṣā | annaṃ rakṣantau bahudhā virūpam | vājaṃ sanutāṃ yajamānāya yajñam | tadaśvināvaśvayujopayātām | śubhaṃ gamiṣṭhau suyamebhiraśvaiḥ | svaṃ nakṣattraṃ haviṣā yajantau | madhvā saṃpṛktau yajuṣā samaktau
3.1.2.d: इमानि हव्या प्रयता जुषाणा । सुगैर्नो यानैरुपयातां यज्ञम् । क्षुद्रान्पशून्रक्षतु रेवती नः । गावो नो अश्वां अन्वेतु पूषा । अन्नं रक्षन्तौ बहुधा विरूपम् । वाजं सनुतां यजमानाय यज्ञम् । तदश्विनावश्वयुजोपयाताम् । शुभं गमिष्ठौ सुयमेभिरश्वैः । स्वं नक्षत्त्रं हविषा यजन्तौ । मध्वा संपृक्तौ यजुषा समक्तौ
3.1.2.m: Enjoying these offered oblations, / may they come unto our sacrifice with easy-going conveyances. / May Revatī protect our small domestic animals; / may Pūṣan follow our cows and horses. / Guarding food of many various kinds, / may they grant prize-wealth and sacrifice to the sacrificer. / May the Aśvins approach that with the Aśvayujas, / foremost in going to beauty with well-guided horses, / worshiping their own lunar mansion with an oblation, / united with sweetness, anointed with sacrificial formula.

3.1.2.s: yau devānāṃ bhiṣajau havyavāhau | viśvasya dūtāvamṛtasya gopau | tau nakṣattraṃ jujuṣāṇopayātām | namo'śvibhyāṃ kṛṇumo'śvayugbhyām | apa pāpmānaṃ bharaṇīrbharantu | tadyamo rājā bhagavān vicaṣṭām | lokasya rājā mahato mahān hi | sugaṃ naḥ panthāmabhayaṃ kṛṇotu | yasminnakṣattre yama eti rājā | yasminnenamabhyaṣiñcanta devāḥ | tadasya citraṃ haviṣā yajāma | apa pāpmānaṃ bharaṇīrbharantu | niveśanī yatte devā adadhuḥ
3.1.2.d: यौ देवानां भिषजौ हव्यवाहौ । विश्वस्य दूतावमृतस्य गोपौ । तौ नक्षत्त्रं जुजुषाणोपयाताम् । नमोऽश्विभ्यां कृणुमोऽश्वयुग्भ्याम् । अप पाप्मानं भरणीर्भरन्तु । तद्यमो राजा भगवान् विचष्टाम् । लोकस्य राजा महतो महान् हि । सुगं नः पन्थामभयं कृणोतु । यस्मिन्नक्षत्त्रे यम एति राजा । यस्मिन्नेनमभ्यषिञ्चन्त देवाः । तदस्य चित्रं हविषा यजाम । अप पाप्मानं भरणीर्भरन्तु । निवेशनी यत्ते देवा अदधुः
3.1.2.m: The two who are the physicians of the gods, the bearers of oblations, / the messengers of everything, the guardians of immortality— / let those two, rejoicing in their lunar mansion, come hither. / Homage we pay to the Aśvins, the Aśvayujas! / Let the Bharaṇīs carry away evil! / Let King Yama, the fortunate, behold that. / King of the realm, great indeed among the great, / let him make our path easy to travel and free of fear. / In which lunar mansion King Yama goes, / in which the gods anointed him [with royal unction], / that wondrous [place] of his let us worship with oblation. / Let the Bharaṇīs carry away evil! / The abiding place which the gods established for you—

3.1.3.s: navo navo bhavati jāyamāno yamādityā aṃśumāpyāyayanti | ye virūpe samanasā saṃvyayantī | samānaṃ tantuṃ pari tātanāte | vibhū prabhū anubhū viśvato huve | te no nakṣattre havamāgametam | vayaṃ devī brahmaṇā saṃvidānāḥ | suratnāso devavītiṃ dadhānāḥ | ahorātre haviṣā vardhayantaḥ | ati pāpmānamatimuktyā gamema | pratyuvadṛśyāyatī
3.1.3.d: नवो नवो भवति जायमानो यमादित्या अंशुमाप्याययन्ति । ये विरूपे समनसा संव्ययन्ती । समानं तन्तुं परि तातनाते । विभू प्रभू अनुभू विश्वतो हुवे । ते नो नक्षत्त्रे हवमागमेतम् । वयं देवी ब्रह्मणा संविदानाः । सुरत्नासो देववीतिं दधानाः । अहोरात्रे हविषा वर्धयन्तः । अति पाप्मानमतिमुक्त्या गमेम । प्रत्युवदृश्यायती
3.1.3.m: “New and ever new he becomes as he is born, the stalk which the Ādityas swell.” / The two of different form, of one mind, clothing themselves together, / who stretch around the common thread, / the pervasive, the potent, the conforming, I call from every side; / may those two lunar mansions come to our call! / We, being in accord with the goddess through brahman, / rich in jewels, presenting the feast for the gods, / increasing day and night with oblation, / may we pass beyond evil through deliverance! / Lo, she has been seen approaching,

3.1.3.s: vyucchantī duhitā divaḥ | apo mahī vṛṇute cakṣuṣā | tamo jyotiṣkṛṇoti sūnarī | udusriyāḥ sacate sūryaḥ | sacā udyannakṣattramarcimat | taveduṣo vyuṣi sūryasya ca | saṃ bhaktena gamemahi | tanno nakṣatramarcimat | bhānumatteja uccarat | upa yajñamihāgamat
3.1.3.d: व्युच्छन्ती दुहिता दिवः । अपो मही वृणुते चक्षुषा । तमो ज्योतिष्कृणोति सूनरी । उदुस्रियाः सचते सूर्यः । सचा उद्यन्नक्षत्त्रमर्चिमत् । तवेदुषो व्युषि सूर्यस्य च । सं भक्तेन गमेमहि । तन्नो नक्षत्रमर्चिमत् । भानुमत्तेज उच्चरत् । उप यज्ञमिहागमत्
3.1.3.m: shining forth, the daughter of heaven; / the great one uncovers the waters with her eye. / The noble one makes light out of darkness; / the sun accompanies the reddish dawn-rays; / rising together with them, the radiant lunar mansion. / At your dawning, O Dawn, and of the sun, / may we attain our share! / May that radiant lunar mansion of ours, / the brilliant fiery energy rising up, / come hither to the sacrifice!

3.1.3.s: pra nakṣatrāya devāya | indrāyenduṃ havāmahe | sa naḥ savitā suvathsanim | puṣṭidāṃ vīravattamam | udu tyaṃ citram | aditirna uruṣyatu mahīmūṣu mātaram | idaṃ viṣṇuḥ pra tadviṣṇuḥ | agnirmūrdhā bhuvaḥ | anu no'dyānumatiranvidanumate tvam | havyavāhaṃ sviṣṭam
3.1.3.d: प्र नक्षत्राय देवाय । इन्द्रायेन्दुं हवामहे । स नः सविता सुवथ्सनिम् । पुष्टिदां वीरवत्तमम् । उदु त्यं चित्रम् । अदितिर्न उरुष्यतु महीमूषु मातरम् । इदं विष्णुः प्र तद्विष्णुः । अग्निर्मूर्धा भुवः । अनु नोऽद्यानुमतिरन्विदनुमते त्वम् । हव्यवाहं स्विष्टम्
3.1.3.m: To the divine lunar mansion, / to Indra, we invoke the soma-drop. / May that Savitṛ grant us the gift, / granting nourishment, most full of heroes! / “Up that wondrous…” / “May Aditi protect us, the great mother…” / “Here Viṣṇu…”, “Forth that Viṣṇu…” / “Agni is head…”, “Bhūḥ…” / “May Anumati favor us today…”, “Do you indeed, O Anumati…” / “The oblation-bearer, well-sacrificed…”

3.1.4.s: agnirvā akāmayata | annādo devānāg syāmiti | sa etamagnaye kṛttikābhyaḥ puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ niravapat | tato vai so'nnādo devānāmabhavat | agnirvai devānāmannādaḥ | yathā ha vā agnirdevānāmannādaḥ | evaṃ ha vā eṣa manuṣyāṇāṃ bhavati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | agnaye svāhā kṛttikābhyaḥ svāhā | ambāyai svāhā dulāyai svāhā | nitatnyai svāhā'bhrayantyai svāhā | meghayantyai svāhā varṣayantyai svāhā | cupuṇīkāyai svāheti
3.1.4.d: अग्निर्वा अकामयत । अन्नादो देवानाग् स्यामिति । स एतमग्नये कृत्तिकाभ्यः पुरोडाशमष्टाकपालं निरवपत् । ततो वै सोऽन्नादो देवानामभवत् । अग्निर्वै देवानामन्नादः । यथा ह वा अग्निर्देवानामन्नादः । एवं ह वा एष मनुष्याणां भवति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । अग्नये स्वाहा कृत्तिकाभ्यः स्वाहा । अम्बायै स्वाहा दुलायै स्वाहा । नितत्न्यै स्वाहाऽभ्रयन्त्यै स्वाहा । मेघयन्त्यै स्वाहा वर्षयन्त्यै स्वाहा । चुपुणीकायै स्वाहेति
3.1.4.m: Agni desired: / “May I be the eater of food among the gods.” / He offered this eight-pot-sherd cake to Agni, to the Kṛttikās. / Thereupon he indeed became the eater of food among the gods. / Agni indeed is the eater of food among the gods. / Just as Agni is the eater of food among the gods, / even so he becomes among humans / who sacrifices with this oblation, / and who knows this thus. / There he offers: / “To Agni, svāhā! To the Kṛttikās, svāhā! / To Ambā, svāhā! To Dulā, svāhā! / To Nitatnī, svāhā! To Abhrayantī, svāhā! / To Meghayantī, svāhā! To Varṣayantī, svāhā! / To Cupuṇīkā, svāhā!”

3.1.4.s: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata | tā asmāthsṛṣṭāḥ parācīrāyann | tāsāṃ rohiṇīmabhyadhyāyat | so'kāmayata | upa mā varteta | samenayā gaccheyeti | sa etaṃ prajāpataye rohiṇyai caruṃ niravapat | tato vai sā tamupāvartata | samenayā'gacchata | upa ha vā enaṃ priyamāvartate | saṃ priyeṇa gacchate | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | prajāpataye svāhā rohiṇyai svāhā | rocamānāyai svāhā prajābhyaḥ svāheti
3.1.4.d: प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत । ता अस्माथ्सृष्टाः पराचीरायन्न् । तासां रोहिणीमभ्यध्यायत् । सोऽकामयत । उप मा वर्तेत । समेनया गच्छेयेति । स एतं प्रजापतये रोहिण्यै चरुं निरवपत् । ततो वै सा तमुपावर्तत । समेनयाऽगच्छत । उप ह वा एनं प्रियमावर्तते । सं प्रियेण गच्छते । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । प्रजापतये स्वाहा रोहिण्यै स्वाहा । रोचमानायै स्वाहा प्रजाभ्यः स्वाहेति
3.1.4.m: Prajāpati created offspring. / Having been created, they went away from him. / Among them he set his heart upon Rohiṇī. / He desired: / “May she return to me; / may I unite with her.” / He offered this caru to Prajāpati, to Rohiṇī. / Thereupon she indeed returned to him; / he united with her. / Unto him indeed returns what is dear; / he unites with what is dear, / who sacrifices with this oblation, / and who knows this thus. / There he offers: / “To Prajāpati, svāhā! To Rohiṇī, svāhā! To the shining one, svāhā! To offspring, svāhā!”

3.1.4.s: somo vā akāmayata | oṣadhīnāṃ rājyamabhijayeyamiti | sa etaṃ somāya mṛgaśīrṣāya śyāmākaṃ caruṃ payasi niravapat | tato vai sa oṣadhīnāṃ rājyamabhyajayat | samānānāṃ ha vai rājyamabhijayati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | somāya svāhā mṛgaśīrṣāya svāhā | invakābhyaḥ svāhauṣadhībhyaḥ svāhā | rājyāya svāhā'bhijityai svāheti
3.1.4.d: सोमो वा अकामयत । ओषधीनां राज्यमभिजयेयमिति । स एतं सोमाय मृगशीर्षाय श्यामाकं चरुं पयसि निरवपत् । ततो वै स ओषधीनां राज्यमभ्यजयत् । समानानां ह वै राज्यमभिजयति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । सोमाय स्वाहा मृगशीर्षाय स्वाहा । इन्वकाभ्यः स्वाहौषधीभ्यः स्वाहा । राज्याय स्वाहाऽभिजित्यै स्वाहेति
3.1.4.m: Soma desired: / “May I win the kingship of the plants.” / He offered this caru of śyāmāka grain in milk to Soma, to Mṛgaśīrṣa. / Thereupon he indeed won the kingship of the plants. / He wins indeed the kingship over his equals / who sacrifices with this oblation, / and who knows this thus. / There he offers: / “To Soma, svāhā! To Mṛgaśīrṣa, svāhā! / To the Invakās, svāhā! To the plants, svāhā! / To kingship, svāhā! To victory, svāhā!”

3.1.4.s: rudro vā akāmayata | paśumānthsyāmiti | sa etaṃ rudrāyārdrāyai praiyyaṅgavaṃ caruṃ payasi niravapat | tato vai sa paśumānabhavat | paśumān ha vai bhavati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | rudrāya svāhā''rdrāyai svāhā | pinvamānāyai svāhā paśubhyaḥ svāheti
3.1.4.d: रुद्रो वा अकामयत । पशुमान्थ्स्यामिति । स एतं रुद्रायार्द्रायै प्रैय्यङ्गवं चरुं पयसि निरवपत् । ततो वै स पशुमानभवत् । पशुमान् ह वै भवति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । रुद्राय स्वाहा'ऽर्द्रायै स्वाहा । पिन्वमानायै स्वाहा पशुभ्यः स्वाहेति
3.1.4.m: Rudra desired: / “May I possess domestic animals.” / He offered this caru of priyaṅgu grain in milk to Rudra, to Ārdrā. / Thereupon he indeed came to possess domestic animals. / He indeed comes to possess domestic animals / who sacrifices with this oblation, / and who knows this thus. / There he offers: / “To Rudra, svāhā! To Ārdrā, svāhā! / To the swelling one, svāhā! To domestic animals, svāhā!”

3.1.4.s: ṛkṣā vā iyamalomakā''sīt | sā'kāmayata | oṣadhībhirvanaspatibhiḥ prajāyeyeti | saitamadityai punarvasubhyāṃ caruṃ niravapat | tato vā iyamoṣadhībhirvanaspatibhiḥ prājāyata | prajāyate ha vai prajayā paśubhiḥ | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | adityai svāhā punarvasubhyām | svāhā''bhūtyai svāhā prajātyai svāheti
3.1.4.d: ऋक्षा वा इयमलोमका'ऽसीत् । साऽकामयत । ओषधीभिर्वनस्पतिभिः प्रजायेयेति । सैतमदित्यै पुनर्वसुभ्यां चरुं निरवपत् । ततो वा इयमोषधीभिर्वनस्पतिभिः प्राजायत । प्रजायते ह वै प्रजया पशुभिः । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । अदित्यै स्वाहा पुनर्वसुभ्याम् । स्वाहा'ऽभूत्यै स्वाहा प्रजात्यै स्वाहेति
3.1.4.m: Bare indeed and hairless was this [earth]. / She desired: / “May I bring forth through plants and trees.” / She offered this caru to Aditi, to the Punarvasus. / Thereupon she brought forth through plants and trees. / He brings forth indeed with offspring and domestic animals / who sacrifices with this oblation, / and who knows this thus. / There he offers: “To Aditi, svāhā! To the Punarvasus, svāhā! To prosperity, svāhā! To procreation, svāhā!”

3.1.4.s: bṛhaspatirvā akāmayata | brahmavarcasī syāmiti | sa etaṃ bṛhaspataye tiṣyāya naivāraṃ caruṃ payasi niravapat | tato vai sa brahmavarcasyabhavat | brahmavarcasī ha vai bhavati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | bṛhaspataye svāhā tiṣyāya svahā | brahmavarcasāya svāheti
3.1.4.d: बृहस्पतिर्वा अकामयत । ब्रह्मवर्चसी स्यामिति । स एतं बृहस्पतये तिष्याय नैवारं चरुं पयसि निरवपत् । ततो वै स ब्रह्मवर्चस्यभवत् । ब्रह्मवर्चसी ह वै भवति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । बृहस्पतये स्वाहा तिष्याय स्वहा । ब्रह्मवर्चसाय स्वाहेति
3.1.4.m: Bṛhaspati desired: / “May I possess spiritual preeminence.” / He offered this caru of wild rice in milk to Bṛhaspati, to Tiṣya. / Thereupon he indeed came to possess spiritual preeminence. / He indeed comes to possess spiritual preeminence / who sacrifices with this oblation, / and who knows this thus. / There he offers: / “To Bṛhaspati, svāhā! To Tiṣya, svāhā! / To spiritual preeminence, svāhā!”

3.1.4.s: devāsurāḥ saṃyattā āsann | te devāḥ sarpebhya āśreṣābhya ājye karambhaṃ niravapann | tānetābhireva devatābhirupānayan | etābhirha vai devatābhirdviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyamupanayati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | sarpebhyaḥ svāhā''śreṣābhyaḥ svāhā | dandaśūkebhyaḥ svāheti
3.1.4.d: देवासुराः संयत्ता आसन्न् । ते देवाः सर्पेभ्य आश्रेषाभ्य आज्ये करम्भं निरवपन्न् । तानेताभिरेव देवताभिरुपानयन् । एताभिर्ह वै देवताभिर्द्विषन्तं भ्रातृव्यमुपनयति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । सर्पेभ्यः स्वाहा'ऽश्रेषाभ्यः स्वाहा । दन्दशूकेभ्यः स्वाहेति
3.1.4.m: The gods and asuras were in conflict. / Those gods offered groats mixed with clarified butter to the serpents, to the Āśreṣās. / By means of these very deities they brought them down. / By means of these deities he brings down the hateful rival / who sacrifices with this oblation, / and who knows this thus. / There he offers: / “To the serpents, svāhā! To the Śreṣās, svāhā! / To the biting serpents, svāhā!”

3.1.4.s: pitaro vā akāmayanta | pitṛloka ṛdhnuyāmeti | ta etaṃ pitṛbhyo maghābhyaḥ puroḍāśaṃ ṣaṭkapālaṃ niravapann | tato vai te pitṛloka ārdhnuvan | pitṛloke ha vā ṛdhnoti | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | pitṛbhyaḥ svāhā maghābhyaḥ | svāhā'naghābhyaḥ svāhā'gadābhyaḥ | svāhā'rundhatībhyaḥ svāheti
