3.1.4.d: पितरो वा अकामयन्त । पितृलोक ऋध्नुयामेति । त एतं पितृभ्यो मघाभ्यः पुरोडाशं षट्कपालं निरवपन्न् । ततो वै ते पितृलोक आर्ध्नुवन् । पितृलोके ह वा ऋध्नोति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । पितृभ्यः स्वाहा मघाभ्यः । स्वाहाऽनघाभ्यः स्वाहाऽगदाभ्यः । स्वाहाऽरुन्धतीभ्यः स्वाहेति
3.1.4.m: The fathers desired: / “May we prosper in the realm of the fathers.” / They offered this six-pot-sherd cake to the fathers, to the Maghās. / Thereupon they indeed prospered in the realm of the fathers. / In the realm of the fathers he indeed prospers / who sacrifices with this oblation, / and who knows this thus. / There he offers: / “To the fathers, svāhā! To the Maghās, svāhā! To the sinless ones, svāhā! To the disease-free ones, svāhā! To the unhindered ones, svāhā!”

3.1.4.s: aryamā vā akāmayata | paśumānthsyāmiti | sa etamaryamṇe phalgunībhyāṃ caruṃ niravapat | tato vai sa paśumānabhavat | paśumān ha vai bhavati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | aryamṇe svāhā phalgunībhyāg svāhā | paśubhyaḥ svāheti
3.1.4.d: अर्यमा वा अकामयत । पशुमान्थ्स्यामिति । स एतमर्यम्णे फल्गुनीभ्यां चरुं निरवपत् । ततो वै स पशुमानभवत् । पशुमान् ह वै भवति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । अर्यम्णे स्वाहा फल्गुनीभ्याग् स्वाहा । पशुभ्यः स्वाहेति
3.1.4.m:
Aryaman desired: 'May I be rich in domestic animals.'
He poured out this caru for Aryaman and the Phalgunīs.
Thereupon he became rich in domestic animals.
He indeed becomes rich in domestic animals,
who sacrifices with this oblation,
and who knows it thus.
He offers here:
'To Aryaman svāhā! To the Phalgunīs svāhā!
To domestic animals svāhā!'

3.1.4.s: bhago vā akāmayata | bhagī śreṣṭhī devānāg syāmiti | sa etaṃ bhagāya phalgunībhyāṃ caruṃ niravapat | tato vai sa bhagī śreṣṭhī devānāmabhavat | bhagī ha vai śreṣṭhī samānānāṃ bhavati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | bhagāya svāhā phalgunībhyāg svāhā | śraiṣṭhyāya svāheti
3.1.4.d: भगो वा अकामयत । भगी श्रेष्ठी देवानाग् स्यामिति । स एतं भगाय फल्गुनीभ्यां चरुं निरवपत् । ततो वै स भगी श्रेष्ठी देवानामभवत् । भगी ह वै श्रेष्ठी समानानां भवति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । भगाय स्वाहा फल्गुनीभ्याग् स्वाहा । श्रैष्ठ्याय स्वाहेति
3.1.4.m:
Bhaga desired: 'May I be fortunate and foremost among the gods.'
He poured out this caru for Bhaga and the Phalgunīs.
Thereupon he became fortunate and foremost among the gods.
He indeed becomes fortunate and foremost among his peers,
who sacrifices with this oblation,
and who knows it thus.
He offers here:
'To Bhaga svāhā! To the Phalgunīs svāhā!
To preeminence svāhā!'

3.1.4.s: savitā vā akāmayata | śranme devā dadhīrann | savitā syāmiti | sa etaṃ savitre hastāya puroḍāśaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ niravapadāśūnāṃ vrīhīṇām | tato vai tasmai śraddevā adadhata | savitā'bhavat | śraddha vā asmai manuṣyā dadhate | savitā samānānāṃ bhavati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | savitre svāhā hastāya | svāhā dadate svāhā pṛṇate | svāhā prayacchate svāhā pratigṛbhṇate svāheti
3.1.4.d: सविता वा अकामयत । श्रन्मे देवा दधीरन्न् । सविता स्यामिति । स एतं सवित्रे हस्ताय पुरोडाशं द्वादशकपालं निरवपदाशूनां व्रीहीणाम् । ततो वै तस्मै श्रद्देवा अदधत । सविताऽभवत् । श्रद्ध वा अस्मै मनुष्या दधते । सविता समानानां भवति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । सवित्रे स्वाहा हस्ताय । स्वाहा ददते स्वाहा पृणते । स्वाहा प्रयच्छते स्वाहा प्रतिगृभ्णते स्वाहेति
3.1.4.m:
Savitṛ desired: 'May the gods place faith in me;
may I be an impeller.'
He poured out this cake on twelve potsherds of swift-growing rice for Savitṛ and Hasta.
Thereupon the gods placed faith in him;
he became an impeller.
Men indeed place faith in him;
he becomes an impeller among his peers,
who sacrifices with this oblation,
and who knows it thus.
He offers here:
'To Savitṛ svāhā! To Hasta svāhā! To the giver svāhā! To the bestower svāhā! To the dispenser svāhā! To the receiver svāhā!'

3.1.4.s: tvaṣṭā vā akāmayata | citraṃ prajāṃ vindeyeti | sa etaṃ tvaṣṭre citrāyai puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ niravapat | tato vai sa citraṃ prajāmavindata | citraṃ ha vai prajāṃ vindate | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | tvaṣṭre svāhā citrāyai svāhā | caitrāya svāhā prajāyai svāheti
3.1.4.d: त्वष्टा वा अकामयत । चित्रं प्रजां विन्देयेति । स एतं त्वष्ट्रे चित्रायै पुरोडाशमष्टाकपालं निरवपत् । ततो वै स चित्रं प्रजामविन्दत । चित्रं ह वै प्रजां विन्दते । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । त्वष्ट्रे स्वाहा चित्रायै स्वाहा । चैत्राय स्वाहा प्रजायै स्वाहेति
3.1.4.m:
Tvaṣṭṛ desired: 'May I obtain variegated offspring.'
He poured out this cake on eight potsherds for Tvaṣṭṛ and Citrā.
Thereupon he obtained variegated offspring.
He indeed obtains variegated offspring,
who sacrifices with this oblation,
and who knows it thus.
He offers here:
'To Tvaṣṭṛ svāhā! To Citrā svāhā!
To the manifold svāhā! To offspring svāhā!'

3.1.4.s: vāyurvā akāmayata | kāmacārameṣu lokeṣvabhijayeyamiti | sa etadvāyave niṣṭyāyai gṛṣṭyai dugdhaṃ payo niravapat | tato vai sa kāmacārameṣu lokeṣvabhyajayat | kāmacāraṃ ha vā eṣu lokeṣvabhijayati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | vāyave svāhā niṣṭyāyai svāhā | kāmacārāya svāhā'bhijityai svāheti
3.1.4.d: वायुर्वा अकामयत । कामचारमेषु लोकेष्वभिजयेयमिति । स एतद्वायवे निष्ट्यायै गृष्ट्यै दुग्धं पयो निरवपत् । ततो वै स कामचारमेषु लोकेष्वभ्यजयत् । कामचारं ह वा एषु लोकेष्वभिजयति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । वायवे स्वाहा निष्ट्यायै स्वाहा । कामचाराय स्वाहाऽभिजित्यै स्वाहेति
3.1.4.m:
Vāyu desired: 'May I win free movement through these worlds.'
He poured out this boiled milk of a cow that has calved once for Vāyu and Niṣṭyā.
Thereupon he won free movement through these worlds.
He indeed wins free movement through these worlds,
who sacrifices with this oblation,
and who knows it thus.
He offers here:
'To Vāyu svāhā! To Niṣṭyā svāhā!
To free movement svāhā! To victory svāhā!'

3.1.4.s: indrāgnī vā akāmayetām | śraiṣṭhyaṃ devānāmabhijayeveti | tāvetamindrāgnibhyāṃ viśākhābhyāṃ puroḍāśamekādaśakapālaṃ niravapatām | tato vai tau śraiṣṭhyaṃ devānāmabhyajayatām | śraiṣṭhyaṃ ha vai samānānāmabhijayati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | indrāgnibhyāg svāhā viśākhābhyāg svāhā | śraiṣṭhyāya svāhā'bhijityai svāheti
3.1.4.d: इन्द्राग्नी वा अकामयेताम् । श्रैष्ठ्यं देवानामभिजयेवेति । तावेतमिन्द्राग्निभ्यां विशाखाभ्यां पुरोडाशमेकादशकपालं निरवपताम् । ततो वै तौ श्रैष्ठ्यं देवानामभ्यजयताम् । श्रैष्ठ्यं ह वै समानानामभिजयति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । इन्द्राग्निभ्याग् स्वाहा विशाखाभ्याग् स्वाहा । श्रैष्ठ्याय स्वाहाऽभिजित्यै स्वाहेति
3.1.4.m:
Indra and Agni desired: 'May we two win preeminence among the gods.'
They two poured out this cake on eleven potsherds for Indra and Agni and the Viśākhās. Thereupon they two won preeminence among the gods.
He indeed wins preeminence among his peers,
who sacrifices with this oblation,
and who knows it thus.
He offers here:
'To Indra and Agni svāhā! To the Viśākhās svāhā!
To preeminence svāhā! To victory svāhā!'

3.1.4.s: athaitatpaurṇamāsyā ājyaṃ nirvapati | kāmo vai paurṇamāsī | kāma ājyam | kāmenaiva kāmaṃ samardhayati | kṣipramenaṃ sa kāma upanamati | yena kāmena yajate | so'tra juhoti | paurṇamāsyai svāhā kāmāya svāhā'gatyai svāheti
3.1.4.d: अथैतत्पौर्णमास्या आज्यं निर्वपति । कामो वै पौर्णमासी । काम आज्यम् । कामेनैव कामं समर्धयति । क्षिप्रमेनं स काम उपनमति । येन कामेन यजते । सोऽत्र जुहोति । पौर्णमास्यै स्वाहा कामाय स्वाहाऽगत्यै स्वाहेति
3.1.4.m:
Then he pours out this clarified butter of the full-moon day.
The full-moon day is desire;
clarified butter is desire.
Through desire he makes desire succeed.
Quickly that desire comes to him,
with which desire he sacrifices.
He offers here:
'To the full-moon day svāhā! To desire svāhā! To attainment svāhā!'

3.1.5.s: mitro vā akāmayata | mitradheyameṣu lokeṣvabhijayeyamiti | sa etaṃ mitrāyānūrādhebhyaścaruṃ niravapat | tato vai sa mitradheyameṣu lokeṣvabhyajayat | mitradheyaṃ ha vā eṣu lokeṣvabhijayati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | mitrāya svāhā'nūrādhebhyaḥ svāhā | mitradheyāya svāhā'bhijityai svāheti
3.1.5.d: मित्रो वा अकामयत । मित्रधेयमेषु लोकेष्वभिजयेयमिति । स एतं मित्रायानूराधेभ्यश्चरुं निरवपत् । ततो वै स मित्रधेयमेषु लोकेष्वभ्यजयत् । मित्रधेयं ह वा एषु लोकेष्वभिजयति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । मित्राय स्वाहाऽनूराधेभ्यः स्वाहा । मित्रधेयाय स्वाहाऽभिजित्यै स्वाहेति
3.1.5.m:
Mitra desired: 'May I win friendship in these worlds.'
He poured out this caru for Mitra and the Anūrādhas.
Thereupon he won friendship in these worlds.
He indeed wins friendship in these worlds,
who sacrifices with this oblation,
and who knows it thus.
He offers here:
'To Mitra svāhā! To the Anūrādhas svāhā!
To friendship svāhā! To victory svāhā!'

3.1.5.s: indro vā akāmayata | jyaiṣṭhyaṃ devānāmabhijayeyamiti | sa etamindrāya jyeṣṭhāyai puroḍāśamekādaśakapālaṃ niravapan mahāvrīhīṇām | tato vai sa jyaiṣṭhyaṃ devānāmabhyajayat | jyaiṣṭhyaṃ ha vai samānānāmabhijayati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | indrāya svāhā jyeṣṭhāyai svāhā | jyaiṣṭhyāya svāhā'bhijityai svāheti
3.1.5.d: इन्द्रो वा अकामयत । ज्यैष्ठ्यं देवानामभिजयेयमिति । स एतमिन्द्राय ज्येष्ठायै पुरोडाशमेकादशकपालं निरवपन् महाव्रीहीणाम् । ततो वै स ज्यैष्ठ्यं देवानामभ्यजयत् । ज्यैष्ठ्यं ह वै समानानामभिजयति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । इन्द्राय स्वाहा ज्येष्ठायै स्वाहा । ज्यैष्ठ्याय स्वाहाऽभिजित्यै स्वाहेति
3.1.5.m:
Indra desired: 'May I win supremacy among the gods.'
He poured out this cake on eleven potsherds of large rice for Indra and Jyeṣṭhā.
Thereupon he won supremacy among the gods.
He indeed wins supremacy among his peers,
who sacrifices with this oblation,
and who knows it thus.
He offers here:
'To Indra svāhā! To Jyeṣṭhā svāhā! To supremacy svāhā! To victory svāhā!'

3.1.5.s: prajāpatirvā akāmayata | mūlaṃ prajāṃ vindeyeti | sa etaṃ prajāpataye mūlāya caruṃ niravapat | tato vai sa mūlaṃ prajāmavindata | mūlaṃ ha vai prajāṃ vindate | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | prajāpataye svāhā mūlāya svāhā | prajāyai svāheti
3.1.5.d: प्रजापतिर्वा अकामयत । मूलं प्रजां विन्देयेति । स एतं प्रजापतये मूलाय चरुं निरवपत् । ततो वै स मूलं प्रजामविन्दत । मूलं ह वै प्रजां विन्दते । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । प्रजापतये स्वाहा मूलाय स्वाहा । प्रजायै स्वाहेति
3.1.5.m:
Prajāpati desired: 'May I obtain offspring from the root.'
He poured out this caru for Prajāpati and Mūla.
Thereupon he obtained offspring from the root.
He indeed obtains offspring from the root,
who sacrifices with this oblation,
and who knows it thus.
He offers here:
'To Prajāpati svāhā! To Mūla svāhā!
To offspring svāhā!'

3.1.5.s: āpo vā akāmayanta | samudraṃ kāmamabhijayemeti | tā etamadbhyo'ṣāḍhābhyaścaruṃ niravapann | tato vai tāḥ samudraṃ kāmamabhyajayann | samudraṃ ha vai kāmamabhijayati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | adbhyaḥ svāhā'ṣāḍhābhyaḥ svāhā | samudrāya svāhā kāmāya svāhā | abhijityai svāheti
3.1.5.d: आपो वा अकामयन्त । समुद्रं काममभिजयेमेति । ता एतमद्भ्योऽषाढाभ्यश्चरुं निरवपन्न् । ततो वै ताः समुद्रं काममभ्यजयन्न् । समुद्रं ह वै काममभिजयति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । अद्भ्यः स्वाहाऽषाढाभ्यः स्वाहा । समुद्राय स्वाहा कामाय स्वाहा । अभिजित्यै स्वाहेति
3.1.5.m:
The Waters desired: 'May we win ocean-like desire.'
They poured out this caru for the Waters and the Aṣāḍhās.
Thereupon they won ocean-like desire.
He indeed wins ocean-like desire,
who sacrifices with this oblation,
and who knows it thus.
He offers here:
'To the Waters svāhā! To the Aṣāḍhās svāhā!
To the ocean svāhā! To desire svāhā!
To victory svāhā!'

3.1.5.s: viśve vai devā akāmayanta | anapajayyaṃ jayemeti | ta etaṃ viśvebhyo devebhyo'ṣāḍhābhyaścaruṃ niravapann | tato vai te'napajayyamajayan | anapajayyaṃ ha vai jayati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ svāhā'ṣāḍhābhyaḥ svāhā | anapajayyāya svāhā jityai svāheti
3.1.5.d: विश्वे वै देवा अकामयन्त । अनपजय्यं जयेमेति । त एतं विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्योऽषाढाभ्यश्चरुं निरवपन्न् । ततो वै तेऽनपजय्यमजयन् । अनपजय्यं ह वै जयति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यः स्वाहाऽषाढाभ्यः स्वाहा । अनपजय्याय स्वाहा जित्यै स्वाहेति
3.1.5.m:
The All-gods desired: 'May we win an unconquerable [realm].'
They poured out this caru for the All-gods and the Aṣāḍhās.
Thereupon they won an unconquerable [realm].
He indeed wins an unconquerable [realm],
who sacrifices with this oblation,
and who knows it thus.
He offers here:
'To the All-gods svāhā! To the Aṣāḍhās svāhā!
To the unconquerable svāhā! To conquest svāhā!'

3.1.5.s: brahma vā akāmayata | brahmalokamabhi jayeyamiti | tadetaṃ brahmaṇe'bhijite caruṃ niravapat | tato vai tadbrahmalokamabhyajayat | brahmalokaṃ ha vā abhijayati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | brahmaṇe svāhā'bhijite svāhā | brahmalokāya svāhā'bhijityai svāheti
3.1.5.d: ब्रह्म वा अकामयत । ब्रह्मलोकमभि जयेयमिति । तदेतं ब्रह्मणेऽभिजिते चरुं निरवपत् । ततो वै तद्ब्रह्मलोकमभ्यजयत् । ब्रह्मलोकं ह वा अभिजयति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । ब्रह्मणे स्वाहाऽभिजिते स्वाहा । ब्रह्मलोकाय स्वाहाऽभिजित्यै स्वाहेति
3.1.5.m:
The brahman desired: 'May I win the world of brahman.'
It poured out this caru for the brahman and Abhijit.
Thereupon it won the world of brahman.
He indeed wins the world of brahman,
who sacrifices with this oblation,
and who knows it thus.
He offers here: 'To the brahman svāhā! To Abhijit svāhā!
To the world of brahman svāhā! To victory svāhā!'

3.1.5.s: viṣṇurvā akāmayata | puṇyaṃ ślokaṃ śṛṇvīya | na mā pāpī kīrtirāgacchediti | sa etaṃ viṣṇave śroṇāyai puroḍāśaṃ trikapālaṃ niravapat | tato vai sa puṇyaṃ ślokamaśṛṇuta | nainaṃ pāpī kīrtirāgacchat | puṇyaṃ ha vai ślokaṃ śṛṇute | nainaṃ pāpī kīrtirāgacchati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | viṣṇave svāhā śroṇāyai svāhā | ślokāya svāhā śrutāya svāheti
3.1.5.d: विष्णुर्वा अकामयत । पुण्यं श्लोकं शृण्वीय । न मा पापी कीर्तिरागच्छेदिति । स एतं विष्णवे श्रोणायै पुरोडाशं त्रिकपालं निरवपत् । ततो वै स पुण्यं श्लोकमशृणुत । नैनं पापी कीर्तिरागच्छत् । पुण्यं ह वै श्लोकं शृणुते । नैनं पापी कीर्तिरागच्छति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । विष्णवे स्वाहा श्रोणायै स्वाहा । श्लोकाय स्वाहा श्रुताय स्वाहेति
3.1.5.m:
Viṣṇu desired:
“May I hear good praise;
may evil fame not come to me.”
He poured out this three-cup sacrificial cake for Viṣṇu, for Śroṇā.
Then indeed he heard good praise;
evil fame did not come to him.
Indeed, he hears good praise;
evil fame does not come to him,
who sacrifices with this oblation
and who likewise knows this thus.
He offers here:
“To Viṣṇu hail! To Śroṇā hail!
To praise hail! To what is heard hail!”

3.1.5.s: vasavo vā akāmayanta | agraṃ devatānāṃ parīyāmeti | ta etaṃ vasubhyaḥ śraviṣṭhābhyaḥ puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ niravapann | tato vai te'graṃ devatānāṃ paryāyann | agraṃ ha vai samānānāṃ paryeti | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | vasubhyaḥ svāhā śraviṣṭhābhyaḥ svāhā | agrāya svāhā parītyai svāheti
3.1.5.d: वसवो वा अकामयन्त । अग्रं देवतानां परीयामेति । त एतं वसुभ्यः श्रविष्ठाभ्यः पुरोडाशमष्टाकपालं निरवपन्न् । ततो वै तेऽग्रं देवतानां पर्यायन्न् । अग्रं ह वै समानानां पर्येति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । वसुभ्यः स्वाहा श्रविष्ठाभ्यः स्वाहा । अग्राय स्वाहा परीत्यै स्वाहेति
3.1.5.m:
The Vasus desired:
“May we attain the forefront of the deities.”
They poured out this eight-cup sacrificial cake for the Vasus, for the Śraviṣṭhās.
Then indeed they attained the forefront of the deities.
Indeed, he attains the forefront of his equals
who sacrifices with this oblation
and who likewise knows this thus.
He offers here:
“To the Vasus hail! To the Śraviṣṭhās hail!
To the forefront hail! To the attainment hail!”

3.1.5.s: indro vā akāmayata | dṛḍho'śithilaḥ syāmiti | sa etaṃ varuṇāya śatabhiṣaje bheṣajebhyaḥ puroḍāśaṃ daśakapālaṃ niravapatkṛṣṇānāṃ vrīhīṇām | tato vai sa dṛḍho'śithilo'bhavat | dṛḍho ha vā aśithilo bhavati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | varuṇāya svāhā śatabhiṣaje svāhā | bheṣajebhyaḥ svāheti
3.1.5.d: इन्द्रो वा अकामयत । दृढोऽशिथिलः स्यामिति । स एतं वरुणाय शतभिषजे भेषजेभ्यः पुरोडाशं दशकपालं निरवपत्कृष्णानां व्रीहीणाम् । ततो वै स दृढोऽशिथिलोऽभवत् । दृढो ह वा अशिथिलो भवति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । वरुणाय स्वाहा शतभिषजे स्वाहा । भेषजेभ्यः स्वाहेति
3.1.5.m:
Indra desired:
“May I be firm, not slack.”
He poured out this ten-cup sacrificial cake of black rice for Varuṇa, for Śatabhiṣaj, for the healing herbs.
Then indeed he became firm, not slack.
Indeed, he becomes firm, not slack,
who sacrifices with this oblation
and who likewise knows this thus.
He offers here:
“To Varuṇa hail! To Śatabhiṣaj hail!
To the healing herbs hail!”

3.1.5.s: ajo vā ekapādakāmayata | tejasvī brahmavarcasī syāmiti | sa etamajāyaikapade proṣṭhapadebhyaścaruṃ niravapat | tato vai sa tejasvī brahmavarcasyabhavat | tejasvī ha vai brahmavarcasī bhavati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | ajāyaikapade svāhā proṣṭhapadebhyaḥ svāhā | tejase svāhā brahmavarcasāya svāheti
3.1.5.d: अजो वा एकपादकामयत । तेजस्वी ब्रह्मवर्चसी स्यामिति । स एतमजायैकपदे प्रोष्ठपदेभ्यश्चरुं निरवपत् । ततो वै स तेजस्वी ब्रह्मवर्चस्यभवत् । तेजस्वी ह वै ब्रह्मवर्चसी भवति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । अजायैकपदे स्वाहा प्रोष्ठपदेभ्यः स्वाहा । तेजसे स्वाहा ब्रह्मवर्चसाय स्वाहेति
3.1.5.m:
Aja Ekapād desired:
“May I possess fiery energy, possess spiritual preeminence.”
He poured out this caru for Aja Ekapād, for the Proṣṭhapadas.
Then indeed he came to possess fiery energy, possess spiritual preeminence.
Indeed, he comes to possess fiery energy, possess spiritual preeminence,
who sacrifices with this oblation
and who likewise knows this thus.
He offers here:
“To Aja Ekapād hail! To the Proṣṭhapadas hail!
To fiery energy hail! To spiritual preeminence hail!”

3.1.5.s: ahirvai budhniyo'kāmayata | imāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ vindeyeti | sa etamahaye budhniyāya proṣṭhapadebhyaḥ puroḍāśaṃ bhūmikapālaṃ niravapat | tato vai sa imāṃ pratiṣṭhāmavindata | imāṃ ha vai pratiṣṭhāṃ vindate | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | ahaye budhniyāya svāhā proṣṭhapadebhyaḥ svāhā | pratiṣṭhāyai svāheti
3.1.5.d: अहिर्वै बुध्नियोऽकामयत । इमां प्रतिष्ठां विन्देयेति । स एतमहये बुध्नियाय प्रोष्ठपदेभ्यः पुरोडाशं भूमिकपालं निरवपत् । ततो वै स इमां प्रतिष्ठामविन्दत । इमां ह वै प्रतिष्ठां विन्दते । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । अहये बुध्नियाय स्वाहा प्रोष्ठपदेभ्यः स्वाहा । प्रतिष्ठायै स्वाहेति
3.1.5.m:
Ahi Budhnya desired:
“May I find this firm foundation.”
He poured out this sacrificial cake on an earthen potsherd for Ahi Budhnya, for the Proṣṭhapadas.
Then indeed he found this firm foundation.
Indeed, he finds this firm foundation,
who sacrifices with this oblation
and who likewise knows this thus.
He offers here:
“To Ahi Budhnya hail! To the Proṣṭhapadas hail!
To the firm foundation hail!”

3.1.5.s: pūṣā vā akāmayata | paśumānthsyāmiti | sa etaṃ pūṣṇe revatyai caruṃ niravapat | tato vai sa paśumānabhavat | paśumān ha vai bhavati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | pūṣṇe svāhā revatyai svāhā | paśubhyaḥ svāheti
3.1.5.d: पूषा वा अकामयत । पशुमान्थ्स्यामिति । स एतं पूष्णे रेवत्यै चरुं निरवपत् । ततो वै स पशुमानभवत् । पशुमान् ह वै भवति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । पूष्णे स्वाहा रेवत्यै स्वाहा । पशुभ्यः स्वाहेति
3.1.5.m:
Pūṣan desired:
“May I possess domestic animals.”
He poured out this caru for Pūṣan, for Revatī.
Then indeed he came to possess domestic animals.
Indeed, he comes to possess domestic animals,
who sacrifices with this oblation
and who likewise knows this thus.
He offers here:
“To Pūṣan hail! To Revatī hail!
To domestic animals hail!”

3.1.5.s: aśvinau vā akāmayetām | śrotrasvināvabadhirau syāveti | tāvetamaśvibhyāmaśvayugbhyāṃ puroḍāśaṃ dvikapālaṃ niravapatām | tato vai tau śrotrasvināvabadhirāvabhavatām | śrotrasvī ha vā abadhiro bhavati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | aśvibhyāg svāhā'śvayugbhyāg svāhā | śrotrāya svāhā śrutyai svāheti
3.1.5.d: अश्विनौ वा अकामयेताम् । श्रोत्रस्विनावबधिरौ स्यावेति । तावेतमश्विभ्यामश्वयुग्भ्यां पुरोडाशं द्विकपालं निरवपताम् । ततो वै तौ श्रोत्रस्विनावबधिरावभवताम् । श्रोत्रस्वी ह वा अबधिरो भवति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । अश्विभ्याग् स्वाहाऽश्वयुग्भ्याग् स्वाहा । श्रोत्राय स्वाहा श्रुत्यै स्वाहेति
3.1.5.m:
The two Aśvins desired:
“May we possess hearing, not be deaf.”
They poured out this two-cup sacrificial cake for the two Aśvins, for the Aśvayujas.
Then indeed they came to possess hearing, not be deaf.
Indeed, he comes to possess hearing, not be deaf,
who sacrifices with this oblation
and who likewise knows this thus.
He offers here:
“To the two Aśvins hail! To the two Aśvayujas hail!
To hearing hail! To hearing hail!”

3.1.5.s: yamo vā akāmayata | pitṛṇāṃ rājyamabhijayeyamiti | sa etaṃ yamāyāpabharaṇībhyaścaruṃ niravapat | tato vai sa pitṛṇāṃ rājyamabhyajayat | samānānāṃ ha vai rājyamabhijayati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | yamāya svāhā'pabharaṇībhyaḥ svāhā | rājyāya svāhā'bhijityai svāheti
3.1.5.d: यमो वा अकामयत । पितृणां राज्यमभिजयेयमिति । स एतं यमायापभरणीभ्यश्चरुं निरवपत् । ततो वै स पितृणां राज्यमभ्यजयत् । समानानां ह वै राज्यमभिजयति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । यमाय स्वाहाऽपभरणीभ्यः स्वाहा । राज्याय स्वाहाऽभिजित्यै स्वाहेति
3.1.5.m:
Yama desired:
“May I win the sovereignty of the ancestors.”
He poured out this caru for Yama, for the Apabharaṇīs.
Then indeed he won the sovereignty of the ancestors.
Indeed, he wins the sovereignty of his equals
who sacrifices with this oblation
and who likewise knows this thus.
He offers here:
“To Yama hail! To the Apabharaṇīs hail!
To sovereignty hail! To conquest hail!”

3.1.5.s: athaitadamāvāsyāyā ājyaṃ nirvapati | kāmo vā amāvāsyā | kāma ājyam | kāmenaiva kāmaṃ samardhayati | kṣipramenaṃ sa kāma upanamati | yena kāmena yajate | so'tra juhoti | amāvāsyāyai svāhā kāmāya svāhā'gatyai svāheti
3.1.5.d: अथैतदमावास्याया आज्यं निर्वपति । कामो वा अमावास्या । काम आज्यम् । कामेनैव कामं समर्धयति । क्षिप्रमेनं स काम उपनमति । येन कामेन यजते । सोऽत्र जुहोति । अमावास्यायै स्वाहा कामाय स्वाहाऽगत्यै स्वाहेति
3.1.5.m:
Now he pours out this clarified butter for the new moon day.
Desire, indeed, is the new moon day;
desire is the clarified butter.
By means of desire, he fulfills desire.
Swiftly does that desire fall to him
with which desire he sacrifices.
He offers here:
“To the new moon day hail! To desire hail! To attainment hail!”

3.1.6.s: candramā vā akāmayata | ahorātrānardhamāsān māsānṛtūnthsaṃvathsaramāptvā | candramasaḥ sāyujyaṃ salokatāmāpnuyāmiti | sa etaṃ candramase pratīdṛśyāyai puroḍāśaṃ pañcadaśakapālaṃ niravapat | tato vai so'horātrānardha māsānmāsānṛtūnthsaṃvathsaramāptvā | candramasaḥ sāyujyaṃ salokatāmāpnot | ahorātrān ha vā ardha māsānmāsānṛtūnthsaṃvathsaramāptvā | candramasaḥ sāyujyaṃ salokatāmāpnoti | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | candramase svāhā pratīdṛśyāyai svāhā | ahorātrebhyaḥ svāhā'rdhamāsebhyaḥ svāhā | māsebhyaḥ svāhārtubhyaḥ svāhā | saṃvathsarāya svāheti
3.1.6.d: चन्द्रमा वा अकामयत । अहोरात्रानर्धमासान् मासानृतून्थ्संवथ्सरमाप्त्वा । चन्द्रमसः सायुज्यं सलोकतामाप्नुयामिति । स एतं चन्द्रमसे प्रतीदृश्यायै पुरोडाशं पञ्चदशकपालं निरवपत् । ततो वै सोऽहोरात्रानर्ध मासान्मासानृतून्थ्संवथ्सरमाप्त्वा । चन्द्रमसः सायुज्यं सलोकतामाप्नोत् । अहोरात्रान् ह वा अर्ध मासान्मासानृतून्थ्संवथ्सरमाप्त्वा । चन्द्रमसः सायुज्यं सलोकतामाप्नोति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । चन्द्रमसे स्वाहा प्रतीदृश्यायै स्वाहा । अहोरात्रेभ्यः स्वाहाऽर्धमासेभ्यः स्वाहा । मासेभ्यः स्वाहार्तुभ्यः स्वाहा । संवथ्सराय स्वाहेति
3.1.6.m:
The moon desired:
“Having obtained the day-and-nights, the half-months, the months, the seasons, the year,
may I obtain unison with the moon, co-residence [with him].”
He poured out this fifteen-cup sacrificial cake for the moon, for Pratīdṛśī.
Then indeed, having obtained the day-and-nights, the half-months, the months, the seasons, the year,
he obtained unison with the moon, co-residence [with him].
Indeed, having obtained the day-and-nights, the half-months, the months, the seasons, the year,
he obtains unison with the moon, co-residence [with him],
who sacrifices with this oblation
and who likewise knows this thus.
He offers here:
“To the moon hail! To Pratīdṛśī hail!
To the day-and-nights hail! To the half-months hail!
To the months hail! To the seasons hail!
To the year hail!”

3.1.6.s: ahorātre vā akāmayetām | atyahorātre mucyevahi | na nāvahorātre āpnuyātāmiti | te etamahorātrābhyāṃ caruṃ niravapatām | dvayānāṃ vrīhīṇām | śuklānāṃ ca kṛṣṇānāṃ ca | savātyordugdhe | śvetāyai ca kṛṣṇāyai ca | tato vai te atyahorātre amucyete | naine ahorātre āpnutām | ati ha vā ahorātre mucyate | nainamahorātre āpnutaḥ | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | ahne svāhā rātriyai svāhā | atimuktyai svāheti
3.1.6.d: अहोरात्रे वा अकामयेताम् । अत्यहोरात्रे मुच्येवहि । न नावहोरात्रे आप्नुयातामिति । ते एतमहोरात्राभ्यां चरुं निरवपताम् । द्वयानां व्रीहीणाम् । शुक्लानां च कृष्णानां च । सवात्योर्दुग्धे । श्वेतायै च कृष्णायै च । ततो वै ते अत्यहोरात्रे अमुच्येते । नैने अहोरात्रे आप्नुताम् । अति ह वा अहोरात्रे मुच्यते । नैनमहोरात्रे आप्नुतः । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । अह्ने स्वाहा रात्रियै स्वाहा । अतिमुक्त्यै स्वाहेति
3.1.6.m:
Day and night desired:
“May we two be released beyond day and night;
may day and night not overtake us two.”
They poured out this caru for day and night,
of two kinds of rice,
both white and black,
in the milk of two calving at the same time,
both of a white and of a black [cow].
Then indeed they two were released beyond day and night;
day and night did not overtake them two.
Indeed, he is released beyond day and night;
day and night do not overtake him,
who sacrifices with this oblation
and who likewise knows this thus.
He offers here:
“To day hail! To night hail!
To release beyond hail!”

3.1.6.s: uṣā vā akāmayata | priyā''dityasya subhagā syāmiti | saitamuṣase caruṃ niravapat | tato vai sā priyā''dityasya subhagā'bhavat | priyo ha vai samānānāṃ subhago bhavati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | uṣase svāhā vyuṣṭyai svāhā | vyūṣuṣyai svāhā vyucchantyai svāhā | vyuṣṭāyai svāheti
3.1.6.d: उषा वा अकामयत । प्रिया'ऽदित्यस्य सुभगा स्यामिति । सैतमुषसे चरुं निरवपत् । ततो वै सा प्रिया'ऽदित्यस्य सुभगाऽभवत् । प्रियो ह वै समानानां सुभगो भवति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । उषसे स्वाहा व्युष्ट्यै स्वाहा । व्यूषुष्यै स्वाहा व्युच्छन्त्यै स्वाहा । व्युष्टायै स्वाहेति
3.1.6.m:
The dawn desired:
“May I be dear to the sun, fortunate.”
She poured out this caru for the dawn.
Then indeed she became dear to the sun, fortunate.
Indeed, he becomes dear to his equals, fortunate,
who sacrifices with this oblation
and who likewise knows this thus.
He offers here:
“To the dawn hail! To the dawning hail!
To the one that has dawned hail! To the one dawning hail!
To the dawned hail!”

3.1.6.s: athaitasmai nakṣattrāya caruṃ nirvapati | yathā tvaṃ devānāmasi | evamahaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ bhūyāsamiti | yathā ha vā etaddevānām | evaṃ ha vā eṣa manuṣyāṇāṃ bhavati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | nakṣattrāya svāhodeṣyate svāhā | udyate svāhoditāya svāhā | harase svāhā bharase svāhā | bhrājase svāhā tejase svāhā | tapase svāhā brahmavarcasāya svāheti
3.1.6.d: अथैतस्मै नक्षत्त्राय चरुं निर्वपति । यथा त्वं देवानामसि । एवमहं मनुष्याणां भूयासमिति । यथा ह वा एतद्देवानाम् । एवं ह वा एष मनुष्याणां भवति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । नक्षत्त्राय स्वाहोदेष्यते स्वाहा । उद्यते स्वाहोदिताय स्वाहा । हरसे स्वाहा भरसे स्वाहा । भ्राजसे स्वाहा तेजसे स्वाहा । तपसे स्वाहा ब्रह्मवर्चसाय स्वाहेति
3.1.6.m: Then he offers a boiled rice mess to this lunar mansion, [praying:] / 'As you are among the gods, / so may I be among men.' / Just as this [lunar mansion is] among the gods, / so indeed does he become among men, / who sacrifices with this oblation, / and who thus knows this. / Here he offers [an oblation with the formula]: / 'To the lunar mansion, svāhā! To the one about to rise, svāhā! / To the rising one, svāhā! To the risen one, svāhā! / To heat, svāhā! To support, svāhā! / To radiance, svāhā! To fiery energy, svāhā! / To heat-austerity, svāhā! To spiritual preeminence, svāhā!'

3.1.6.s: sūryo vā akāmayata | nakṣattrāṇāṃ pratiṣṭhā syāmiti | sa etaṃ sūryāya nakṣattrebhyaścaruṃ niravapat | tato vai sa nakṣattrāṇāṃ pratiṣṭhā'bhavat | pratiṣṭhā ha vai samānānāṃ bhavati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainadevaṃ veda | so'tra juhoti | sūryāya svāhā nakṣattrebhyaḥ svāhā | pratiṣṭhāyai svāheti
3.1.6.d: सूर्यो वा अकामयत । नक्षत्त्राणां प्रतिष्ठा स्यामिति । स एतं सूर्याय नक्षत्त्रेभ्यश्चरुं निरवपत् । ततो वै स नक्षत्त्राणां प्रतिष्ठाऽभवत् । प्रतिष्ठा ह वै समानानां भवति । य एतेन हविषा यजते । य उ चैनदेवं वेद । सोऽत्र जुहोति । सूर्याय स्वाहा नक्षत्त्रेभ्यः स्वाहा । प्रतिष्ठायै स्वाहेति
3.1.6.m: Sūrya, indeed, desired: / 'May I be the foundation of the lunar mansions.' / He offered this boiled rice mess to Sūrya [and] to the lunar mansions. / Then, indeed, he became the foundation of the lunar mansions. / A foundation of his peers, indeed, he becomes, / who sacrifices with this oblation, / and who thus knows this. / Here he offers [with the formula]: / 'To Sūrya, svāhā! To the lunar mansions, svāhā! / To the foundation, svāhā!'

3.1.6.s: athaitamadityai caruṃ nirvapati | iyaṃ vā aditiḥ | asyāmeva pratitiṣṭhati | so'tra juhoti | adityai svāhā pratiṣṭhāyai svāheti
3.1.6.d: अथैतमदित्यै चरुं निर्वपति । इयं वा अदितिः । अस्यामेव प्रतितिष्ठति । सोऽत्र जुहोति । अदित्यै स्वाहा प्रतिष्ठायै स्वाहेति
3.1.6.m: Then he offers this boiled rice mess to Aditi. / This [earth], indeed, is Aditi. / On this [earth] indeed he becomes established. / Here he offers [with the formula]: / 'To Aditi, svāhā! To the foundation, svāhā!'

3.1.6.s: athaitaṃ viṣṇave caruṃ nirvapati | yajño vai viṣṇuḥ | yajña evāntataḥ pratitiṣṭhati | so'tra juhoti | viṣṇave svāhā yajñāya svāhā | pratiṣṭhāyai svāheti
3.1.6.d: अथैतं विष्णवे चरुं निर्वपति । यज्ञो वै विष्णुः । यज्ञ एवान्ततः प्रतितिष्ठति । सोऽत्र जुहोति । विष्णवे स्वाहा यज्ञाय स्वाहा । प्रतिष्ठायै स्वाहेति
3.1.6.m: Then he offers this boiled rice mess to Viṣṇu. / The sacrifice, indeed, is Viṣṇu. / In the sacrifice itself he ultimately becomes established. / Here he offers [with the formula]: / 'To Viṣṇu, svāhā! To the sacrifice, svāhā! / To the foundation, svāhā!'

3.2.1.s: tṛtīyasyāmito divi soma āsīt | taṃ gāyatryā'harat | tasya parṇamacchidyata | tatparṇo'bhavat | tatparṇasya parṇatvam | brahma vai parṇaḥ | yatparṇaśākhayā vathsānapākaroti | brahmaṇaivainānapākaroti | gāyatro vai parṇaḥ | gāyatrāḥ paśavaḥ
3.2.1.d: तृतीयस्यामितो दिवि सोम आसीत् । तं गायत्र्याऽहरत् । तस्य पर्णमच्छिद्यत । तत्पर्णोऽभवत् । तत्पर्णस्य पर्णत्वम् । ब्रह्म वै पर्णः । यत्पर्णशाखया वथ्सानपाकरोति । ब्रह्मणैवैनानपाकरोति । गायत्रो वै पर्णः । गायत्राः पशवः
3.2.1.m: Soma was in the third heaven from here. / The Gāyatrī brought it. / A leaf of it was cut off. / That became the parṇa tree. / That is the parṇa-nature of the parṇa tree. / The parṇa, indeed, is brahman. / When he drives away the calves with a parṇa branch, / he drives them away with brahman itself. / The parṇa tree is connected with the Gāyatrī. / Domestic animals are connected with the Gāyatrī.

3.2.1.s: tasmāttrīṇi trīṇi parṇasya palāśāni | tripadā gāyatrī | yatparṇaśākhayā gāḥ prārpayati | svayaivainā devatayā prārpayati | yaṃ kāmayetāpaśuḥ syāditi | aparṇāṃ tasmai śuṣkāgrāmāharet | apaśureva bhavati | yaṃ kāmayeta paśumānthsyāditi | bahuparṇāṃ tasmai bahuśākhāmāharet | paśumantamevainaṃ karoti
3.2.1.d: तस्मात्त्रीणि त्रीणि पर्णस्य पलाशानि । त्रिपदा गायत्री । यत्पर्णशाखया गाः प्रार्पयति । स्वयैवैना देवतया प्रार्पयति । यं कामयेतापशुः स्यादिति । अपर्णां तस्मै शुष्काग्रामाहरेत् । अपशुरेव भवति । यं कामयेत पशुमान्थ्स्यादिति । बहुपर्णां तस्मै बहुशाखामाहरेत् । पशुमन्तमेवैनं करोति
3.2.1.m: Therefore the parṇa tree has leaves by threes. / The Gāyatrī has three feet. / When he sets the cows in motion with a parṇa branch, / he sets them in motion with their own deity. / If he should desire of someone, 'May he be without domestic animals,' / he should bring for him [a branch] without leaves, whose tip is dry. / He indeed becomes without domestic animals. / If he should desire of someone, 'May he have domestic animals,' / he should bring for him [a branch] with many leaves, with many twigs. / He makes him possess domestic animals.

3.2.1.s: yatprācīmāharet | devalokamabhijayet | yadudīcīṃ manuṣyalokam | prācīmudīcīmāharati | ubhayorlokayorabhijityai | iṣe tvorje tvetyāha | iṣamevorjaṃ yajamāne dadhāti | vāyavaḥ sthetyāha | vāyurvā antarikṣasyādhyakṣāḥ | antarikṣadevatyāḥ khalu vai paśavaḥ
3.2.1.d: यत्प्राचीमाहरेत् । देवलोकमभिजयेत् । यदुदीचीं मनुष्यलोकम् । प्राचीमुदीचीमाहरति । उभयोर्लोकयोरभिजित्यै । इषे त्वोर्जे त्वेत्याह । इषमेवोर्जं यजमाने दधाति । वायवः स्थेत्याह । वायुर्वा अन्तरिक्षस्याध्यक्षाः । अन्तरिक्षदेवत्याः खलु वै पशवः
3.2.1.m: If he should bring one facing east, / he would win the realm of the gods; / if facing north, the realm of men. / He brings one facing northeast, / for the winning of both realms. / He says: 'For refreshment, thee! For vigor, thee!' / He places refreshment and vigor in the sacrificer. / He says: 'Ye are the winds.' / Vāyu, indeed, is the overseer of the atmosphere. / Domestic animals indeed have the atmosphere as their deity.

3.2.1.s: vāyava evainānparidadāti | pra vā enānetadākaroti | yadāha | vāyavaḥ sthetyupāyavaḥ sthetyāha | yajamānāyaiva paśūnupahvayate | devo vaḥ savitā prārpayatvityāha prasūtyai | śreṣṭhatamāya karmaṇa ityāha | yajño hi śreṣṭhatamaṃ karma | tasmādevamāha | āpyāyadhvamaghniyā devabhāgamityāha
3.2.1.d: वायव एवैनान्परिददाति । प्र वा एनानेतदाकरोति । यदाह । वायवः स्थेत्युपायवः स्थेत्याह । यजमानायैव पशूनुपह्वयते । देवो वः सविता प्रार्पयत्वित्याह प्रसूत्यै । श्रेष्ठतमाय कर्मण इत्याह । यज्ञो हि श्रेष्ठतमं कर्म । तस्मादेवमाह । आप्यायध्वमघ्निया देवभागमित्याह
3.2.1.m: He entrusts them to Vāyu himself. / He brings them forth [and] drives them forward with this. / That he says, / 'Ye are the winds,' [and] says, 'ye are approaching,' / he summons the domestic animals for the sacrificer himself. / He says: 'May the divine Savitṛ set you in motion,' for impulse; / he says: 'for the supreme work.' / The sacrifice, indeed, is the supreme work. / Therefore he speaks thus. / He says: 'Swell, O inviolable ones, for the gods' portion.'

3.2.1.s: vathsebhyaśca vā etāḥ purā manuṣyebhyaścāpyāyanta | devebhya evainā indrāyāpyāyayati | ūrjasvatīḥ payasvatīrityāha | ūrjaṃ hi payaḥ saṃbharanti | prajāvatīranamīvā ayakṣmā ityāha prajātyai | mā vaḥ stena īśata mā'ghaśaṃsa ityāha guptyai | rudrasya hetiḥ pari vo vṛṇaktvityāha | rudrādevaināstrāyate | dhruvā asmingopatau syāta bahvīrityāha | dhruvā evāsminbahvīḥ karoti
3.2.1.d: वथ्सेभ्यश्च वा एताः पुरा मनुष्येभ्यश्चाप्यायन्त । देवेभ्य एवैना इन्द्रायाप्याययति । ऊर्जस्वतीः पयस्वतीरित्याह । ऊर्जं हि पयः संभरन्ति । प्रजावतीरनमीवा अयक्ष्मा इत्याह प्रजात्यै । मा वः स्तेन ईशत माऽघशंस इत्याह गुप्त्यै । रुद्रस्य हेतिः परि वो वृणक्त्वित्याह । रुद्रादेवैनास्त्रायते । ध्रुवा अस्मिन्गोपतौ स्यात बह्वीरित्याह । ध्रुवा एवास्मिन्बह्वीः करोति
3.2.1.m: Formerly they used to swell for the calves and for men. / He makes them swell for the gods, for Indra. / He says: 'Full of vigor, full of milk.' / For they bring together vigor and milk. / He says: 'Possessing offspring, free from disease, free from consumption,' for procreation. / He says: 'May no thief overpower you, no ill-wisher,' for protection. / He says: 'May Rudra’s missile avoid you.' / He protects them from Rudra himself. / He says: 'May ye be steadfast and numerous with this lord of cattle.' / He makes them steadfast and numerous with him.

3.2.1.s: yajamānasya paśūnpāhītyāha | paśūnāṃ gopīthāya | tasmāthsāyaṃ paśava upasamāvartante | anadhaḥ sādayati | garbhāṇāṃ dhṛtyā aprapādāya | tasmādgarbhāḥ prajānāmaprapādukāḥ | uparīva nidadhāti | uparīva hi suvargo lokaḥ | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai
3.2.1.d: यजमानस्य पशून्पाहीत्याह । पशूनां गोपीथाय । तस्माथ्सायं पशव उपसमावर्तन्ते । अनधः सादयति । गर्भाणां धृत्या अप्रपादाय । तस्माद्गर्भाः प्रजानामप्रपादुकाः । उपरीव निदधाति । उपरीव हि सुवर्गो लोकः । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै
3.2.1.m: He says: 'Guard the domestic animals of the sacrificer,' / for the protection of the domestic animals. / Therefore domestic animals return home in the evening. / He sets [the branch] down, not below, / for the holding of the embryos, so that they do not miscarry. / Therefore the embryos of offspring do not miscarry. / He deposits it as if above. / For the heavenly realm is as if above, / for the attainment of the heavenly realm.

3.2.2.s: devasya tvā savituḥ prasava ityaśvaparśumādatte prasūtyai | aśvinorbāhubhyāmityāha | aśvinau hi devānāmadhvaryū āstām | pūṣṇo hastābhyāmityāha yatyai | yo vā oṣadhīḥ parvaśo veda | naināḥ sa hinasti | prajāpatirvā oṣadhīḥ parvaśo veda | sa enā na hinasti | aśvaparśvā barhiracchaiti | prājāpatyo vā aśvaḥ sayonitvāya
3.2.2.d: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसव इत्यश्वपर्शुमादत्ते प्रसूत्यै । अश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यामित्याह । अश्विनौ हि देवानामध्वर्यू आस्ताम् । पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यामित्याह यत्यै । यो वा ओषधीः पर्वशो वेद । नैनाः स हिनस्ति । प्रजापतिर्वा ओषधीः पर्वशो वेद । स एना न हिनस्ति । अश्वपर्श्वा बर्हिरच्छैति । प्राजापत्यो वा अश्वः सयोनित्वाय
3.2.2.m: With 'At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ,' he takes the horse-rib, for impulse. / He says: 'With the arms of the Aśvins.' / For the Aśvins were the two Adhvaryu priests of the gods. / He says: 'With the hands of Pūṣan,' for restraint. / Whoever knows the plants joint by joint, / he does not injure them. / Prajāpati knows the plants joint by joint; / he does not injure them. With the horse-rib he goes to the sacred grass. / The horse is related to Prajāpati, for having the same origin,

3.2.2.s: oṣadhīnāmahiṃsāyai | yajñasya ghoṣadasītyāha | yajamāna eva rayiṃ dadhāti | pratyuṣṭaṃ rakṣaḥ pratyuṣṭā arātaya ityāha | rakṣasāmapahatyai | preyamagāddhiṣaṇā barhiracchetyāha | vidyā vai dhiṣaṇā | vidyayaivainadacchaiti | manunā kṛtā svadhayā vitaṣṭetyāha | mānavī hi parśuḥ svadhā kṛtā
3.2.2.d: ओषधीनामहिंसायै । यज्ञस्य घोषदसीत्याह । यजमान एव रयिं दधाति । प्रत्युष्टं रक्षः प्रत्युष्टा अरातय इत्याह । रक्षसामपहत्यै । प्रेयमगाद्धिषणा बर्हिरच्छेत्याह । विद्या वै धिषणा । विद्ययैवैनदच्छैति । मनुना कृता स्वधया वितष्टेत्याह । मानवी हि पर्शुः स्वधा कृता
3.2.2.m: for the non-injury of the plants. / He says: 'Thou art the proclaiming of the sacrifice.' / He places wealth in the sacrificer himself. / He says: 'Scorched is the demon, scorched are the adversaries,' / for the destruction of the demons. / He says: 'Forward has this Dhiṣaṇā gone to the sacred grass.' / Dhiṣaṇā, indeed, is sacred knowledge. / By sacred knowledge itself he goes to it. / He says: 'Fashioned by Manu, shaped by own-nature.' / For the rib is human, shaped by own-nature.

3.2.2.s: ta āvahanti kavayaḥ purastādityāha | śuśruvāṃso vai kavayaḥ | yajñaḥ purastāt | mukhata eva yajñamārabhate | atho yadetaduktvā yataḥ kutaścāharati | tatprācyā eva diśo bhavati | devebhyo juṣṭamiha barhirāsada ityāha | barhiṣaḥ samṛddhyai | karmaṇo'naparādhāya | devānāṃ pariṣūtamasītyāha
3.2.2.d: त आवहन्ति कवयः पुरस्तादित्याह । शुश्रुवांसो वै कवयः । यज्ञः पुरस्तात् । मुखत एव यज्ञमारभते । अथो यदेतदुक्त्वा यतः कुतश्चाहरति । तत्प्राच्या एव दिशो भवति । देवेभ्यो जुष्टमिह बर्हिरासद इत्याह । बर्हिषः समृद्ध्यै । कर्मणोऽनपराधाय । देवानां परिषूतमसीत्याह
3.2.2.m: He says: 'They bring [it] from the front, the wise poets.' / For the wise poets are the learned. / The sacrifice is in front. / From the face itself he begins the sacrifice. / Furthermore, having spoken this, from wherever he brings [it], / that comes from the eastern direction itself. / He says: 'Pleasing to the gods, to sit here on the sacred grass,' / for the success of the sacred grass, / for the non-failure of the rite. / He says: 'Thou art spurred on by the gods.'

3.2.2.s: yadvā idaṃ kiṃca | taddevānāṃ pariṣūtam | atho yathā vasyase pratiprocyāhedaṃ kariṣyāmīti | evameva tadadhvaryurdevebhyaḥ pratiprocya barhirdāti | ātmano'hiṃsāyai | yāvataḥ stambānparidiśet | yatteṣāmucchiggṣyāt | ati tadyajñasya recayet | ekaṃ stambaṃ paridiśet | taṃ sarvaṃ dāyāt
3.2.2.d: यद्वा इदं किंच । तद्देवानां परिषूतम् । अथो यथा वस्यसे प्रतिप्रोच्याहेदं करिष्यामीति । एवमेव तदध्वर्युर्देवेभ्यः प्रतिप्रोच्य बर्हिर्दाति । आत्मनोऽहिंसायै । यावतः स्तम्बान्परिदिशेत् । यत्तेषामुच्छिग्ग्ष्यात् । अति तद्यज्ञस्य रेचयेत् । एकं स्तम्बं परिदिशेत् । तं सर्वं दायात्
3.2.2.m: For whatever there is here, / that is spurred on by the gods. / Moreover, just as one, having announced to a superior, says, 'I will do this,' / just so indeed does the Adhvaryu, having announced to the gods, cut the sacred grass, / for the non-injury of himself. / As many clumps as he should encompass, / if he should leave any of them over, / that would leave a surplus in the sacrifice. / He should encompass one clump; / he should cut that entirely,

3.2.2.s: yajñasyānatirekāya | varṣavṛddhamasītyāha | varṣavṛddhā vā oṣadhayaḥ | deva barhirityāha | devebhya evainatkaroti | mā tvā'nvaṅmā tiryagityāhāhiṃsāyai | parvate rādhyāsamityāharddhyai | ācchettā te māriṣamityāha | nāsyātmano mīyate | ya evaṃ veda
3.2.2.d: यज्ञस्यानतिरेकाय । वर्षवृद्धमसीत्याह । वर्षवृद्धा वा ओषधयः । देव बर्हिरित्याह । देवेभ्य एवैनत्करोति । मा त्वाऽन्वङ्मा तिर्यगित्याहाहिंसायै । पर्वते राध्यासमित्याहर्द्ध्यै । आच्छेत्ता ते मारिषमित्याह । नास्यात्मनो मीयते । य एवं वेद
3.2.2.m: for the non-excess of the sacrifice. / He says: 'Grown by the rains art thou.' / For plants are grown by the rains. / He says: 'O divine sacred grass.' / He makes it belong to the gods themselves. / He says: 'Not forward, not across,' for non-injury. / He says: 'May I succeed in [cutting] thy joint,' for success. / He says: 'May I, the cutter, not suffer harm.' / No part of his self is harmed, / who knows thus.

3.2.2.s: deva barhiḥ śatavalśaṃ virohetyāha | prajā vai barhiḥ | prajānāṃ prajananāya | sahasravalśā vi vayaṃ ruhemetyāha | āśiṣamevaitāmāśāste | pṛthivyāḥ saṃpṛcaḥ pāhītyāha pratiṣṭhityai | ayuṅgā'yuṅgānmuṣṭīnlunoti | mithunatvāya prajātyai | susaṃbhṛtā tvā saṃbharāmītyāha | brahmaṇaivainathsaṃbharati
3.2.2.d: देव बर्हिः शतवल्शं विरोहेत्याह । प्रजा वै बर्हिः । प्रजानां प्रजननाय । सहस्रवल्शा वि वयं रुहेमेत्याह । आशिषमेवैतामाशास्ते । पृथिव्याः संपृचः पाहीत्याह प्रतिष्ठित्यै । अयुङ्गाऽयुङ्गान्मुष्टीन्लुनोति । मिथुनत्वाय प्रजात्यै । सुसंभृता त्वा संभरामीत्याह । ब्रह्मणैवैनथ्संभरति
3.2.2.m: "O divine barhis, sprout with a hundred shoots!" he says. / The barhis is offspring. / [It is] for the procreation of offspring. / "May we sprout with a thousand shoots!" he says. / He thereby invokes this very blessing. / "Protect [it] from contact with the earth!" he says, for stability. / He cuts the handfuls in pairs. / [It is] for copulation, for propagation. / "Well-gathered, I gather you," he says. / With brahman indeed he gathers it.

3.2.2.s: adityai rāsnā'sītyāha | iyaṃ vā aditiḥ | asyā evainadrāsnāṃ karoti | indrāṇyai saṃnahanamityāha | indrāṇī vā agre devatānāṃ samanahyata | sā''rdhnot | ṛddhyai sannahyati | prajā vai barhiḥ | prajānāmaparāvāpāya | tasmāthsnāvasaṃtatāḥ prajā jāyante
3.2.2.d: अदित्यै रास्नाऽसीत्याह । इयं वा अदितिः । अस्या एवैनद्रास्नां करोति । इन्द्राण्यै संनहनमित्याह । इन्द्राणी वा अग्रे देवतानां समनह्यत । सा'ऽर्ध्नोत् । ऋद्ध्यै सन्नह्यति । प्रजा वै बर्हिः । प्रजानामपरावापाय । तस्माथ्स्नावसंतताः प्रजा जायन्ते
3.2.2.m: "You are Aditi's girdle," he says. / Aditi is this [earth]. / He makes it her very girdle. / "Indrāṇī's cord," he says. / Indrāṇī indeed girded herself at the head of the deities. / She prospered. / He ties [it] for prosperity. / The barhis is offspring. / [It is] so that offspring do not fall away. / Therefore offspring are born bound by sinews.

3.2.2.s: pūṣā te granthiṃ grathnātvityāha | puṣṭimeva yajamāne dadhāti | sa te mā''sthādityāhāhiṃsāyai | paścātprāñcamupa gūhati | paścādvai prācīnaṃ reto dhīyate | paścādevāsmai prācīnaṃ reto dadhāti | indrasya tvā bāhubhyāmudyaccha ityāha | indriyameva yajamāne dadhāti | bṛhaspatermūrdhnā harāmītyāha | brahma vai devānāṃ bṛhaspatiḥ
3.2.2.d: पूषा ते ग्रन्थिं ग्रथ्नात्वित्याह । पुष्टिमेव यजमाने दधाति । स ते मा'ऽस्थादित्याहाहिंसायै । पश्चात्प्राञ्चमुप गूहति । पश्चाद्वै प्राचीनं रेतो धीयते । पश्चादेवास्मै प्राचीनं रेतो दधाति । इन्द्रस्य त्वा बाहुभ्यामुद्यच्छ इत्याह । इन्द्रियमेव यजमाने दधाति । बृहस्पतेर्मूर्ध्ना हरामीत्याह । ब्रह्म वै देवानां बृहस्पतिः
3.2.2.m: "May Pūṣan tie your knot," he says. / He thereby places nourishment in the sacrificer. / "May it not harm you," he says, for non-injury. He tucks [the ends] eastward behind. / Behind, indeed, eastward, semen is deposited. / Behind, indeed, eastward, he deposits semen for him. / "With Indra's two arms I lift you up," he says. / He thereby places indriya in the sacrificer. / "With Bṛhaspati's head I carry [you]," he says. / Bṛhaspati is the brahman of the gods.

3.2.2.s: brahmaṇaivainaddharati | urvantarikṣamanvihītyāha gatyai | devaṃgamamasītyāha | devānevainadgamayati | anadhaḥ sādayati | garbhāṇāṃ dhṛtyā aprapādāya | tasmādgarbhāḥ prajānāmaprapādukāḥ | uparīva nidadhāti | uparīva hi suvargo lokaḥ | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai
3.2.2.d: ब्रह्मणैवैनद्धरति । उर्वन्तरिक्षमन्विहीत्याह गत्यै । देवंगममसीत्याह । देवानेवैनद्गमयति । अनधः सादयति । गर्भाणां धृत्या अप्रपादाय । तस्माद्गर्भाः प्रजानामप्रपादुकाः । उपरीव निदधाति । उपरीव हि सुवर्गो लोकः । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै
3.2.2.m: With brahman indeed he carries it. / "Go along the wide atmosphere!" he says, for movement. / "You are going to the gods," he says. / He makes it go to the gods. / He sets [it] down not below. / For the holding of embryos, so they do not miscarry. / Therefore the embryos of creatures do not miscarry. / He places it, as it were, above. / For the heavenly realm is above, as it were. / [It is] for the attainment of the heavenly realm.

3.2.3.s: pūrvedyuridhmābarhiḥ karoti | yajñamevārabhya gṛhītvopavasati | prajāpatiryajñamasṛjata | tasyokhe asraṃsetām | yajño vai prajāpatiḥ | yathsāṃnnāyyokhe bhavataḥ | yajñasyaiva tadukhe upadadhātyaprasraṃsāya | śundhadhvaṃ daivyāya karmaṇe devayajyāyā ityāha | devayajyāyā evaināni śundhati | mātariśvano gharmo'sītyāha
3.2.3.d: पूर्वेद्युरिध्माबर्हिः करोति । यज्ञमेवारभ्य गृहीत्वोपवसति । प्रजापतिर्यज्ञमसृजत । तस्योखे अस्रंसेताम् । यज्ञो वै प्रजापतिः । यथ्सांन्नाय्योखे भवतः । यज्ञस्यैव तदुखे उपदधात्यप्रस्रंसाय । शुन्धध्वं दैव्याय कर्मणे देवयज्याया इत्याह । देवयज्याया एवैनानि शुन्धति । मातरिश्वनो घर्मोऽसीत्याह
3.2.3.m: On the previous day, he prepares the firewood and the barhis. / Taking hold of the sacrifice, having grasped [it], he fastens [it] and fasts. / Prajāpati created the sacrifice. / His two cooking pots collapsed. / Prajāpati is the sacrifice. / In that there are two cooking pots for the sāṃnāyya, / he sets the sacrifice's two cooking pots for its non-collapsing. / "Purify yourselves for the divine rite, for sacrifice to the gods!" he says. / He purifies them for sacrifice to the gods. / "You are Mātariśvan's cauldron," he says.

3.2.3.s: antarikṣaṃ vai mātariśvano gharmaḥ | eṣāṃ lokānāṃ vidhṛtyai | dyaurasi pṛthivyasītyāha | divaśca hyeṣā pṛthivyāśca saṃbhṛtā | yadukhā | tasmādevamāha | viśvadhāyā asi parameṇa dhāmnetyāha | vṛṣṭirvai viśvadhāyāḥ | vṛṣṭimevāvarundhe | dṛṃhasva mā hvārityāha dhṛtyai
3.2.3.d: अन्तरिक्षं वै मातरिश्वनो घर्मः । एषां लोकानां विधृत्यै । द्यौरसि पृथिव्यसीत्याह । दिवश्च ह्येषा पृथिव्याश्च संभृता । यदुखा । तस्मादेवमाह । विश्वधाया असि परमेण धाम्नेत्याह । वृष्टिर्वै विश्वधायाः । वृष्टिमेवावरुन्धे । दृंहस्व मा ह्वारित्याह धृत्यै
3.2.3.m: Mātariśvan's cauldron is the atmosphere, / for the separation of these worlds. / "You are heaven, you are earth," he says. / For from heaven and earth it has been gathered, / which is the cooking pot. / Therefore he says thus. / "You are all-sustaining by the highest station," he says. / The all-sustaining is rain. / He secures rain. / "Be firm, do not stagger!" he says, for stability.

3.2.3.s: vasūnāṃ pavitramasītyāha | prāṇā vai vasavaḥ | teṣāṃ vā etadbhāgadheyam | yatpavitram | tebhya evainatkaroti | śatadhāraṃ sahasradhāramityāha | prāṇeṣvevāyurdadhāti sarvatvāya | trivṛtpalāśa śākhāyāṃ darbhamayaṃ bhavati | trivṛdvai prāṇaḥ | trivṛtameva prāṇaṃ madhyato yajamāne dadhāti
3.2.3.d: वसूनां पवित्रमसीत्याह । प्राणा वै वसवः । तेषां वा एतद्भागधेयम् । यत्पवित्रम् । तेभ्य एवैनत्करोति । शतधारं सहस्रधारमित्याह । प्राणेष्वेवायुर्दधाति सर्वत्वाय । त्रिवृत्पलाश शाखायां दर्भमयं भवति । त्रिवृद्वै प्राणः । त्रिवृतमेव प्राणं मध्यतो यजमाने दधाति
3.2.3.m: "You are the filter of the Vasus," he says. / The Vasus are the vital breaths. / This is their share, / namely the filter. / He makes it for them. / "Possessing a hundred streams, a thousand streams," he says. / He places lifespan in the vital breaths for completeness. / It is threefold, made of darbha grass, on a palāśa branch. / The vital breath is threefold. / He places the threefold vital breath right in the middle of the sacrificer.

3.2.3.s: saumyaḥ parṇaḥ sayonitvāya | sākṣātpavitraṃ darbhāḥ | prākhsāyamadhinidadhāti | tatprāṇāpānayo rūpam | tiryakprātaḥ | taddarśasya rūpam | dārśyaṃ hyetadahaḥ | annaṃ vai candramāḥ | annaṃ prāṇāḥ | ubhayamevopaityajāmitvāya
3.2.3.d: सौम्यः पर्णः सयोनित्वाय । साक्षात्पवित्रं दर्भाः । प्राख्सायमधिनिदधाति । तत्प्राणापानयो रूपम् । तिर्यक्प्रातः । तद्दर्शस्य रूपम् । दार्श्यं ह्येतदहः । अन्नं वै चन्द्रमाः । अन्नं प्राणाः । उभयमेवोपैत्यजामित्वाय
3.2.3.m: The parṇa [leaf] belongs to Soma, for sharing the same origin. / Darbha grass is directly a filter. / In the evening, he places it facing east. / That is the form of exhalation and inhalation. / Crosswise in the morning. / That is the form of the new moon. / For this day pertains to the new moon. / The moon is food. / The vital breaths are food. / He attains both, for non-monotony.

3.2.3.s: tasmādayaṃ sarvataḥ pavate | hutaḥ stoko huto drapsa ityāha pratiṣṭhityai | haviṣo'skandāya | na hi hutaṃ svāhākṛtagg skandati | divi nāko nāmāgniḥ | tasya vipruṣo bhāgadheyam | agnaye bṛhate nākāyetyāha | nākamevāgniṃ bhāgadheyena samardhayati | svāhā dyāvāpṛthivībhyāmityāha | dyāvāpṛthivyorevainat pratiṣṭhāpayati
3.2.3.d: तस्मादयं सर्वतः पवते । हुतः स्तोको हुतो द्रप्स इत्याह प्रतिष्ठित्यै । हविषोऽस्कन्दाय । न हि हुतं स्वाहाकृतग्ग् स्कन्दति । दिवि नाको नामाग्निः । तस्य विप्रुषो भागधेयम् । अग्नये बृहते नाकायेत्याह । नाकमेवाग्निं भागधेयेन समर्धयति । स्वाहा द्यावापृथिवीभ्यामित्याह । द्यावापृथिव्योरेवैनत् प्रतिष्ठापयति
3.2.3.m: Therefore this [wind] purifies from all sides. / "Offered is the drop, offered is the droplet," he says, for stability, / so that the oblation does not spill. / For what is offered and consecrated with svāhā does not spill. / In heaven is the fire named Nāka. / His share is the splatterings. / "To Agni, to the great Nāka," he says. / He makes Agni Nāka prosper with his share. / "Svāhā to heaven and earth!" he says. / He establishes it in heaven and earth.

3.2.3.s: pavitravatyānayati | apāṃ caivauṣadhīnāṃ ca rasaṃ saṃsṛjati | atho oṣadhīṣveva paśūnpratiṣṭhāpayati | anvārabhya vācaṃ yacchati | yajñasya dhṛtyai | dhārayannāste | dhārayanta iva hi duhanti | kāmadhukṣa ityāhā tṛtīyasyai | traya ime lokāḥ | imāneva lokān yajamāno duhe
3.2.3.d: पवित्रवत्यानयति । अपां चैवौषधीनां च रसं संसृजति । अथो ओषधीष्वेव पशून्प्रतिष्ठापयति । अन्वारभ्य वाचं यच्छति । यज्ञस्य धृत्यै । धारयन्नास्ते । धारयन्त इव हि दुहन्ति । कामधुक्ष इत्याहा तृतीयस्यै । त्रय इमे लोकाः । इमानेव लोकान् यजमानो दुहे
3.2.3.m: He pours [the milk] through the filter. / He unites the sap of water and plants. / And he establishes the domestic animals in the plants. / Taking hold [of the pot], he restrains his speech, / for the holding of the sacrifice. / He remains holding it. / For they milk [the cows] holding [the vessel], as it were. / "Whom have you milked?" he says up to the third [cow]. / Three are these worlds. / The sacrificer milks these worlds.

3.2.3.s: amūmiti nāma gṛhṇāti | bhadramevāsāṃ karmāviṣkaroti | sā viśvāyuḥ sā viśvavyacāḥ sā viśvakarmetyāha | iyaṃ vai viśvāyuḥ | antarikṣaṃ viśvavyacāḥ | asau viśvakarmā | imānevaitābhirlokān yathāpūrvaṃ duhe | atho yathā pradātre puṇyamāśāste | evamevainā etadupastauti | tasmātprādādityunnīya vandamānā upastuvantaḥ paśūnduhanti
3.2.3.d: अमूमिति नाम गृह्णाति । भद्रमेवासां कर्माविष्करोति । सा विश्वायुः सा विश्वव्यचाः सा विश्वकर्मेत्याह । इयं वै विश्वायुः । अन्तरिक्षं विश्वव्यचाः । असौ विश्वकर्मा । इमानेवैताभिर्लोकान् यथापूर्वं दुहे । अथो यथा प्रदात्रे पुण्यमाशास्ते । एवमेवैना एतदुपस्तौति । तस्मात्प्रादादित्युन्नीय वन्दमाना उपस्तुवन्तः पशून्दुहन्ति
3.2.3.m: He utters the name, saying, "Such-and-such." / He reveals their good work. / "She is Viśvāyus, she is Viśvavyacas, she is Viśvakarma," he says. / This [earth] is Viśvāyus. / The atmosphere is Viśvavyacas. / Yonder [heaven] is Viśvakarma. / With these [words] he milks these worlds in order. / And just as one wishes good fortune to a giver, / even so he praises them. / Therefore, concluding, "She has given," praising and honoring [them], they milk the domestic animals.

3.2.3.s: bahu dugdhīndrāya devebhyo haviriti vācaṃ visṛjate | yathādevatameva prasauti | daivyasya ca mānuṣasya ca vyāvṛttyai | trirāha | triṣatyā hi devāḥ | avācaṃ yamo'nanvārabhyottarāḥ | aparimitamevāvarundhe | na dārupātreṇa duhyāt | agnivadvai dārupātram | yaddārupātreṇa duhyāt
3.2.3.d: बहु दुग्धीन्द्राय देवेभ्यो हविरिति वाचं विसृजते । यथादेवतमेव प्रसौति । दैव्यस्य च मानुषस्य च व्यावृत्त्यै । त्रिराह । त्रिषत्या हि देवाः । अवाचं यमोऽनन्वारभ्योत्तराः । अपरिमितमेवावरुन्धे । न दारुपात्रेण दुह्यात् । अग्निवद्वै दारुपात्रम् । यद्दारुपात्रेण दुह्यात्
3.2.3.m: "Much milk for Indra, the oblation for the gods!" Saying this, he releases speech. / He impels [it] according to each deity, / to distinguish between the divine and the human. / Three times he speaks. / For the gods are threefold true. / Without restraining speech, without taking hold, [he milks] the subsequent [cows]. / He secures the unlimited. / He should not milk into a wooden vessel. / The wooden vessel has the nature of Agni. / If he were to milk into a wooden vessel,

3.2.3.s: yātayāmnā haviṣā yajeta | atho khalvāhuḥ | puroḍāśamukhāni vai havīṃṣi | neta itaḥ puroḍāśaṃ haviṣo yāmo'stīti | kāmameva dārupātreṇa duhyāt | śūdra eva na duhyāt | asato vā eṣa saṃbhūtaḥ | yacchūdraḥ | ahavireva tadityāhuḥ | yacchūdro dogdhīti
3.2.3.d: यातयाम्ना हविषा यजेत । अथो खल्वाहुः । पुरोडाशमुखानि वै हवींषि । नेत इतः पुरोडाशं हविषो यामोऽस्तीति । काममेव दारुपात्रेण दुह्यात् । शूद्र एव न दुह्यात् । असतो वा एष संभूतः । यच्छूद्रः । अहविरेव तदित्याहुः । यच्छूद्रो दोग्धीति
3.2.3.m: he would sacrifice with a stale oblation. / Yet they also say: / "The cake is the foremost of oblations; / the path of the oblation does not depart from the cake." / At will, he may milk into a wooden vessel. / Only a Śūdra should not milk. / He is born from non-existence, / namely the Śūdra. / "That is non-oblation," they say, / "which a Śūdra milks."

3.2.3.s: agnihotrameva na duhyācchūdraḥ | taddhi notpunanti | yadā khalu vai pavitramatyeti | atha taddhaviriti | saṃpṛcyadhvamṛtāvarīrityāha | apāṃ caivauṣadhīnāṃ ca rasaṃ saṃsṛjati | tasmādapāṃ cauṣadhīnāṃ ca rasamupajīvāmaḥ | mandrā dhanasya sātaya ityāha | puṣṭimeva yajamāne dadhāti | somena tvā''tanacmīndrāya dadhītyāha
3.2.3.d: अग्निहोत्रमेव न दुह्याच्छूद्रः । तद्धि नोत्पुनन्ति । यदा खलु वै पवित्रमत्येति । अथ तद्धविरिति । संपृच्यध्वमृतावरीरित्याह । अपां चैवौषधीनां च रसं संसृजति । तस्मादपां चौषधीनां च रसमुपजीवामः । मन्द्रा धनस्य सातय इत्याह । पुष्टिमेव यजमाने दधाति । सोमेन त्वा'ऽतनच्मीन्द्राय दधीत्याह
3.2.3.m: A Śūdra should not milk the Agnihotra milk. / For they do not strain that. / When indeed it passes through the filter, / then it is the oblation. / "Mix together, O righteous ones!" he says. / He unites the sap of water and plants. / Therefore we subsist on the sap of water and plants. / "Pleasing, for the winning of wealth," he says. / He thereby places nourishment in the sacrificer. / "With soma I curdle you, curds for Indra," he says.

3.2.3.s: somamevainatkaroti | yo vai somaṃ bhakṣayitvā | saṃvathsaraṃ somaṃ na pibati | punarbhakṣyo'sya somapītho bhavati | somaḥ khalu vai sānnāyyam | ya evaṃ vidvānthsāṃnāyyaṃ pibati | apunarbhakṣyo'sya somapītho bhavati | na mṛnmayenāpidadhyāt | yanmṛnmayenāpidadhyāt | pitṛdevatyagg syāt
3.2.3.d: सोममेवैनत्करोति । यो वै सोमं भक्षयित्वा । संवथ्सरं सोमं न पिबति । पुनर्भक्ष्योऽस्य सोमपीथो भवति । सोमः खलु वै सान्नाय्यम् । य एवं विद्वान्थ्सांनाय्यं पिबति । अपुनर्भक्ष्योऽस्य सोमपीथो भवति । न मृन्मयेनापिदध्यात् । यन्मृन्मयेनापिदध्यात् । पितृदेवत्यग्ग् स्यात्
3.2.3.m: He thereby makes it Soma. / Whoever, having consumed Soma, / does not drink Soma for a year, / his draught of Soma becomes something to be consumed again. / Soma indeed is the curd-milk mixture. / He who, knowing thus, drinks the curd-milk mixture, / his draught of Soma does not become something to be consumed again. / He should not cover it with an earthenware vessel. / If he were to cover it with an earthenware vessel, / it would belong to the ancestors.

3.2.3.s: ayaspātreṇa vā dārupātreṇa vā'pidadhāti | taddhi sadevam | udanvadbhavati | āpo vai rakṣoghnīḥ | rakṣasāmapahatyai | adastamasi viṣṇave tvetyāha | yajño vai viṣṇuḥ | yajñāyaivainadadastaṃ karoti | viṣṇo havyaṃ rakṣasvetyāha guptyai | anadhaḥ sādayati | garbhāṇāṃ dhṛtyā aprapādāya | tasmādgarbhāḥ prajānāmaprapādukāḥ | uparīva nidadhāti | uparīva hi suvargo lokaḥ | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai
3.2.3.d: अयस्पात्रेण वा दारुपात्रेण वाऽपिदधाति । तद्धि सदेवम् । उदन्वद्भवति । आपो वै रक्षोघ्नीः । रक्षसामपहत्यै । अदस्तमसि विष्णवे त्वेत्याह । यज्ञो वै विष्णुः । यज्ञायैवैनददस्तं करोति । विष्णो हव्यं रक्षस्वेत्याह गुप्त्यै । अनधः सादयति । गर्भाणां धृत्या अप्रपादाय । तस्माद्गर्भाः प्रजानामप्रपादुकाः । उपरीव निदधाति । उपरीव हि सुवर्गो लोकः । सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै
3.2.3.m: He covers it either with a metal vessel or with a wooden vessel; / for that is accompanied by the gods. / It contains water. / Waters indeed are slayers of the Rakṣases; / [it is] for the warding off of the Rakṣases. / He says, 'You are not destroyed; for Viṣṇu [I take] you.' / Viṣṇu indeed is the sacrifice. / He thereby makes it undestroyed for the sacrifice. / He says, 'O Viṣṇu, protect the oblation,' for protection. / He sets it down not low, / for the retention of embryos, that they may not fall out. / Therefore the embryos of living creatures do not fall out. / He places it, as it were, above; / for the heavenly realm is, as it were, above; / [it is] for the attainment of the heavenly realm.

3.2.4.s: karmaṇe vāṃ devebhyaḥ śakeyamityāha śaktyai | yajñasya vai saṃtatimanu prajāḥ paśavo yajamānasya saṃtāyante | yajñasya vicchittimanu prajāḥ paśavo yajamānasya vicchidyante | yajñasya saṃtatirasi yajñasya tvā saṃtatyai stṛṇāmi saṃtatyai tvā yajñasyetyāhavanīyāthsaṃtanoti | yajamānasya prajāyai paśūnāṃ saṃtatyai | apaḥ praṇayati | śraddhā vā āpaḥ | śraddhāmevārabhya praṇīya pracarati | apaḥ praṇayati | yajño vā āpaḥ
3.2.4.d: कर्मणे वां देवेभ्यः शकेयमित्याह शक्त्यै । यज्ञस्य वै संततिमनु प्रजाः पशवो यजमानस्य संतायन्ते । यज्ञस्य विच्छित्तिमनु प्रजाः पशवो यजमानस्य विच्छिद्यन्ते । यज्ञस्य संततिरसि यज्ञस्य त्वा संतत्यै स्तृणामि संतत्यै त्वा यज्ञस्येत्याहवनीयाथ्संतनोति । यजमानस्य प्रजायै पशूनां संतत्यै । अपः प्रणयति । श्रद्धा वा आपः । श्रद्धामेवारभ्य प्रणीय प्रचरति । अपः प्रणयति । यज्ञो वा आपः
3.2.4.m:
He says, 'For the work of you two, for the gods, may I be able,' for capability. / Along with the continuity of the sacrifice the offspring and domestic animals of the sacrificer are continued. / Along with the disruption of the sacrifice the offspring and domestic animals of the sacrificer are disrupted. / With 'You are the continuity of the sacrifice; for the continuity of the sacrifice I strew you; for the continuity of the sacrifice [I strew] you,' he stretches [a line of straw] continuously up to the āhavanīya fire, / for the continuity of the sacrificer's offspring and domestic animals. / He leads forward the waters. / The waters indeed are faith; having undertaken and led forward faith, he proceeds. / He leads forward the waters. / The sacrifice indeed is the waters.

Having undertaken and led forward the sacrifice, he proceeds. / He leads forward the waters. / The thunderbolt indeed is the waters. / Having hurled the thunderbolt at his rivals and led it forward, he proceeds. / He leads forward the waters. / The waters indeed are slayers of the Rakṣases; / [it is] for the warding off of the Rakṣases. / He leads forward the waters. / The waters indeed are the dear domain of the gods. / Having led forward the dear domain of the gods, he proceeds.

3.2.4.s: yajñamevārabhya praṇīya pracarati | apaḥ praṇayati | vajro vā āpaḥ | vajrameva bhrātṛvyebhyaḥ prahṛtya praṇīya pracarati | apaḥ praṇayati | āpo vai rakṣoghnīḥ | rakṣasāmapahatyai | apaḥ praṇayati | āpo vai devānāṃ priyaṃ dhāma | devānāmeva priyaṃ dhāma praṇīya pracarati
3.2.4.d: यज्ञमेवारभ्य प्रणीय प्रचरति । अपः प्रणयति । वज्रो वा आपः । वज्रमेव भ्रातृव्येभ्यः प्रहृत्य प्रणीय प्रचरति । अपः प्रणयति । आपो वै रक्षोघ्नीः । रक्षसामपहत्यै । अपः प्रणयति । आपो वै देवानां प्रियं धाम । देवानामेव प्रियं धाम प्रणीय प्रचरति
3.2.4.m: He leads forward the waters. / The waters indeed are all the deities. / Having undertaken and led forward the deities, he proceeds. / He says, 'For the garb, [I take] you'; / for it is for the garb that he takes it. / He says, 'Scorched is the Rakṣas, scorched are the enemies,' / for the warding off of the Rakṣases. / He says, 'You are the yoke-pole.' / This fire indeed belongs to the yoke-pole. / If he were to pass beyond it without touching [it],

3.2.4.s: apaḥ praṇayati | āpo vai sarvā devatāḥ | devatā evārabhya praṇīya pracarati | veṣāya tvetyāha | veṣāya hyenadādatte | pratyuṣṭaṃ rakṣaḥ pratyuṣṭā arātaya ityāha | rakṣasāmapahatyai | dhūrasītyāha | eṣa vai dhuryo'gniḥ | taṃ yadanupaspṛśyātīyāt
3.2.4.d: अपः प्रणयति । आपो वै सर्वा देवताः । देवता एवारभ्य प्रणीय प्रचरति । वेषाय त्वेत्याह । वेषाय ह्येनदादत्ते । प्रत्युष्टं रक्षः प्रत्युष्टा अरातय इत्याह । रक्षसामपहत्यै । धूरसीत्याह । एष वै धुर्योऽग्निः । तं यदनुपस्पृश्यातीयात्

3.2.4.s: adhvaryuṃ ca yajamānaṃ ca pradahet | upaspṛśyātyeti | adhvaryośca yajamānasya cāpradāhāya | dhūrvataṃ yo'smāndhūrvati taṃ dhūrvayaṃ vayaṃ dhūrvāma ityāha | dvau vāva puruṣau | yaṃ caiva dhūrvati | yaścainaṃ dhūrvati | tāvubhau śucā'rpayati | tvaṃ devānāmasi sasnitamaṃ papritamaṃ juṣṭatamaṃ vahnitamaṃ devahūtamamityāha | yathā yajurevaitat
3.2.4.d: अध्वर्युं च यजमानं च प्रदहेत् । उपस्पृश्यात्येति । अध्वर्योश्च यजमानस्य चाप्रदाहाय । धूर्वतं योऽस्मान्धूर्वति तं धूर्वयं वयं धूर्वाम इत्याह । द्वौ वाव पुरुषौ । यं चैव धूर्वति । यश्चैनं धूर्वति । तावुभौ शुचाऽर्पयति । त्वं देवानामसि सस्नितमं पप्रितमं जुष्टतमं वह्नितमं देवहूतममित्याह । यथा यजुरेवैतत्
3.2.4.m: it would burn up both the adhvaryu and the sacrificer. / He passes beyond having touched it, / so that neither the adhvaryu nor the sacrificer may be burned. / He says, 'Injure him who injures us; injure him whom we injure.' / There are two men indeed: / the one whom he injures, / and the one who injures him. / Both of them he pierces with anguish. / He says, 'You among the gods are the most successful, the most fulfilling, the most agreeable, the most transporting, the best invoker of the gods.' / This is precisely according to the Yajus formula.

3.2.4.s: ahrutamasi havirdhānamityāhānārtyai | dṛṃhasva mā hvārityāha dhṛtyai | mitrasya tvā cakṣuṣā prekṣa ityāha mitratvāya | mā bhermā saṃvikthā mā tvā hiṃsiṣamityāhāhiṃsāyai | yadvai kiṃca vāto nābhivāti | tathsarvaṃ varuṇadevatyam | uruvātāyetyāha | avāruṇamevainatkaroti | devasya tvā savituḥ prasava ityāha prasūtyai | aśvinorbāhubhyāmityāha
3.2.4.d: अह्रुतमसि हविर्धानमित्याहानार्त्यै । दृंहस्व मा ह्वारित्याह धृत्यै । मित्रस्य त्वा चक्षुषा प्रेक्ष इत्याह मित्रत्वाय । मा भेर्मा संविक्था मा त्वा हिंसिषमित्याहाहिंसायै । यद्वै किंच वातो नाभिवाति । तथ्सर्वं वरुणदेवत्यम् । उरुवातायेत्याह । अवारुणमेवैनत्करोति । देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसव इत्याह प्रसूत्यै । अश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यामित्याह
3.2.4.m: He says, 'You are the uncrooked cart for oblations,' to prevent failure. / He says, 'Be firm, do not stagger,' for stability. / He says, 'I look upon you with the eye of Mitra,' for friendship. / He says, 'Do not fear, do not tremble, may I not harm you,' for harmlessness. / Whatever the wind does not blow upon, / that all belongs to Varuṇa. / He says, 'Wide for the wind.' / He thereby makes it free from Varuṇa. / He says, 'At the instigation of the divine Savitṛ,' for impulsion. / He says, 'With the arms of the Aśvins,'

3.2.4.s: aśvinau hi devānāmadhvaryū āstām | pūṣṇo hastābhyāmityāha yatyai | agnaye juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmītyāha | agnaya evaināṃ juṣṭaṃ nirvapati | triryajuṣā | traya ime lokāḥ | eṣāṃ lokānāmāptyai | tūṣṇīṃ caturtham | aparimitamevāvarundhe | sa evamevānu pūrvaṃ havīṃṣi nirvapati
3.2.4.d: अश्विनौ हि देवानामध्वर्यू आस्ताम् । पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यामित्याह यत्यै । अग्नये जुष्टं निर्वपामीत्याह । अग्नय एवैनां जुष्टं निर्वपति । त्रिर्यजुषा । त्रय इमे लोकाः । एषां लोकानामाप्त्यै । तूष्णीं चतुर्थम् । अपरिमितमेवावरुन्धे । स एवमेवानु पूर्वं हवींषि निर्वपति
3.2.4.m: for the Aśvins were the two adhvaryus of the gods. / He says, 'With the hands of Pūṣan,' / for proper order. / He says, 'Agreeable to Agni I measure out [you].' / He measures it out agreeable to Agni. / Three times with a Yajus formula; / three are these worlds; / [it is] for the attainment of these worlds. / Silently a fourth time; / he thereby secures the unlimited. / In this very manner he measures out the oblations in order.

3.2.4.s: idaṃ devānāmidamunaḥ sahetyāha vyāvṛttyai | sphātyai tvā nārātyā ityāha guptyai | tamasīva vā eṣo'ntaścarati | yaḥ parīṇahi | suvarabhi vikhyeṣaṃ vaiśvānaraṃ jyotirityāha | suvarevābhi vipaśyati vaiśvānaraṃ jyotiḥ | dyāvāpṛthivī haviṣi gṛhīta udavepetām | dṛṃhantāṃ duryā dyāvāpṛthivyorityāha | gṛhāṇāṃ dyāvāpṛthivyordhṛtyai | urvantarikṣamanvihītyāha gatyai | adityāstvopasthe sādayāmītyāha | iyaṃ vā aditiḥ | asyā evainadupasthe sādayati | agne havyaṃ rakṣasvetyāha guptyai
3.2.4.d: इदं देवानामिदमुनः सहेत्याह व्यावृत्त्यै । स्फात्यै त्वा नारात्या इत्याह गुप्त्यै । तमसीव वा एषोऽन्तश्चरति । यः परीणहि । सुवरभि विख्येषं वैश्वानरं ज्योतिरित्याह । सुवरेवाभि विपश्यति वैश्वानरं ज्योतिः । द्यावापृथिवी हविषि गृहीत उदवेपेताम् । दृंहन्तां दुर्या द्यावापृथिव्योरित्याह । गृहाणां द्यावापृथिव्योर्धृत्यै । उर्वन्तरिक्षमन्विहीत्याह गत्यै । अदित्यास्त्वोपस्थे सादयामीत्याह । इयं वा अदितिः । अस्या एवैनदुपस्थे सादयति । अग्ने हव्यं रक्षस्वेत्याह गुप्त्यै
3.2.4.m: He says, 'This for the gods, this in turn together for us,' for separation. / He says, 'For abundance [I take] you, not for malice,' for protection. / Indeed, he moves as if in darkness, / he who is within the cart-frame. / He says, 'May I behold the sun, the Vaiśvānara light.' / He thereby looks upon the sun, the Vaiśvānara light. / Heaven and earth trembled when the oblation was taken. / He says, 'May the dwellings of heaven and earth be firm,' / for the stability of heaven and earth, the two dwellings. / He says, 'Follow the wide intermediate space,' for passage. / He says, 'I place you in the lap of Aditi.' / Aditi indeed is this [earth]. / He sets it down in her lap. / He says, 'O Agni, protect the oblation,' for protection.

3.2.5.s: indro vṛtramahann | so'paḥ | abhyamriyata | tāsāṃ yanmedhyaṃ yajñiyaṃ sadevamāsīt | tadapodakrāmat | te darbhā abhavann | yaddarbhairapa utpunāti | yā eva medhyā yajñiyāḥ sadevā āpaḥ | tābhirevainā utpunāti | dvābhyāmutpunāti
3.2.5.d: इन्द्रो वृत्रमहन्न् । सोऽपः । अभ्यम्रियत । तासां यन्मेध्यं यज्ञियं सदेवमासीत् । तदपोदक्रामत् । ते दर्भा अभवन्न् । यद्दर्भैरप उत्पुनाति । या एव मेध्या यज्ञियाः सदेवा आपः । ताभिरेवैना उत्पुनाति । द्वाभ्यामुत्पुनाति
3.2.5.m: Indra slew Vṛtra. / He died upon the waters. / What of them was fit for sacrifice, sacrificial, and accompanied by the gods, / that stepped out. / They became darbha grass. / When he purifies the waters with blades of darbha grass, / with those very waters that are fit for sacrifice, sacrificial, and accompanied by the gods, / with them he purifies these [waters]. / With two [blades] he purifies,

3.2.5.s: dvipādyajamānaḥ pratiṣṭhityai | devo vaḥ savitotpunātvityāha | savitṛprasūta evainā utpunāti | acchidreṇa pavitreṇetyāha | asau vā ādityo'cchidraṃ pavitram | tenaivainā utpunāti | vasoḥ sūryasya raśmibhirityāha | prāṇā vā āpaḥ | prāṇā vasavaḥ | prāṇā raśmayaḥ
3.2.5.d: द्विपाद्यजमानः प्रतिष्ठित्यै । देवो वः सवितोत्पुनात्वित्याह । सवितृप्रसूत एवैना उत्पुनाति । अच्छिद्रेण पवित्रेणेत्याह । असौ वा आदित्योऽच्छिद्रं पवित्रम् । तेनैवैना उत्पुनाति । वसोः सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिरित्याह । प्राणा वा आपः । प्राणा वसवः । प्राणा रश्मयः
3.2.5.m: for the sacrificer is two-footed, for firm standing. / He says, 'May the divine Savitṛ purify you.' / Instigated by Savitṛ he purifies them. / He says, 'With an unslit strainer.' / Yonder sun indeed is an unslit strainer. / With that he purifies them. / He says, 'With the rays of the good Sūrya.' / The waters indeed are the vital breaths; the Vasus are the vital breaths; / the rays are the vital breaths.

3.2.5.s: prāṇaireva prāṇānthsaṃpṛṇakti | sāvitriyarcā | savitṛprasūtaṃ me karmāsaditi | savitṛprasūtamevāsya karma bhavati | paccho gāyatriyā triṣṣamṛddhatvāya | āpo devīragrepuvo agre guva ityāha | rūpamevāsāmetanmahimānaṃ vyācaṣṭe | agra imaṃ yajñaṃ nayatāgre yajñapatimityāha | agra eva yajñaṃ nayanti | agre yajñapatim
3.2.5.d: प्राणैरेव प्राणान्थ्संपृणक्ति । सावित्रियर्चा । सवितृप्रसूतं मे कर्मासदिति । सवितृप्रसूतमेवास्य कर्म भवति । पच्छो गायत्रिया त्रिष्षमृद्धत्वाय । आपो देवीरग्रेपुवो अग्रे गुव इत्याह । रूपमेवासामेतन्महिमानं व्याचष्टे । अग्र इमं यज्ञं नयताग्रे यज्ञपतिमित्याह । अग्र एव यज्ञं नयन्ति । अग्रे यज्ञपतिम्
3.2.5.m: With the vital breaths he unites the vital breaths. / With a verse dedicated to Savitṛ [he purifies], / thinking, 'May my action be instigated by Savitṛ.' / His action indeed becomes instigated by Savitṛ. / Pāda by pāda with the Gāyatrī verse, for triple prosperity. / He says, 'O divine waters, purifying in front, moving in front.' / He thereby declares their form and their greatness. / He says, 'Lead this sacrifice in front, in front the lord of the sacrifice.' / They lead the sacrifice in front, / in front the lord of the sacrifice.

3.2.5.s: yuṣmānindro'vṛṇīta vṛtratūrye yūyamindramavṛṇīdhvaṃ vṛtratūrya ityāha | vṛtraṃ ha haniṣyannindra āpo vavre | āpo hendraṃ vavrire | saṃjñāmevāsāmetathsāmānaṃ vyācaṣṭe | prokṣitāḥ sthetyāha | tenāpaḥ prokṣitāḥ | agnaye vo juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmyagnīṣomābhyāmityāha | yathādevatamevainānprokṣati | triḥ prokṣati | tryāvṛddhi yajñaḥ
3.2.5.d: युष्मानिन्द्रोऽवृणीत वृत्रतूर्ये यूयमिन्द्रमवृणीध्वं वृत्रतूर्य इत्याह । वृत्रं ह हनिष्यन्निन्द्र आपो वव्रे । आपो हेन्द्रं वव्रिरे । संज्ञामेवासामेतथ्सामानं व्याचष्टे । प्रोक्षिताः स्थेत्याह । तेनापः प्रोक्षिताः । अग्नये वो जुष्टं प्रोक्षाम्यग्नीषोमाभ्यामित्याह । यथादेवतमेवैनान्प्रोक्षति । त्रिः प्रोक्षति । त्र्यावृद्धि यज्ञः
3.2.5.m: "Indra chose you in the contest with Vṛtra; you chose Indra in the contest with Vṛtra," he says. / For Indra, about to slay Vṛtra, chose the waters. / The waters chose Indra. / He thus explains their agreement and harmony. / "You are sprinkled," he says. / Thereby the waters are sprinkled. / "Agreeable to Agni I sprinkle you, to Agni and Soma," he says. / According to deity he sprinkles them. / Three times he sprinkles. / For threefold is the sacrifice.

3.2.5.s: atho rakṣasāmapahatyai | śundhadhvaṃ daivyāya karmaṇe devayajyāyā ityāha | devayajyāyā evaināni śundhati | triḥ prokṣati | tryāvṛddhi yajñaḥ | atho medhyatvāya | avadhūtaṃ rakṣo'vadhūtā arātaya ityāha | rakṣasāmapahatyai | adityāstvagasītyāha | iyaṃ vā aditiḥ
3.2.5.d: अथो रक्षसामपहत्यै । शुन्धध्वं दैव्याय कर्मणे देवयज्याया इत्याह । देवयज्याया एवैनानि शुन्धति । त्रिः प्रोक्षति । त्र्यावृद्धि यज्ञः । अथो मेध्यत्वाय । अवधूतं रक्षोऽवधूता अरातय इत्याह । रक्षसामपहत्यै । अदित्यास्त्वगसीत्याह । इयं वा अदितिः
3.2.5.m: And [it is] for the smiting away of the rakṣases. / "Be cleansed for the divine work, for the sacrifice to the gods," he says. / For the sacrifice to the gods he cleanses them. / Three times he sprinkles. / For threefold is the sacrifice. / And [it is] for fitness for sacrifice. / "Shaken away is the rakṣas, shaken away are the enemies," he says. / For the smiting away of the rakṣases. / "You are the skin of Aditi," he says. / Aditi indeed is this [earth].

3.2.5.s: asyā evainattvacaṃ karoti | prati tvā pṛthivī vettvityāha pratiṣṭhityai | purastātpratīcīna grīvamuttaralomopa stṛṇāti medhyatvāya | tasmātpurastātpratyañcaḥ paśavo medhamupatiṣṭhante | tasmātprajā mṛgaṃ grāhukāḥ | yajño devebhyo nilāyata | kṛṣṇo rūpaṃ kṛtvā | yatkṛṣṇājine haviradhyavahanti | yajñādeva tadyajñaṃ prayuṅkte | haviṣo'skandāya
3.2.5.d: अस्या एवैनत्त्वचं करोति । प्रति त्वा पृथिवी वेत्त्वित्याह प्रतिष्ठित्यै । पुरस्तात्प्रतीचीन ग्रीवमुत्तरलोमोप स्तृणाति मेध्यत्वाय । तस्मात्पुरस्तात्प्रत्यञ्चः पशवो मेधमुपतिष्ठन्ते । तस्मात्प्रजा मृगं ग्राहुकाः । यज्ञो देवेभ्यो निलायत । कृष्णो रूपं कृत्वा । यत्कृष्णाजिने हविरध्यवहन्ति । यज्ञादेव तद्यज्ञं प्रयुङ्क्ते । हविषोऽस्कन्दाय
3.2.5.m: He makes it her skin. / "May earth recognize you," he says, for stability. / In front, with neck pointing westward, with fleece uppermost, he spreads it out, for fitness for sacrifice. / Therefore domestic animals in front, facing west, attend the sacrifice. / Therefore creatures capture wild game. / The sacrifice concealed itself from the gods, / having assumed a black form. / When he pounds the oblation on the black antelope skin, / from the sacrifice itself he harnesses the sacrifice, / for non-spilling of the oblation.

3.2.5.s: adhiṣavaṇamasi vānaspatyamityāha | adhiṣavaṇamevainatkaroti | prati tvā'dityāstvagvetvityāha sayatvāya | agnestanūrasītyāha | agnervā eṣā tanūḥ | yadoṣadhayaḥ | vāco visarjanamityāha | yadā hi prajā oṣadhīnāmaśnanti | atha vācaṃ visṛjante | devavītaye tvā gṛhṇāmītyāha
3.2.5.d: अधिषवणमसि वानस्पत्यमित्याह । अधिषवणमेवैनत्करोति । प्रति त्वाऽदित्यास्त्वग्वेत्वित्याह सयत्वाय । अग्नेस्तनूरसीत्याह । अग्नेर्वा एषा तनूः । यदोषधयः । वाचो विसर्जनमित्याह । यदा हि प्रजा ओषधीनामश्नन्ति । अथ वाचं विसृजन्ते । देववीतये त्वा गृह्णामीत्याह
3.2.5.m: "You are the pressing-board made of wood," he says. / He makes it a pressing-board. / "May the skin of Aditi recognize you," he says, for union. / "You are the body of Agni," he says. / This is indeed the body of Agni: / the plants. / "The release of speech," he says. / For when creatures eat of the plants, / then they release speech. / "For the feast of the gods I take you," he says.

3.2.5.s: devatābhirevainathsamardhayati | adrirasi vānaspatya ityāha | grāvāṇamevainatkaroti | sa idaṃ devebhyo havyaṃ suśami śamiṣvetyāha śāntyai | haviṣkṛdehītyāha | ya eva devānāṃ haviṣkṛtaḥ | tānhvayati | trirhvayati | triṣatyā hi devāḥ | iṣamā vadorjamā vadetyāha
3.2.5.d: देवताभिरेवैनथ्समर्धयति । अद्रिरसि वानस्पत्य इत्याह । ग्रावाणमेवैनत्करोति । स इदं देवेभ्यो हव्यं सुशमि शमिष्वेत्याह शान्त्यै । हविष्कृदेहीत्याह । य एव देवानां हविष्कृतः । तान्ह्वयति । त्रिर्ह्वयति । त्रिषत्या हि देवाः । इषमा वदोर्जमा वदेत्याह
3.2.5.m: With the deities he causes it to prosper. / "You are the rock made of wood," he says. / He makes it a grinding stone. / "May you prepare this oblation well for the gods," he says, for peace. / "Maker of the oblation, come!" he says. / Those who are makers of the oblation for the gods, / them he summons. / Three times he summons. / For the gods are threefold in truth. / "Speak forth refreshment! Speak forth vigor!" he says.

3.2.5.s: iṣamevorjaṃ yajamāne dadhāti | dyumadvadata vayaṃ saṃghātaṃ jeṣmetyāha bhrātṛvyābhibhūtyai | manoḥ śraddhādevasya yajamānasyāsuraghnī vāk | yajñāyudheṣu praviṣṭā''sīt | te'surā yāvanto yajñāyudhānāmudvadatāmupāśṛṇvann | te parābhavann | tasmāthsvānāṃ madhye'vasāya yajeta | yāvanto'sya bhrātṛvyā yajñāyudhānāmudvadatāmupaśṛṇvanti | te parābhavanti | uccaiḥ samāhantavā āha vijityai
3.2.5.d: इषमेवोर्जं यजमाने दधाति । द्युमद्वदत वयं संघातं जेष्मेत्याह भ्रातृव्याभिभूत्यै । मनोः श्रद्धादेवस्य यजमानस्यासुरघ्नी वाक् । यज्ञायुधेषु प्रविष्टा'ऽसीत् । तेऽसुरा यावन्तो यज्ञायुधानामुद्वदतामुपाशृण्वन्न् । ते पराभवन्न् । तस्माथ्स्वानां मध्येऽवसाय यजेत । यावन्तोऽस्य भ्रातृव्या यज्ञायुधानामुद्वदतामुपशृण्वन्ति । ते पराभवन्ति । उच्चैः समाहन्तवा आह विजित्यै
3.2.5.m: Refreshment and vigor he places in the sacrificer. / "Speak brilliantly, so that we may conquer the gathering!" he says, to overcome the rival. / The voice of Manu, who had faith in the gods, the sacrificer, was a slayer of asuras; / it had entered the sacrificial implements. / As many asuras as heard the sacrificial implements sounding, / they perished. / Therefore one should settle and sacrifice in the midst of one's own people. / As many rivals of his as hear the sacrificial implements sounding, / they perish. / "Pound together loudly!" he says, for victory.

3.2.5.s: vṛṅkta eṣāmindriyaṃ vīryam | śreṣṭha eṣāṃ bhavati | varṣavṛddhamasi prati tvā varṣavṛddhaṃ vettvityāha | varṣavṛddhā vā oṣadhayaḥ | varṣavṛddhā iṣīkāḥ samṛddhyai | yajñaṃ rakṣāṃsyanuprāviśann | tānyasnā paśubhyo niravādayanta | tuṣairoṣadhībhyaḥ | parāpūtaṃ rakṣaḥ parāpūtā arātaya ityāha | rakṣasāmapahatyai
3.2.5.d: वृङ्क्त एषामिन्द्रियं वीर्यम् । श्रेष्ठ एषां भवति । वर्षवृद्धमसि प्रति त्वा वर्षवृद्धं वेत्त्वित्याह । वर्षवृद्धा वा ओषधयः । वर्षवृद्धा इषीकाः समृद्ध्यै । यज्ञं रक्षांस्यनुप्राविशन्न् । तान्यस्ना पशुभ्यो निरवादयन्त । तुषैरोषधीभ्यः । परापूतं रक्षः परापूता अरातय इत्याह । रक्षसामपहत्यै
3.2.5.m: He takes away their power and heroic power. / He becomes the best of them. / "You are grown by rain; may what is grown by rain recognize you," he says. / The plants are indeed grown by rain; / the reeds are grown by rain, for prosperity. / The rakṣases entered into the sacrifice. / Them they excluded from domestic animals with blood, / from plants with husks. / "Winnowed away is the rakṣas, winnowed away are the enemies," he says, / for the smiting away of the rakṣases.

3.2.5.s: rakṣasāṃ bhāgo'sītyāha | tuṣaireva rakṣāṃsi niravadayate | apa upaspṛśati medhyatvāya | vāyurvo vivinaktvityāha | pavitraṃ vai vāyuḥ | punātyevainān | antarikṣādiva vā ete praskandanti | ye śūrpāt | devo vaḥ savitā hiraṇyapāṇiḥ pratigṛhṇātvityāha pratiṣṭhityai | haviṣo'skandāya | triṣphalī kartavā āha | tryāvṛddhi yajñaḥ | atho medhyatvāya
3.2.5.d: रक्षसां भागोऽसीत्याह । तुषैरेव रक्षांसि निरवदयते । अप उपस्पृशति मेध्यत्वाय । वायुर्वो विविनक्त्वित्याह । पवित्रं वै वायुः । पुनात्येवैनान् । अन्तरिक्षादिव वा एते प्रस्कन्दन्ति । ये शूर्पात् । देवो वः सविता हिरण्यपाणिः प्रतिगृह्णात्वित्याह प्रतिष्ठित्यै । हविषोऽस्कन्दाय । त्रिष्फली कर्तवा आह । त्र्यावृद्धि यज्ञः । अथो मेध्यत्वाय
3.2.5.m: "You are the portion of the rakṣases," he says. / With the husks he excludes the rakṣases. / He touches water, for fitness for sacrifice. / "May Vāyu separate you," he says. / Vāyu is indeed a purifier. / He purifies them. / As if from the intermediate space these leap forth, / which [fall] from the winnowing basket. / "May divine Savitṛ of golden hand receive you," he says, for stability, / for non-spilling of the oblation. / "Thrice shall it be husked," he says. / For threefold is the sacrifice, / and [it is] for fitness for sacrifice.

3.2.6.s: avadhūtaṃ rakṣo'vadhūtā arātaya ityāha | rakṣasāmapahatyai | adityāstvagasītyāha | iyaṃ vā aditiḥ | asyā evainattvacaṃ karoti | prati tvā pṛthivī vettvityāha pratiṣṭhityai | purastātpratīcīna grīvamuttara lomopastṛṇāti medhyatvāya | tasmātpurastātpratyañcaḥ paśavo medhamupatiṣṭhante | tasmātprajā mṛgaṃ grāhukāḥ | yajño devebhyo nilāyata
